job.title: 3rd Shift Registered Nurse - Occupational Health
job.description:
Occupational Health Registered Nurses needed for 3rd shift contract opportunities with Yoh's manufacturing client in Arlington, TX. Two openings available!
 
  • Opening #1: Full-time, Sunday-Thursday for approximately 3 months, then transitions to per-diem
  • Opening #2: Two Fridays per month plus additional per diem coverage as needed (minimum commitment of 4 shifts/month)

This role is primarily focused on occupational health administration, compliance reporting, and case documentation, with limited direct patient care. The RN will support employee health services while managing OSHA records, workers' compensation documentation, health surveillance records, and corporate reporting requirements.


3rd Shift: 10:00PM - 6:30AM (Sundays 9:00PM - 6:30AM)
* Flexibility for occasional earlier or later start/end times is required to support shift changes.
* Must be able to complete 5 days of daytime orientation prior to working independently on 3rd shift. Orientation is typically 6:00AM - 2:30PM, with EMR training from 7:00AM - 3:30PM.

Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Active/unrestricted Texas RN license
  • 3+ years of nursing experience in Occupational Health, Employee Health, Urgent Care, Emergency Medicine, Family Practice, Corrections, School Nursing, or similar settings
  • Strong organizational, time-management, and documentation skills
  • Self-motivated who can adapt to changing priorities and maintain a positive attitude in a fast-paced setting
  • Proficiency with EMR systems and electronic documentation
  • Professional, dependable, and customer-service focused

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Assess, triage, treat, and educate employees with work-related or non-work-related health concerns
  • Provide first aid and episodic treatment within established standing orders
  • Manage OSHA records, workers' compensation documentation, and health surveillance reporting
  • Perform occupational health screenings including drug testing, vision testing, pulmonary function testing, and biometric screenings
  • Document care and case activity in Cority EMR
  • Support employee wellness initiatives and programs
  • Assist with minor procedures and respond to workplace medical emergencies as needed

What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Current Texas RN license
  • Current CPR/BLS
  • Must be computer savvy with experience using EMR systems (Cority experience strongly preferred)
  • Effective oral and written communication skills
  • Knowledge of occupational health, injury prevention, workplace safety, and employee wellness principles
  • Comfortable stepping into a busy environment, embracing change, and contributing to a collaborative, supportive team culture

What’s In It For You?
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on employee health, safety, and wellness
  • Long-term opportunity with ongoing per diem potential
  • Weekly direct deposit every Friday

Know a qualified healthcare professional looking for their next opportunity? Refer them today!!
*Yoh Healthcare specializes in occupational/employee health and case management services. We partner with well-known companies, hospitals, and managed care companies nationwide to place top healthcare professionals like Medical Assistants, Nurses, Physician Assistants, and Nurse Practitioners. To explore our current openings, visit https://jobs.yoh.com/#/jobs!

job.title: Data Analyst/Developer (Python, Azure, ADF, SQL)
job.description:
Data Analyst/Developer (Python, Azure, ADF, SQL)
6 month contract to hire
Dallas, TX (Remote, must reside in TX)

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations that communicate business insights effectively.
  • Translate business requirements and analytical findings into clear visual representations.
  • Develop semantic data models and data access solutions that support analytics and reporting needs.
  • Ensure visualization solutions meet both functional and non-functional business requirements.
  • Leverage enterprise-standard BI and analytics platforms to deliver scalable reporting solutions.
  • Create presentations and executive-level reporting materials as needed.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand reporting and analytics requirements.
  • Apply knowledge of business processes and data domains to identify valuable insights and opportunities.
  • Drive stakeholder adoption of data-driven decision making and analytics-enabled business process improvements.
  • Conduct knowledge transfer and training sessions on dashboards, reports, and visualization tools.
  • Partner with Data Engineers, Analytics Teams, and Subject Matter Experts to define data sourcing, transformation, and aggregation requirements.
  • Ensure business requirements are accurately reflected in technical designs.
  • Participate in proof-of-concept (POC) initiatives and recommend analytics solutions and visualization technologies.
  • Evaluate emerging visualization tools, technologies, and industry best practices.
  • Create intuitive visual experiences that transform data into meaningful business insights.
  • Understand target audiences and tailor visualizations to meet their needs.
  • Apply UX, visual design, and information design principles to maximize clarity and impact.
  • Simplify complex data into concise, actionable messages.
  • Continuously explore innovative ways to communicate insights through data visualization.
 
Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Programming, Analytics, or a related field.
  • 1+ years of Python development skills
  • 5+ years of experience developing business intelligence and analytics solutions.
  • 5+ years of experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF), Databricks, SQL, SSRS, Power BIand related BI technologies.
  • Experience driving analytics-enabled business process improvements and innovation.
  • Experience leading small project teams or workstreams.
  • Strong understanding of business information systems and enterprise data environments.
  • Proven ability to analyze complex cross-functional business problems and develop effective solutions.
  • Experience designing, developing, testing, and deploying business analytics and reporting solutions.

job.title: Lead Business System Analyst | Private Credit | Allvue Platform
job.description:
TThe Role
Serve as the primary technology partner to the Private Credit business, advancing the platforms, data, integrations and workflows supporting front-office and investment-accounting capabilities, with a primary focus on Allvue.
This is a hands-on role. You will lead discovery with business and technology stakeholders, configure investment applications, analyze data using SQL, troubleshoot complex issues and work directly with developers and vendors on solutions. You will own workstreams from concept through implementation and stabilization, mentor analysts, establish delivery standards and help shape the multi-year Private Credit technology roadmap. You will collaborate with colleagues across the US and UK.
What You Will Do
Business Partnership and Solution Design
  • Act as the primary technology partner for Private Credit stakeholders and the business product manager.
  • Lead discovery through workshops, interviews and data analysis; translate business needs into requirements, process flows, data mappings, functional designs and user stories.
  • Challenge assumptions, identify requirement and control gaps, evaluate solution options and drive clear business and technology decisions.
  • Design end-to-end Private Credit workflows spanning deal and facility setup, trade execution, funding, interest and fee accruals, rate resets, paydowns, amendments, valuations, restructurings and reporting.
  • Translate Private Credit operating requirements into scalable platform configurations, integrations and data solutions.
Systems, Data and Delivery
  • Configure Allvue workflows, reference data, business rules and application behavior.
  • Use advanced SQL for data profiling, reconciliation, impact analysis, data lineage and root-cause investigation.
  • Trace data across front-office platforms, Security Master, IBOR, investment accounting and enterprise data platforms to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Understand and map relationships among sponsors, borrowers/issuers, deals, facilities/assets, trades, portfolios, positions/holdings and accounting records.
  • Validate REST APIs, JSON payloads, batch/file interfaces and data pipelines; define reconciliations, exception handling and data-quality controls.
  • Partner with engineering teams on integration design, implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Lead system, integration and user-acceptance testing with particular focus on business outcomes, accounting impact, financial calculations and data integrity.
  • Support implementation through production stabilization and ensure sustainable operational handoff.
That entity-level modeling matters in your environment. In Loan Tape process, CFO was discussed in terms of company roles such as sponsor, borrower and issuer, followed by asset creation, funding/trade activity and downstream investment-accounting integration.
Credit Data, Loan Tapes and Reporting
I would give this its own section because it is a meaningful capability rather than burying it under qualifications.
  • Design, configure and maintain Private Credit loan tapes, portfolio extracts and credit reporting datasets for operational, investor, lender and other downstream requirements.
  • Define source-to-target mappings and calculations covering borrower/issuer, facility type, commitment, funded and unfunded amounts, outstanding principal, benchmark/reference rate, spread, floor, maturity, PIK/cash-pay terms, seniority, lien, financial metrics and portfolio/holding information.
  • Build configurable templates capable of supporting different reporting requirements while maintaining consistent definitions, lineage and controls.
  • Reconcile loan-tape outputs to Allvue, investment accounting and other systems of record; investigate and resolve breaks.
  • Understand how term sheets and executed credit documentation translate into structured system attributes, transaction terms and downstream reporting.
  • Develop and maintain tear sheets or credit snapshots used for portfolio monitoring and investment review.
This separation is worthwhile because your Private_Credit_Interview_Scorecard already distinguishes a loan tape from a tear sheet: the loan tape is a structured schedule of facilities and loan attributes, while the tear sheet is a concise borrower/deal snapshot used by portfolio managers and analysts. 
Platform, Vendor and Team Leadership
  • Partner with Allvue engineering, product and support teams to troubleshoot defects and influence product enhancements.
  • Evaluate trade-offs among native configuration, custom development, integration, data solutions including Snowflake, and business-process change.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level analysts and establish standards for requirements, solution design, testing, documentation and production readiness.
  • Contribute to the Private Credit technology roadmap with an emphasis on platform simplification, automation, reduced manual processing and stronger data quality and controls.
What You Bring
Private Credit Domain
  • Strong understanding of the Private Credit lifecycle, including origination, underwriting, closing and funding, servicing, portfolio monitoring, valuation, amendments, restructurings and exits.
  • Knowledge of instruments including unitranche, first- and second-lien direct lending, syndicated loans, term loans, delayed-draw term loans, revolving facilities, mezzanine and PIK/PIK-toggle debt.
  • Strong understanding of loan economics, including floating-rate structures, benchmarks/reference rates, spreads, floors, rate resets, OID, upfront and commitment fees, amendment fees, accruals, paydowns and funded/unfunded commitments.
  • Understanding of facility type, lien position and seniority, and how these characteristics affect transaction processing, accounting and reporting.
  • Understanding of how Security Master, IBOR and investment accounting support transaction processing, positions, controls and downstream data consumption.
  • Experience translating credit agreements, term sheets and other deal documentation into structured application and reporting requirements.
Analysis and Technical
  • Proven experience leading complex requirements analysis and solution design across business, product, data and engineering stakeholders.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including complex querying, reconciliation, profiling and root-cause analysis.
  • Hands-on experience configuring investment platforms; Allvue Credit Front Office and/or Investment Accounting strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, file-based interfaces, data mappings and integration troubleshooting.
  • Experience designing data-quality controls, reconciliations and exception-management processes.
  • Agile/Scrum delivery experience, including system testing, UAT, implementation and post-production validation.
 
Qualifications
  • 7+ years of experience in business systems analysis, product technology, solution delivery or a similar role within financial services, with meaningful hands-on SQL and application configuration experience.
  • 3+ years working with private markets, leveraged finance or alternative investments, preferably Private Credit/direct lending.
Nice to Have
  • Hands-on experience with Allvue Credit Front Office and Allvue Investment Accounting.
  • Experience with Private Equity, fund-of-funds or broader alternative-investment platforms.
  • Experience with Snowflake or comparable cloud data platforms and enterprise reporting/data-consumption patterns.
  • Experience with Security Master and IBOR implementations.
  • Experience integrating front-office investment platforms with accounting, enterprise data and downstream reporting systems.

job.title: Semiconductor Engineering Process Technician
job.description:
Gaveyard Semiconductor Engineering Process Technician needed for an 18-month contract to hire opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Santa Clara, California.


Pay Rate $28-$32 per hour


Shift available- Weekday Night Shift, Mon-Thurs 9am-7pm


The Big Picture – Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Solid interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Ability to quickly adapt to change


What You Will Be Doing:
  • FIB Technician Key Responsibilities:
  • Prepares samples for experiments include cleaning samples, mount / un-mount samples, loading FOUPs, prepare jobs for experimentation, to help evaluates performance of process system 
  • Prepare transmission electron microscope (TEM) lamella samples by focused ion beam (FIB) and help to optimize sample prep procedure and conditions, identify cutting location based on pattern instructions. 
  • Operate metrology tools in FIB & TEM lab to help understand cross section or top view critical dimension (CD), energy dispersive spectroscopy (EDS) analysis, take high-quality imaging pending on job assignment, identify all of patterns of interest, understand image quality requirement and sample/beam interaction to determine optimized condition, finish requested jobs under limited supervision after training.
  • Understand basic scanning electron microscopy (SEM)/Focused Ion Beam (FIB)/Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) principle.
  • Perform SEM/FIB/TEM system, perform routine maintenance procedures, flash, plasma clean, image calibrations etc. 
  • Perform routine shut down procedure. Identify problem put tool down and call for service. Coordinates instrument repair and maintenance. 
  • Order equipment and supplies, and coordinates with vendors and purchasing. Interface with requestors, understand their detail requirement, and communicate on results, Coordinates with engineering on job request status.
  • Help lab on monitoring job in the queue and maintaining lab throughput.
  • Document redo and lesson learn to lower redo rate
  • Pick up and drop off customer coupons from other labs if needed · Adhere to lab protocol and SOP's
  • Operate semiconductor process and metrology equipment in a lab environment
  • Supporting Clean Room Metrology Lab operations
  • Coordinates with engineering on samples priorities
  • Mounting, dismounting, cleaning and handling customer samples – coupons and wafers
  • Tracking and maintaining order of the incoming jobs and their execution
  • Knowledgeably operates laboratory process equipment and instrumentation
  • Execution of metrology jobs by using developed BKMs and available recipes on SEM metrology tools
  • Performing analysis of metrology images with company proprietary algorithms and SW, with predefined (available) recipes
  • Report preparation according to predefined template
  • Interface with requestors, understand their detail requirement, and communicate on results; help lab on monitoring wafer in process (WIP) and maintaining throughpu
  • Interface with HW team, HW troubleshooting, execute tool maintenance

What You Need to Bring to the Table: 
  • Have a college degree in Material, electrical, chemistry engineering, or a related field.
  • Basic data analytics skill
  • Able to be hands-on for lab operations, including sample handing and equipment operations.
  • Team player
  • Semiconductor experience is nice to have, but not a must.
  • Have 0-2 years of experience



Bonus Points! Otherwise Known As Preferred Qualifications:
  • Ability to work under pressure
  • Ability to work in team and individually
  • Knowledge / experience with Semiconductor and SEM metrology tools is a plus

job.description:
Position:  Engineering Technician
2 plus years of experience needed
Location: Austin, TX (onsite)
Type: 18-month contract
Pay: $23 to $26 per hour
New Hire Completion Bonus payout structure:
$500 after successful completion of 90 day
$1,000 after successful completion of 180 days

Key Responsibilities

job.title: Senior Hardware Engineer
job.description:
Senior Hardware Engineer

Scope:
• Lead board bring-up, hands-on testing, and characterization of analog, digital, mixed-signal, and high-speed circuits.
• Troubleshoot hardware issues, identify root causes, and implement and verify design modifications.
• Develop and execute test plans to validate hardware performance against system requirements.
• Document test results, debug findings, and recommended design improvements.
• Build and maintain detailed schematics using Altium Designer.
• Guide PCB layout to address critical design requirements, including signal integrity, power integrity, and timing.
• Perform signal integrity and high-speed simulations as needed.
• Partner with operations and assembly teams to ensure designs are manufacturable, testable, cost-effective, and ready for volume production.

Required:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
• Eight or more years of hands-on board-level hardware design experience, including substantial bring-up, debugging, and validation work.
• Proficiency in Altium Designer for schematic capture and PCB layout review.
• Strong foundation in analog, digital, mixed-signal, and high-speed circuit design.
• Proficiency with oscilloscopes and other laboratory instruments used for board-level testing and characterization.
• Ability to develop and execute hardware test plans and deliver repeatable, reliable results.
• Strong understanding of timing analysis and design for manufacturing principles.
• Ability to work independently and collaborate closely with hardware, systems, and manufacturing teams.

Pluses:
• Experience with HyperLynx or similar high-speed simulation tools.
• Expertise in power integrity and signal integrity analysis.
• Experience automating hardware tests using Python or similar scripting languages.
• Experience with board rework and prototype modifications.

job.title: Asset Operations Specialist
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting contract opportunity for a Vendor Contracts & Asset Operations Specialist. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced procurement or vendor management professional with a strong background in contract administration, data reconciliation, and vendor record management.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this or other opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: Vendor Contracts & Asset Operations Specialist
Compensation: $45-60/hr DOE
Type: Contract
Location: Remote
Eligibility: Must qualify as a U.S. Person under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) due to applicable export-control requirements.

Responsibilities
  • Review and organize historical vendor agreements, contracts, amendments, renewals, purchase records, and statements of work across multiple systems and repositories.

  • Consolidate fragmented contract documentation into accurate, searchable records, ensuring historical agreements and related documents are properly linked.

  • Review contract terms, expiration dates, renewal provisions, financial commitments, and other key details to establish reliable vendor and contract records.

  • Standardize vendor information, identify duplicate records, validate ownership, and reconcile inconsistencies across existing datasets.

  • Develop and maintain a centralized vendor and contract inventory, including associated purchasing, software, and asset information.

  • Track contractual obligations, renewal deadlines, notice periods, and outstanding follow-up items.

  • Partner with Procurement, Finance, Legal, and internal stakeholders to investigate missing documentation and resolve data discrepancies.

  • Prepare recommended vendor record corrections and updates for review and approval by appropriate stakeholders.

  • Establish documentation standards, data validation procedures, and ongoing maintenance guidelines.

  • Monitor project milestones, communicate progress, and deliver organized records and processes for transition to internal teams.

Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience in vendor management, contract administration, procurement operations, IT asset management, or data remediation.

  • Demonstrated experience organizing, reconciling, and maintaining large volumes of vendor or contract information across multiple systems.

  • Strong understanding of commercial agreements, contract amendments, statements of work, renewal terms, and purchasing documentation.

  • Advanced Excel or spreadsheet skills, including data validation, reconciliation, deduplication, and structured reporting.

  • Experience maintaining vendor master records, resolving duplicate entries, and standardizing supplier information.

  • Ability to identify discrepancies, investigate incomplete records, and coordinate with stakeholders to resolve outstanding issues.

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to independently manage deliverables against project deadlines.

  • Excellent written communication and documentation skills.

  • Experience handling confidential commercial and financial information.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience leading contract cleanup, vendor data consolidation, or master-data improvement initiatives.

  • Familiarity with procurement, contract management, ERP, or IT asset management platforms such as Coupa, Ironclad, NetSuite, Oracle, ServiceNow, or Jira.

  • Understanding of software licensing, vendor agreements, asset tracking, and renewal management.

  • Experience developing centralized vendor databases, contract inventories, or reporting frameworks.

  • Knowledge of records retention, audit readiness, and compliance-related documentation.

  • Background supporting technology, aerospace, defense, or other rapidly growing organizations.

job.title: Lead Business System Analyst | Private Credit | Allvue Platform
job.description:
TThe Role
Serve as the primary technology partner to the Private Credit business, advancing the platforms, data, integrations and workflows supporting front-office and investment-accounting capabilities, with a primary focus on Allvue.
This is a hands-on role. You will lead discovery with business and technology stakeholders, configure investment applications, analyze data using SQL, troubleshoot complex issues and work directly with developers and vendors on solutions. You will own workstreams from concept through implementation and stabilization, mentor analysts, establish delivery standards and help shape the multi-year Private Credit technology roadmap. You will collaborate with colleagues across the US and UK.
What You Will Do
Business Partnership and Solution Design
  • Act as the primary technology partner for Private Credit stakeholders and the business product manager.
  • Lead discovery through workshops, interviews and data analysis; translate business needs into requirements, process flows, data mappings, functional designs and user stories.
  • Challenge assumptions, identify requirement and control gaps, evaluate solution options and drive clear business and technology decisions.
  • Design end-to-end Private Credit workflows spanning deal and facility setup, trade execution, funding, interest and fee accruals, rate resets, paydowns, amendments, valuations, restructurings and reporting.
  • Translate Private Credit operating requirements into scalable platform configurations, integrations and data solutions.
Systems, Data and Delivery
  • Configure Allvue workflows, reference data, business rules and application behavior.
  • Use advanced SQL for data profiling, reconciliation, impact analysis, data lineage and root-cause investigation.
  • Trace data across front-office platforms, Security Master, IBOR, investment accounting and enterprise data platforms to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Understand and map relationships among sponsors, borrowers/issuers, deals, facilities/assets, trades, portfolios, positions/holdings and accounting records.
  • Validate REST APIs, JSON payloads, batch/file interfaces and data pipelines; define reconciliations, exception handling and data-quality controls.
  • Partner with engineering teams on integration design, implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Lead system, integration and user-acceptance testing with particular focus on business outcomes, accounting impact, financial calculations and data integrity.
  • Support implementation through production stabilization and ensure sustainable operational handoff.
That entity-level modeling matters in your environment. In Loan Tape process, CFO was discussed in terms of company roles such as sponsor, borrower and issuer, followed by asset creation, funding/trade activity and downstream investment-accounting integration.
Credit Data, Loan Tapes and Reporting
I would give this its own section because it is a meaningful capability rather than burying it under qualifications.
  • Design, configure and maintain Private Credit loan tapes, portfolio extracts and credit reporting datasets for operational, investor, lender and other downstream requirements.
  • Define source-to-target mappings and calculations covering borrower/issuer, facility type, commitment, funded and unfunded amounts, outstanding principal, benchmark/reference rate, spread, floor, maturity, PIK/cash-pay terms, seniority, lien, financial metrics and portfolio/holding information.
  • Build configurable templates capable of supporting different reporting requirements while maintaining consistent definitions, lineage and controls.
  • Reconcile loan-tape outputs to Allvue, investment accounting and other systems of record; investigate and resolve breaks.
  • Understand how term sheets and executed credit documentation translate into structured system attributes, transaction terms and downstream reporting.
  • Develop and maintain tear sheets or credit snapshots used for portfolio monitoring and investment review.
This separation is worthwhile because your Private_Credit_Interview_Scorecard already distinguishes a loan tape from a tear sheet: the loan tape is a structured schedule of facilities and loan attributes, while the tear sheet is a concise borrower/deal snapshot used by portfolio managers and analysts. 
Platform, Vendor and Team Leadership
  • Partner with Allvue engineering, product and support teams to troubleshoot defects and influence product enhancements.
  • Evaluate trade-offs among native configuration, custom development, integration, data solutions including Snowflake, and business-process change.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level analysts and establish standards for requirements, solution design, testing, documentation and production readiness.
  • Contribute to the Private Credit technology roadmap with an emphasis on platform simplification, automation, reduced manual processing and stronger data quality and controls.
What You Bring
Private Credit Domain
  • Strong understanding of the Private Credit lifecycle, including origination, underwriting, closing and funding, servicing, portfolio monitoring, valuation, amendments, restructurings and exits.
  • Knowledge of instruments including unitranche, first- and second-lien direct lending, syndicated loans, term loans, delayed-draw term loans, revolving facilities, mezzanine and PIK/PIK-toggle debt.
  • Strong understanding of loan economics, including floating-rate structures, benchmarks/reference rates, spreads, floors, rate resets, OID, upfront and commitment fees, amendment fees, accruals, paydowns and funded/unfunded commitments.
  • Understanding of facility type, lien position and seniority, and how these characteristics affect transaction processing, accounting and reporting.
  • Understanding of how Security Master, IBOR and investment accounting support transaction processing, positions, controls and downstream data consumption.
  • Experience translating credit agreements, term sheets and other deal documentation into structured application and reporting requirements.
Analysis and Technical
  • Proven experience leading complex requirements analysis and solution design across business, product, data and engineering stakeholders.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including complex querying, reconciliation, profiling and root-cause analysis.
  • Hands-on experience configuring investment platforms; Allvue Credit Front Office and/or Investment Accounting strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, file-based interfaces, data mappings and integration troubleshooting.
  • Experience designing data-quality controls, reconciliations and exception-management processes.
  • Agile/Scrum delivery experience, including system testing, UAT, implementation and post-production validation.
 
Qualifications
  • 7+ years of experience in business systems analysis, product technology, solution delivery or a similar role within financial services, with meaningful hands-on SQL and application configuration experience.
  • 3+ years working with private markets, leveraged finance or alternative investments, preferably Private Credit/direct lending.
Nice to Have
  • Hands-on experience with Allvue Credit Front Office and Allvue Investment Accounting.
  • Experience with Private Equity, fund-of-funds or broader alternative-investment platforms.
  • Experience with Snowflake or comparable cloud data platforms and enterprise reporting/data-consumption patterns.
  • Experience with Security Master and IBOR implementations.
  • Experience integrating front-office investment platforms with accounting, enterprise data and downstream reporting systems.

job.title: Cash Management Operations Specialist
job.description:
Cash Management Operations Specialist
12+ month contract
Tempe, AZ/Fort Mill, SC (Hybrid)
 
Position Overview
The ideal candidate has 2–3 years of financial services or related industry experience, strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and the ability to balance transaction processing with inbound and outbound client/advisor interactions.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Process incoming and outgoing domestic and international wire transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Review and enter wire instructions into internal systems and identify foreign/international wire requirements.
  • Perform required AML, OFAC, anti-fraud, and compliance reviews as part of the transaction process.
  • Conduct due diligence to protect clients from fraudulent or unauthorized transactions.
  • Contact financial advisors and other stakeholders to clarify incomplete, incorrect, or potentially problematic transaction information.
  • Educate financial advisors on client sytems, processes, documentation, signatures, and requirements to help successfully complete client transactions.
  • Research and resolve compliance or banking-related questions, including issues that may result in holds or additional review by LPL or receiving banks.
  • Handle both processing work and inbound/outbound calls while maintaining productivity and accuracy.
  • Support NIGO activities and other cash management functions as needed.
  • Cross-train and provide support across other cash operations functions, including ACH, checks, and journals, based on business needs.
  • Participate in ad hoc projects and contribute ideas for process improvements and operational efficiencies.
  • Maintain a high level of professionalism when working with financial advisors and clients, including the ability to handle sensitive or escalated situations.
 
Required Qualifications
  • 2–3 years of experience in financial services, banking, brokerage, or a related industry.
  • Experience processing domestic wires; international wire experience is strongly preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established controls and procedures.
  • Ability to manage a high volume of transactional work while also handling phone-based inquiries.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Comfortable communicating with financial advisors and clients and providing process/system education.
  • Ability to ask appropriate security and verification questions and handle occasional de-escalation situations.
  • Strong problem-solving and investigative skills.
  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with team members.
  • Flexibility to cross-train and support other cash management functions as business needs change.
  • Beta / legacy banking systems, including platforms such as Thompson or AS/400.
  • LexisNexis or similar AML, OFAC, fraud, or identity-verification systems.
  • Softphone/contact center platforms, such as NICE or CXone.
  • Microsoft Office products.
  • Cloud-based document/storage platforms.
 
Ideal Candidate Profile
The strongest candidates will bring a combination of financial services experience, wire processing knowledge, operational accuracy, and customer-service skills. Candidates who have worked in banking or brokerage environments and have experience with domestic and international wires, AML/fraud processes, legacy banking systems, and call center/softphone environments are especially well aligned.
Candidates should be comfortable working in a structured, highly regulated environment where they must balance speed, accuracy, compliance, client protection, and advisor service.

job.description:
Desktop Support Analyst
12 month contract/contract to hire
Fort Mill, SC (Onsite)
 
Looking for someone with good attitude, self-driven, can come and work independently and hit the ground running. Culture, team fit and attitude is the biggest thing for this group!
 
Job Description:
We are seeking a qualified professional Analyst II, Home Office Tech to provide IT Support to our internal employees, resolving or escalating issues in a timely and professional manner over multiple channels of communication. Secondarily, this role will support and participate in internal IT activities such as helping rollout and drive user adoption to new technologies, ensuring new hires success with IT needs when they start, and assist in building a robust knowledge base that we be leveraged as we introduce automation and AI.
 
Responsibilities:
  • Provides Tier 2 support for end-user computing devices for employees and Contingent workers in multiple offices and functions as an escalation point for Tier 1 support.
  • Responds to incidents and requests within a ticketing system, providing resolution within a complex fast-paced business environment.
  • Deploys and troubleshoots end-user computing devices including laptops, desktops, printers, MFPs, and wireless devices that are aligned with the Home Office Security Policy.
  • Reimage computers/hard drives in accordance with standards using MS Intune Autopilot. Perform Move, Add, and Change functions including installation and decommission.
  • Install, configure, and troubleshoot Windows-based operating systems, Microsoft Office and Internet browsers.
  • Install, configure, and troubleshoot MAC/Apple-based operating systems and proprietary applications.
  • Configures and supports remote users including VPN client and connectivity.
  • Provides customer training and knowledge documentation.
  • Complies with and supports ITIL change-incident-problem management processes and work instructions.
  • Troubleshoots incidents and fulfills requests within established SLAs.
  • Adheres to Desktop and End User Computing processes, procedures, policies, and job aids.
  • Provides a high touch, business-aware, personalized, world-class customer service that extends to executive and senior-level support.
  • Partner with Business Units, Active Directory (Azure), Messaging, Network, Engineering, Information Security, Service Desk and vendors.
  • Perform asset inventory activities as needed.
  • Able to work with minimal instruction on day-to-day operations and general instruction on new assignments from management.
  • Provide exceptional customer service to internal business partners by troubleshooting IT-related problems from LOB application, MS Suite and VPN for remote users, to hardware such as mobile phones, laptops, PCs and printers.
  • Maintain a high degree of customer service for all support queries and adhere to all service management principles, and standard operating procedures.
  • Drive continuous improvement by thinking out of the box for potential solutions or ideas around reducing volume to the service desk and contribute to our knowledge base by writing and submitting KB articles.
 
Required Qualifications:
  • Must be able to work 100% from a corporate office 5 days a week. Role supports onsite employees so working remotely is not an option.
  • 2+ years of Tech Support experience including supporting Windows and Mac
  • Experience with workstation setup, Citrix VDI experience, conference room support, networking, and other related duties
  • Experience in management and support of Microsoft Active Directory Domains, Azure, Intune AutoPilot, ServiceNow,Microsoft Office, Office 365, corporate networks, and mobile device technology.
  • Working knowledge of various Windows OS and hardware for PC environments, principles and terminology of networking and mobile technologies.
  • Strong communication skills and collaborative attitude are key attributes for this role.
  • An associate’s degree, Certificate, or Boot Camp in Computer Science or equivalent training/experience required.

job.title: Director of Genetics
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Director, Genetics for our clinical diagnostics laboratory client. In this leadership role, you will oversee the overall operations, strategic direction, and scientific integrity of the Genetics Department, ensuring compliance with all applicable clinical laboratory regulations and quality standards. The Director, Genetics will provide scientific and operational leadership for cytogenetics and molecular cytogenetics testing, including oncology genetics, FISH, and advanced genetic testing technologies. This position will be responsible for laboratory performance, regulatory compliance, quality assurance, staff development, and the implementation of new technologies and services. The ideal candidate will bring extensive clinical laboratory leadership experience, strong expertise in cancer cytogenetics, and the ability to drive operational excellence while supporting organizational growth.

Industry: Clinical Diagnostics / Genetics / Molecular Cytogenetics
Location: Alpharetta, GA
Compensation: 160k - 180k annual
Type: Direct Hire

Job Functions
  • Provide strategic, scientific, and operational leadership for the Genetics Department, ensuring compliance with applicable clinical laboratory regulations, accreditation standards, and organizational policies.

  • Direct and oversee daily laboratory operations, ensuring accurate, timely, and reliable genetic testing and reporting.

  • Develop and maintain an effective departmental structure to support uninterrupted laboratory operations, regulatory compliance, and scientific integrity.

  • Oversee patient report sign-out activities in collaboration with the Pathology team, ensuring accuracy and validity of test results.

  • Direct the development, implementation, and maintenance of laboratory procedures, testing methods, and Quality Control processes.

  • Assume responsibility for the review and approval of laboratory activities, including internal and external Quality Control and validation of new equipment, methods, and testing procedures.

  • Support strategic planning, business development, and implementation of new genetic testing technologies, laboratory services, and diagnostic assays.

  • Lead initiatives involving microarray testing strategies and technical-only Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization (FISH) services.

  • Provide scientific and technical expertise in cytogenetics, molecular cytogenetics, oncology genetics, and related diagnostic testing.

  • Collaborate with internal departments and external customers to address scientific, medical, laboratory, and patient-reporting inquiries.

  • Review and approve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for the Genetics Department.

  • Maintain laboratory accreditation and Quality Assurance programs in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Serve as the primary departmental representative during laboratory inspections, regulatory audits, and accreditation assessments.

  • Ensure timely investigation and implementation of corrective actions related to audit findings, laboratory deficiencies, and Quality System issues.

  • Develop and deliver scientific presentations and technical training for employees, customers, and professional meetings.

  • Provide scientific guidance and consultation on complex laboratory testing and technical issues.

  • Oversee departmental training programs and ensure personnel competency, procedural compliance, and adherence to laboratory policies.

  • Mentor, train, and develop Associate Genetics Directors and other laboratory personnel.

  • Monitor developments in clinical laboratory medicine, oncology genetics, cytogenetics, and emerging diagnostic technologies.

  • Maintain required professional licensure, certifications, and continuing education to ensure compliance with applicable standards.

  • Foster a collaborative departmental culture that promotes teamwork, knowledge sharing, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.

  • Support long-term laboratory planning, growth strategies, and organizational performance initiatives.

Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • MD or PhD in Genetics or a closely related scientific discipline required.

  • Completion of a two-year American Board of Medical Genetics (ABMG)-approved training program required.

  • Minimum of five (5) to seven (7) years of relevant clinical laboratory experience.

  • Extensive knowledge and demonstrated expertise in cytogenetics, molecular cytogenetics, and Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization (FISH).

  • Strong experience in cancer cytogenetics, including complex cancer karyotyping using microscopy and molecular approaches.

  • Experience with constitutional and prenatal cytogenetics, including Products of Conception (POC) testing.

  • Familiarity with advanced genetic and diagnostic testing technologies, including microarray testing.

  • Demonstrated experience overseeing clinical laboratory operations, Quality Control, method validation, and regulatory compliance.

  • Experience developing, reviewing, and approving laboratory SOPs, testing procedures, and Quality Assurance documentation.

  • Strong understanding of clinical laboratory accreditation requirements and applicable regulatory standards.

  • Experience supporting laboratory inspections, audits, and corrective action initiatives.

  • Demonstrated ability to provide scientific and technical leadership in a clinical diagnostics environment.

  • Experience mentoring, training, and developing scientific and laboratory personnel.

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate complex scientific and technical information to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Pathology, laboratory operations, executive leadership, and external customers.

  • Strong strategic planning and operational leadership skills with the ability to support laboratory growth and new testing initiatives.

Required Certifications

  • Certification by the American Board of Medical Genetics (ABMG) or equivalent qualifications and certifications acceptable for a CLIA laboratory director.

Preferred Certifications

  • New York State Certificate of Qualification (COQ) in Cytogenetics and Molecular Cytogenetics preferred.

  • Valid California Clinical Cytogenetics license preferred.

Physical Job Requirements
  • Clinical diagnostics laboratory and professional office environment.

  • Regular use of computers and laboratory information systems for reviewing patient reports, laboratory documentation, and scientific data.

  • May require standing, walking, or sitting for extended periods while overseeing laboratory operations and administrative responsibilities.

  • Ability to review detailed microscopic images, cytogenetic results, laboratory reports, and technical documentation.

  • May require working within clinical laboratory environments while following established safety, infection control, and regulatory procedures.

  • Must maintain compliance with laboratory safety requirements and applicable policies.

job.title: IT - Desktop Support-Level II
job.description:
Desktop Support Analyst
12 month contract/contract to hire
Austin, TX (Onsite)
 
Looking for someone with good attitude, self-driven, can come and work independently and hit the ground running. Culture, team fit and attitude is the biggest thing for this group!
 
Job Description:
We are seeking a qualified professional Analyst II, Home Office Tech to provide IT Support to our internal employees, resolving or escalating issues in a timely and professional manner over multiple channels of communication. Secondarily, this role will support and participate in internal IT activities such as helping rollout and drive user adoption to new technologies, ensuring new hires success with IT needs when they start, and assist in building a robust knowledge base that we be leveraged as we introduce automation and AI.
 
Responsibilities:
  • Provides Tier 2 support for end-user computing devices for employees and Contingent workers in multiple offices and functions as an escalation point for Tier 1 support.
  • Responds to incidents and requests within a ticketing system, providing resolution within a complex fast-paced business environment.
  • Deploys and troubleshoots end-user computing devices including laptops, desktops, printers, MFPs, and wireless devices that are aligned with the Home Office Security Policy.
  • Reimage computers/hard drives in accordance with standards using MS Intune Autopilot. Perform Move, Add, and Change functions including installation and decommission.
  • Install, configure, and troubleshoot Windows-based operating systems, Microsoft Office and Internet browsers.
  • Install, configure, and troubleshoot MAC/Apple-based operating systems and proprietary applications.
  • Configures and supports remote users including VPN client and connectivity.
  • Provides customer training and knowledge documentation.
  • Complies with and supports ITIL change-incident-problem management processes and work instructions.
  • Troubleshoots incidents and fulfills requests within established SLAs.
  • Adheres to Desktop and End User Computing processes, procedures, policies, and job aids.
  • Provides a high touch, business-aware, personalized, world-class customer service that extends to executive and senior-level support.
  • Partner with Business Units, Active Directory (Azure), Messaging, Network, Engineering, Information Security, Service Desk and vendors.
  • Perform asset inventory activities as needed.
  • Able to work with minimal instruction on day-to-day operations and general instruction on new assignments from management.
  • Provide exceptional customer service to internal business partners by troubleshooting IT-related problems from LOB application, MS Suite and VPN for remote users, to hardware such as mobile phones, laptops, PCs and printers.
  • Maintain a high degree of customer service for all support queries and adhere to all service management principles, and standard operating procedures.
  • Drive continuous improvement by thinking out of the box for potential solutions or ideas around reducing volume to the service desk and contribute to our knowledge base by writing and submitting KB articles.
 
Required Qualifications:
  • Must be able to work 100% from a corporate office 5 days a week. Role supports onsite employees so working remotely is not an option.
  • 2+ years of Tech Support experience including supporting Windows and Mac
  • Experience with workstation setup, Citrix VDI experience, conference room support, networking, and other related duties
  • Experience in management and support of Microsoft Active Directory Domains, Azure, Intune AutoPilot, ServiceNow,Microsoft Office, Office 365, corporate networks, and mobile device technology.
  • Working knowledge of various Windows OS and hardware for PC environments, principles and terminology of networking and mobile technologies.
  • Strong communication skills and collaborative attitude are key attributes for this role.
  • An associate’s degree, Certificate, or Boot Camp in Computer Science or equivalent training/experience required.

job.title: Registered Nurse/Healthcare Instructor
job.description:
Registered Nurse/Healthcare Instructor- needed for a full-time remote contract opportunity with Yoh’s client located around Saint Claire, Maryland.

Summary: Our client is seeking experienced healthcare professionals to serve as Service Delivery Healthcare Instructors.

In this role, instructor delivers Advanced Life Support (ALS), Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS), Neonatal Advanced Life Support (NALS) and in some cases Basic Life Support (BLS) courses to healthcare providers nationwide.

This position offers flexible scheduling opportunities and the ability to make a meaningful impact by preparing healthcare teams to respond effectively during emergencies. Instructors represent the client with professionalism while delivering high-quality, evidence-based education that supports improved patient outcomes and healthcare readiness.

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Deliver instructor-led ALS, BLS, PALS, and/or NALS courses in accordance with our client curriculum, policies, and quality standards.
  • Facilitate engaging educational experiences for healthcare professionals using classroom instruction, skills practice, and simulation-based learning.
  • Travel to training locations nationwide to conduct in-person courses and educational programs.
  • Prepare, set up, operate, and return training equipment and course materials in accordance with organizational standards.
  • Ensure accurate completion of course records, participant documentation, evaluations, and reporting requirements.
  • Maintain compliance with all administrative, instructional, and quality assurance requirements.
  • Represent the client professionally and uphold the organization's mission, values, and commitment to excellence.
  • Communicate effectively with Service Delivery regarding scheduling, travel logistics, equipment needs, and course delivery.
  • Maintain current knowledge of program updates, instructional methodologies, and healthcare resuscitation guidelines.
  • Participate in quality improvement and instructor development activities as required
 
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Current professional licensure or certification as one of the following:
    Nationally Registered Paramedic (NRP), Registered Nurse (RN), Certified Nurse Midwife (CNM) Certified Professional Midwife (CPM), Nurse Practitioner (NP),Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA),Respiratory Therapist (RT), Physician Assistant (PA)
  • Current certification as an ALS, PALS, and/or NALS
  • Current or recent clinical experience in emergency medical services, emergency medicine, critical care, neonatal care, pediatrics, or other relevant healthcare settings.
  • Previous experience delivering healthcare education, professional training, simulation-based learning, or clinical instruction preferred.
  • Strong presentation, facilitation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to engage adult learners and adapt instruction to a variety of healthcare audiences.
  • Ability to travel extensively and independently throughout the United States.
  • Reliable transportation and ability to manage travel logistics.
  • Proficiency with basic technology and audiovisual equipment used in healthcare education.
  • Ability to work independently and maintain professionalism.

    Physical Requirements:
  • Ability to lift, transport, and set up training equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to stand and instruct for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to demonstrate healthcare skills, including CPR and emergency response techniques.
  • Ability to travel frequently by air and ground transportation.

  • Join Yoh’s extensive talent community that will provide you with access to Yoh’s vast network of opportunities

job.description:
Client Service Associate
12+ month contract
Council Bluffs, IA (Onsite)


Job Overview:
The Client Service Associate plays a crucial role in supporting financial advisors and ensuring an exceptional client experience. This position is responsible for administrative tasks, client relationship management, and operational support within the branch office. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail oriented, and able to handle multiple responsibilities while maintaining a professional and client focused approach.

Responsibilities:
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing exceptional service and support through phone, email, and in-person interactions while addressing account inquiries and service requests.
Coordinate advisor calendars, schedule client meetings, prepare meeting materials, and manage follow-up communications to ensure a seamless client experience.

Maintain accurate client records within the CRM system and support compliance efforts by adhering to firm, FINRA, and SEC regulations while safeguarding confidential client information.
Collaborate with custodians, fund companies, and financial institutions to process transactions, resolve account issues, and monitor account accuracy.
Support overall office operations and client engagement initiatives through document preparation, mail management, event coordination, educational seminars, newsletters, social media updates, and administrative support.

What are we looking for?
We are looking for individuals with client service/administrative experience, preferably in financial services, who are comfortable supporting advisors, handling client requests, account maintenance, scheduling, and CRM documentation.

Requirements:
In-Office role M-F
Strong organizational skills with a keen attention to detail.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
Ability to learn and use CRM systems.
Strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to work both independently and with a team.
High level of professionalism, discretion, and ethical conduct.
Associate or bachelors degree, preferably in business, accounting or finance.

job.title: Amazon eCommerce Coordinator - onsite in NYC or Culver City
job.description:
Amazon eCommerce Coordinator – Music & Entertainment

*Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorship. No C2C!!


Location: New York, NY (Preferred) or Culver City, CA

Employment Type: Temporary, Full-Time

Assignment Duration: Approximately 3 months, with potential for permanent conversion

Pay Rate: $23.00–$25.00 per hour, depending on experience

Start Date: ASAP



Position Summary


An exciting opportunity is available for a detail-oriented and motivated Amazon Coordinator to support a growing e-commerce and licensed merchandise business within the music and entertainment industry!

This position will play a key role in managing day-to-day Amazon marketplace operations, supporting product launches, coordinating artist approvals, and assisting with digital merchandising and marketing initiatives.

The ideal candidate is passionate about music, highly organized, and comfortable working across multiple teams to bring artist brands and merchandise to life on Amazon.

This is an initial three-month temporary assignment with the potential to transition into a full-time, permanent position for the right candidate.




Key Responsibilities


Amazon Marketplace Operations


  • Support daily operations of the Amazon marketplace, including product launches, listing setup, updates, and maintenance.
  • Monitor inventory tracking and ensure product information remains accurate and up to date.
  • Assist with digital merchandising efforts to maintain engaging, high-quality product listings.
  • Provide administrative and sales support for the artist licensed merchandise and retail program.

Artist Submissions & Approvals

  • Coordinate artist merchandise and marketing submissions through established approval processes.
  • Organize submission materials, track feedback, and maintain accurate approval records.
  • Follow up with internal teams and external stakeholders to facilitate timely approvals.
  • Help ensure product launches and marketing initiatives remain on schedule.

Product Content & Digital Assets

  • Coordinate the upload and maintenance of product imagery, descriptions, A+ content, and other digital assets.
  • Ensure Amazon product listings accurately reflect each artist's brand and creative direction.
  • Organize and maintain product information, artwork, and supporting content.
  • Collaborate with creative teams to ensure brand consistency across marketplace listings.

Marketing & Campaign Coordination


  • Support Amazon marketing campaigns by collecting and organizing promotional materials and creative assets.
  • Track campaign deadlines, deliverables, and outstanding requests.
  • Coordinate the distribution of artist artwork and marketing materials to internal teams and external partners.
  • Maintain organized, accessible, and secure digital asset libraries and file-sharing links.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


  • Partner with creative, production, sales, buying, and marketing teams to support successful product launches.
  • Communicate marketplace needs, project updates, and timelines to relevant stakeholders.
  • Assist with troubleshooting operational challenges and coordinating solutions.
  • Help deliver a seamless customer experience across Amazon storefronts.

Qualifications

  • 1–2 years of relevant experience, preferably in e-commerce, Amazon marketplace operations, digital merchandising, retail, or a related field.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and data analysis.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities.
  • Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment.
  • Genuine interest in music, artists, merchandise, and entertainment culture.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Previous experience with Amazon Seller Central, Vendor Central, or other e-commerce marketplace platforms.
  • Familiarity with product listings, digital merchandising, and online retail operations.
  • Experience coordinating creative assets, marketing campaigns, or product launches.
  • Exposure to licensed merchandise, consumer products, or the music and entertainment industry.

job.title: Materials Coordinator / Order & Emerging Markets Specialist Services – San Francisco
job.description:
Materials Coordinator / Order & Emerging Markets Specialist Services – San Francisco
Full-Time Weekday Morning Shift
Days/Shift Hours:
Monday–Friday, 8-hour shifts
8:00 AM–5:00 PM

The Materials Coordinator will support warehouse, inventory, order fulfillment, and materials operations in a fast-paced automotive environment. The role will also provide order specialist and emerging markets specialist services, including coordinating material requests, supporting new or evolving customer and market requirements, validating part information, and ensuring orders are accurately prepared and delivered.

Scope:
• Receive, unpack, inspect, and verify merchandise and products for accuracy.
• Process receiving exceptions and resolve discrepancies as needed.
• Use handheld RF tools to receive products into the warehouse management system.
• Perform stock checks, part-number verification, cycle counts, and physical inventory support.
• Coordinate material and parts requests associated with customer orders, service activities, production, and emerging market requirements.
• Review order details, confirm product availability, and help ensure orders are complete and accurate.
• Support the setup and fulfillment of new, nonstandard, or evolving order requirements.
• Communicate with internal teams to clarify material needs, priorities, delivery requirements, and documentation.
• Consolidate loads as required, including packing, repacking, wrapping, and preparing products for shipment.
• Label parts during put-away, picking, and shipping activities.
• Pick parts for order fulfillment, shipments, scrap requests, work orders, and other material needs.
• Ensure orders and shipping materials include the appropriate documentation, including revised bills of lading, manual tags, packing slips, and delivery records.
• Fill requisitions, work orders, and material requests, and distribute materials, tools, or stock items to production workers or assembly-line personnel.
• Maintain accurate inventory records and support order tracking, reporting, and KPI documentation.

job.title: Automation Engineer
job.description:
Yoh is seeking a Laboratory Automation Engineer – NGS & Molecular Diagnostics to support a client in the South Bay Area, CA. This is a hands-on technical opportunity focused on developing, implementing, and optimizing automated laboratory workflows for cell-free DNA (cfDNA), low-input DNA, and next-generation sequencing applications.

The successful candidate will combine strong robotic liquid-handler programming skills with practical molecular biology and NGS experience. You will translate complex laboratory protocols into reliable automated methods, integrate laboratory instruments and software, troubleshoot workflow performance, and help establish scalable automation processes suitable for molecular diagnostic development.

This role is well suited for an automation specialist who can independently own projects from early method development through qualification, documentation, and transfer into routine laboratory operations. 

Department: Assay Development / Research & Development
Location: Sunnyvale, CA
Salary: $160,000-$220,000 (DOE)
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities:
 Development
  • Evaluate, configure, and implement laboratory automation platforms such as Hamilton Microlab STAR, Agilent Bravo, Beckman Coulter Biomek, or comparable liquid-handling systems.
  • Assess automation platform capabilities against assay requirements, throughput needs, workflow complexity, and future scalability.
  • Design robotic deck layouts, labware configurations, liquid classes, transfer parameters, and integrated workflows.
  • Coordinate instrument setup, commissioning, vendor support, and operational readiness.
  • Develop automation strategies that improve throughput, reproducibility, reagent utilization, and hands-on time.
Robotic Programming and Instrument Integration
  • Independently develop, debug, optimize, and maintain custom robotic methods using software such as Hamilton VENUS, Agilent VWorks, Beckman Biomek software, or equivalent programming environments.
  • Translate manual molecular biology protocols into reliable and executable automated workflows.
  • Develop custom routines for liquid transfers, reagent dispensing, magnetic-bead handling, incubation, thermal cycling, plate movement, and workflow-control logic.
  • Implement barcode-based sample identification, reagent tracking, operator alerts, error detection, and safe recovery procedures.
  • Integrate liquid handlers with supporting laboratory systems, including thermal cyclers, plate readers, barcode scanners, and laboratory information management systems.
  • Maintain version-controlled scripts, technical documentation, method specifications, and change histories.
  • Work with equipment vendors and internal technical teams to resolve complex automation, programming, and integration issues.
cfDNA and NGS Workflow Automation
  • Automate and optimize cfDNA, low-input DNA, and NGS library-preparation workflows.
  • Develop automated methods for processes such as magnetic-bead purification, DNA cleanup, end repair, adapter ligation, unique molecular identifier incorporation, amplification, target enrichment, and library normalization, as applicable.
  • Optimize liquid handling to minimize sample loss, improve transfer consistency, and control contamination and carryover.
  • Support samples with variable DNA concentrations and fragment-size distributions.
  • Work closely with assay development scientists and other technical partners to assess library quality, sequencing metrics, and overall workflow performance.
  • Investigate workflow failures and implement corrective actions that improve assay robustness, recovery, and reproducibility.
Method Development, Qualification, and Validation
  • Design and execute experiments comparing automated workflows with established manual or reference methods.
  • Establish and evaluate acceptance criteria for pipetting accuracy and precision, sample recovery, library yield, fragment-size distribution, contamination, carryover, and reproducibility.
  • Develop and execute instrument qualification, method verification, and performance-testing protocols.
  • Support analytical validation, method transfer, and process scale-up in collaboration with assay development, quality, laboratory operations, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Maintain clear records of development experiments, deviations, corrective actions, and method changes.
  • Develop and maintain automation workflows in alignment with applicable laboratory quality systems and regulatory requirements.
Troubleshooting and Operational Support
  • Perform root-cause analysis of robotic errors, liquid-handling failures, assay variability, and instrument-integration issues.
  • Optimize liquid classes, mixing parameters, aspiration and dispense settings, deck configurations, and error-handling logic.
  • Develop operating, preventive-maintenance, and troubleshooting procedures in partnership with equipment vendors.
  • Train laboratory personnel on routine operation, workflow execution, and error recovery.
  • Prepare technical documentation and provide ongoing support during transfer into routine laboratory use.
Requirments:
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in automation engineering, robotics, biomedical engineering, bioengineering, mechanical engineering, biotechnology, molecular biology, or a related discipline.
  • At least 3–5 years of hands-on experience developing and implementing laboratory automation workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience programming and debugging liquid-handling robots, preferably using Hamilton, Agilent Bravo, Beckman Coulter Biomek, or comparable platforms.
  • Proven ability to write custom automation scripts and translate laboratory protocols into automated methods.
  • Experience with NGS library preparation, molecular biology workflows, DNA purification, or related sample-preparation processes.
  • Strong understanding of liquid handling, magnetic-bead purification, reaction setup, thermal cycling, and multistep plate-based workflows.
  • Experience troubleshooting automation methods, liquid transfers, laboratory instruments, and integrated workflows.
  • Ability to independently drive automation projects from development through implementation.
  • Strong technical documentation, experimental-design, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with scientists, engineers, laboratory operations personnel, quality teams, software or LIMS partners, and equipment vendors.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience with cfDNA, circulating tumor DNA, liquid biopsy, or other low-input DNA workflows.
  • Experience with targeted sequencing panels, hybrid-capture methods, UMI-based sequencing, or other highly sensitive molecular diagnostic applications.
  • Familiarity with Illumina-compatible library-preparation chemistry and sequencing workflows.
  • Experience with automation in clinical diagnostics, regulated laboratories, assay validation, or design-control environments.
  • Programming experience with Python, SQL, APIs, or related tools used for instrument integration, data processing, and LIMS connectivity.
  • Experience with low-volume liquid handling, liquid-class optimization, automated sample tracking, and contamination control.
  • Experience integrating laboratory automation with thermal cyclers, plate readers, barcode systems, robotic plate movement, or other supporting instrumentation.

#IND-SPG

Estimated Max Rate: $220000.00

job.description:

  • Pay Rate: $32-36/hr. CAN (max hourly rate)
  • 37.5 hours a week, Monday-Friday, 3 days OnSite
  • 1-3 years of marketing experience, including relevant internships or co-op placements.
Join the Canadian marketing team at SAP Concur as a Marketing Coordinator. We're looking for a proactive, highly organized marketing professional to support digital campaigns, content localization, website updates, social media, and broader marketing initiatives- and can hit the ground running!

  • Coordinate content localization and marketing materials for the Canadian market.
  • Support the execution of marketing campaigns, ensuring projects are delivered on time and with attention to detail.

job.title: Buyer - Supply Chain Analyst MUST LIVE CLOSE TO GLOUCESTER MA
job.description:
Buyer / Supply Chain Analyst - MUST LIVE CLOSE TO Gloucester, MA
Applied Materials | 100% Onsite | 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM
Gloucester, MA
$33.45 per Hour
Yoh is partnering with Applied Materials, the world leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world, to identify a Buyer / Supply Chain Analyst for an exciting onsite opportunity in Gloucester, Massachusetts.
This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or early-career supply chain professional looking to build a long-term career with an industry-leading technology organization. You will work closely with suppliers, manufacturing teams, engineers, and program managers to ensure material availability, support production goals, and drive supply chain excellence.
Key Responsibilities
  • Ensure uninterrupted material supply to support manufacturing operations.
  • Follow up on purchase orders and supplier deliveries.
  • Partner with suppliers to manage demand and supply requirements.
  • Execute pull-ins and push-outs to align with MRP demand.
  • Resolve shipment, receiving, invoicing, and billing issues.
  • Support inventory reduction and Excess & Zero Demand (E&Z) initiatives.
  • Obtain and evaluate supplier quotations (RFQs).
  • Assist with supplier negotiations and cost management activities.
  • Drive resolution of supply-related issues with engineering, manufacturing, and program teams.
  • Maintain accurate purchasing records and adhere to standard business processes.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's Degree required.
  • 1-2 years of related experience in Supply Chain, Purchasing, Procurement, Operations, Business, Logistics, or Manufacturing.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience working with data, reports, and problem-solving activities.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
Preferred Experience
  • Purchase Order (PO) Management
  • MRP Execution
  • Supplier Management
  • Inventory Management
  • RFQs and Vendor Quotes
  • Shortage Management
  • Dispute Resolution
  • Cost Reduction Initiatives
  • Supply Chain Analytics
Why Applied Materials?
Applied Materials is one of the most respected companies in the semiconductor industry, developing the technologies that enable the world's most advanced chips and electronics. This role offers an opportunity to gain valuable experience within a global organization that values innovation, collaboration, and professional growth.
Pay & Schedule
  • Pay Rate: $33.45/hour
  • Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM
  • Location: Gloucester, MA
  • Work Arrangement: 100% Onsite
Interested candidates are encouraged to apply today.

job.title: Senior Buyer
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is seeking an experienced Senior Buyer to join our client’s team in Rancho Cordova, CA. This is an excellent opportunity for a procurement professional to leverage their sourcing expertise, negotiation skills, and independent judgment in a role focused on driving purchasing efficiency and cost savings.

In this position, you will oversee moderately complex purchasing activities for supplies, equipment, and services, while building strong supplier relationships, negotiating favorable terms, and identifying opportunities to improve procurement processes. You’ll work with a high degree of autonomy, represent Purchasing on cross-functional projects, and provide guidance and mentorship to junior buyers.


Industry: Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
Location: On-site in Rancho Cordova, CA
Pay: $51-58/hr
Type: Contract 3-6 months

WHAT YOU’LL DO:
  • Lead procurement operations and sourcing activities that improve efficiency and deliver cost savings.
  • Represent Purchasing on assigned cross-functional teams, including capital projects, Integrated Project Teams (IPTs), and software implementations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve existing purchasing policies and procedures, and recommend practical ways to increase efficiency.
  • Help develop procurement plans and recommend processes and methods for implementation.
  • Negotiate vendor contracts and service agreements to maximize cost savings, and identify new suppliers and sourcing opportunities.
  • Partner with management to review ongoing initiatives and recommend improvements where appropriate.
  • Mentor and train staff, sharing procurement knowledge and supporting junior buyers.
  • Ensure purchasing activities comply with AFC policies.
  • Lead business reviews with key suppliers as needed.
  • Support a safe, healthy, and environmentally responsible workplace by following all company SHE policies and procedures, participating in hazard identification and environmental risk reduction, and reporting incidents, nonconformities, and potential hazards to management.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
  • 9-13 years of related experience with a bachelor's degree, 7-11 years of related experience with a master's degree, or equivalent experience.

SKILLS YOU WILL BRING
  • Strong negotiation skills for vendor contracts and services.
  • Strong problem-solving skills to address purchasing challenges and identify process improvements.
  • Ability to mentor junior buyers and share practical procurement expertise.

job.title: Registered Nurse
job.description:
Registered Nurse needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh’s steel manufacturing client located in Reading, PA. This is an occupational health clinic and the responsibilities include triage of work related injuries, medical surveillance exams and drug testing, as well as RTW exams.
 
Schedule: Tues, Wed, Thurs, Fri, & Sat 11p-7a
Duration: 11/9-12/7 with possible extension or direct placement
Pay: $38-48hr, DOE
 
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Uses nursing skills to evaluate patient care needs, prioritize treatment, and maintain patient flow.
  • Conducts a nursing assessment by taking a patient history and physical assessment and by obtaining vital signs and other medical tests. Provides treatment within scope of practice as defined by state law.
  • Collaborates with Physician or other Licensed Independent Practitioner to arrange for further medical treatment, when needed.
  • Identifies equipment that needs repair and brings it to the attention of the lead clinician.
  • Performs occupational and health screening tests as defined in site contract (EKG, audiometry, spirometry, vision).
  • Conducts appropriate laboratory tests and quality control procedures.
  • Documents accurately all elements of nursing assessment, treatments, medications administered, discharge instructions provided, and follow up care arranged.
  • Evaluates health education/promotion needs of patients and provides necessary training and instruction.
  • Identifies emergency situations and provides care within legal scope of practice.
  • Administers medications and medical treatments competently as directed by a Physician or Licensed Independent Practitioner.
  • Maintains medical records using (In some health centers it may be using Electronic Medical Record software).
  • Maintains a clean and safe environment. Follows infection control procedures.
  • Maintains patient privacy and confidential patient information.
  • Participates in follow up phone calls and follow up patient visits.
  • Other duties as assigned.
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Current RN license
  • ASN or BSN
  • BLS certification upon hire
