job.title: Material Coordinator
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Materials Coordinator in Carlsbad, CA.  You will support our biopharmaceutical customer with receiving, storing, staging, and distributing raw materials, components, and finished goods in accordance with cGMP (Current Good Manufacturing Practices), SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), and safety regulations. The role supports production schedules and ensures inventory accuracy while maintaining a safe, clean, and organized warehouse environment.

Location:  Carlsbad, CA 
Shift:   M-F 8-4:30pm 
Pay: $25-$28/hr DOE 
Duration: Contract to perm 

Responsibilities
  • Support and work within the Code of Federal Regulations Title 21, Quality Management System, Standard Operation Procedures (SOP’s), Work Instructions, comply with all documentation needs, and practices.  
  • Perform timely and accurate data entry in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) for material transactions.
  • Perform receipt of incoming materials. Check materials received against specifications, vendor shipping documents and purchase orders for accuracy.
  • Accurately maintain all receiving documentation to comply with internal procedures and or SOPs.
  • Follow best practices related to the systems and process that support material inventory, purchasing, and material control. 
  • Provide recommendations and assist with implementation of improvements.
  • Work with Purchasing and  Accounts Payable to  resolve any supplier invoice issues or discrepancies.
  • Coordinate with Quality Assurance and Quality Control personnel, ensuring timely testing and release of materials.
  • Conduct cycle counts and wall-to-wall counts as needed.
  • Pick and stage materials for manufacturing and laboratory support.
  • Support accurate client billing and raw material traceability through timely processing of return to stock items.
  • Inspect stock for damage/product integrity. Maintain organization of work areas through 6S (sort, set, standardize, shine, sustain, safety).
  • Interact with Manufacturing and laboratory departments to reconcile inventory variances.
  • Perform packaging and shipping of materials and samples to customers and/or testing facilities. Monitor shipments and update of any potential delays.
  • Manage effective relationships with suppliers as well as internal and external clients.
  • Successfully adapt to changing priorities in a high operating tempo.
Qualification
  • Minimum high school diploma, or equivalent
  • Preferred minimum two (2) years’ experience in materials management. Preferred minimum one (1) year experience working in Pharmaceutical environment.
  • Ability to read, understand, and carry out Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s), Work Instructions and other Quality Process Documentation in English.
  • Knowledge of standard concepts, practices and procedures within the manufacturing and biologic environment preferred.
  • Microsoft Office experience

job.title: Microarray Print Process Engineer II
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Microarray Print  Process Engineer in Longmont, CO for a leading diagnostic company. The Process Engineer will support transfer and development of new products and processes.  You will support manufacturing, while maintaining and improving upon existing equipment as well as ensuring product quality and yield. 

Position:  Microarray Print Process Engineer II
Pay: $84,000-105,000 DOE 
Location: Longmont, CO 
Duration: FTE


Responsibilities

  • Lead efforts to provide sustaining support to operations utilizing continuous improvement principles and technical support to operations utilizing root cause analysis to implement corrective actions.

  • Enables company growth by ensuring on-time equipment milestone deliveries.

  • Recommends and implements equipment and process modifications to improve production efficiencies, manufacturing techniques and production yields for existing products.

  • Assists in developing high level capital equipment integration protocols and procedures for manufacturing. 

  • Develops and conducts statistical analysis such as Design of Experiments (DOE) and Statistical Process Control (SPC) targeting physical cause of failure for yield loss and improving quality. Active database and data management allowing for process performance assessment via GR&R, Yield Tracking and Cpk analysis.

  • Accurately documents all work products to ensure equipment qualifications and in line with and follow IQ, OQ, PQ requirements.

  • Interacts with design staff to ensure that processes and designs are compatible with existing equipment.

  • Translate design requirements into production by defining, designing and/or communicating efficient and capable process tooling.

  • Utilizing GDP, author documents including but not limited to manufacturing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and detailed work instructions.

  • Trains manufacturing staff on proper processes to follow when operating equipment, including wave-guide instrument(s).

  • Ensures that team and staff members follow safety rules and protocol.

 

Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field required; master’s degree preferred.

  • Must have experience with Biodot equipment and microarray printing
  • Five to seven (5-7) years prior experience in an R&D or production environment with proven success of process improvement and scale-up projects.
  • Experience in a regulated environment (FDA, ISO, etc.), preferred.

  • Experience in project management preferred.

  • Experience in the medical device field, specifically invitro diagnostics, preferred.

  • Licenses or certifications such as ISO, PMP, LEAN, IFMA, MPS, Six Sigma, cGMP, preferred.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate technical information to technical and non-technical staff to ensure understanding.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate in problem solving.

  • Excellent data gathering and analysis skills.

  • Excellent electro-mechanical equipment development and troubleshooting skills.

  • Knowledge of QMS, including experience with deviation, CAPA, and other quality related objectives and requirements.

  • Software use and knowledge: Windows, MS Office products, SolidWorks (or similar).

job.title: MS Dynamics AX / 365 Business Systems Analyst/Project Manager
job.description:
MS Dynamics AX / 365 Business Systems Analyst/Project Manager
Direct Hire
Addison, TX (Hybrid)

We are seeking an experienced Techno-Functional Business Systems Analyst / Project Manager to play a key role in an upcoming Microsoft Dynamics AX to Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) migration and upgrade initiative.
 
This individual will serve as a primary liaison between internal business stakeholders, IT teams, developers, and our selected implementation partner. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience supporting or leading Dynamics AX to D365 upgrade/migration projects, with the ability to evaluate, coordinate, and implement moves, adds, changes, enhancements, configurations, and customizations within the ERP environment.
This is a permanent role that will support the organization throughout the implementation lifecycle and transition into an ongoing D365 application support, administration, enhancement, and optimization role following go-live.
We are looking to bring this individual onboard prior to project kickoff so they can gain a strong understanding of our current AX environment, business processes, integrations, data, customizations, and operational requirements.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • AX to D365 Migration & Project Delivery: Serve as an internal subject matter resource throughout the Dynamics AX to D365 F&O migration, partnering with the implementation vendor, internal IT, developers, and business stakeholders from discovery through go-live and stabilization.
  • Application Moves, Adds & Changes: Own and coordinate ongoing moves, adds, changes, enhancements, and modifications across the AX/D365 application environment. Evaluate business requests, determine system impact, document requirements, define acceptance criteria, and oversee changes through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Configuration & Customization: Evaluate whether business requirements can be addressed through standard D365 configuration, workflow changes, extensions, integrations, reporting changes, or custom development. Partner with technical resources on required customizations while helping the organization minimize unnecessary customization of the D365 platform.
  • Business & Technical Requirements: Lead requirements-gathering sessions to document current-state processes and define future-state requirements. Translate business needs into detailed functional requirements, technical requirements, user stories, process flows, and system specifications.
  • Application Enhancement Management: Manage requests for new functionality and enhancements following established change-management processes. Analyze requested changes for impacts to modules, integrations, data, security roles, workflows, reporting, and other business processes.
  • Fit-Gap & Customization Analysis: Perform fit-gap analysis between the organization's existing AX functionality and D365 capabilities. Identify which legacy AX customizations should be retained, redesigned, replaced with native D365 functionality, or retired as part of the migration.
  • Project Management & Vendor Coordination: Help manage project timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, change requests, and deliverables. Act as a knowledgeable internal advocate when working with the D365 implementation partner and challenge proposed solutions when they do not align with business or technical requirements.
  • Functional Configuration: Participate in the configuration and ongoing support of applicable D365 modules such as General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Inventory Management, and Warehouse Management.
  • Technical & Integration Coordination: Work closely with developers, architects, and vendors on interfaces, integrations, APIs, data entities, workflows, reports, batch processes, and custom extensions, ensuring technical solutions align with business requirements.
  • Data Migration & Mapping: Support source-to-target mapping, legacy AX data analysis, cleansing, transformation, conversion, financial reconciliation, validation, and cutover activities.
  • Testing & Release Validation: Develop and coordinate test scenarios for SIT, UAT, regression testing, and post-deployment validation. Ensure moves, adds, changes, configurations, and customizations are properly tested before being introduced into production.
  • Security & Role Changes: Partner with IT and business leadership to manage changes to D365 security roles, duties, privileges, user access, workflows, and segregation-of-duties requirements as the organization evolves.
  • Cutover & Go-Live: Support release planning, cutover, go-live readiness, deployment validation, issue resolution, and post-production hypercare.
  • Documentation & Change Management: Maintain documentation for business processes, system configurations, customizations, workflows, integrations, application changes, test results, and operating procedures.
  • Post-Go-Live Application Ownership: Following implementation, serve as a key resource for D365 application support, production issues, moves/adds/changes, configuration changes, enhancements, customizations, upgrades, release management, and continuous improvement.
 
Qualifications
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics AX and Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.
  • Experience participating in or leading an AX to D365 upgrade, migration, or transformation project.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting application moves, adds, changes, configurations, enhancements, and customizations within Dynamics AX or D365.
  • Ability to determine when a business requirement should be solved through configuration versus customization or development.
  • Experience gathering and translating requirements between business users, developers, architects, infrastructure teams, and implementation partners.
  • Strong understanding of the ERP lifecycle, including requirements, fit-gap analysis, configuration, customization, development coordination, integrations, data migration, testing, deployment, cutover, and production support.
  • Experience coordinating SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect management, and production validation.
  • Experience with ERP data migration, mapping, reconciliation, and legacy-system conversion.
  • Strong project management skills, including management of scope, timelines, risks, issues, dependencies, change requests, and vendor deliverables.
  • D365 configuration and application administration
  • AX-to-D365 upgrade/migration projects
  • D365 extensions and customizations
  • Workflows and business processes
  • Integrations, interfaces, APIs, and data entities
  • Azure DevOps
  • Lifecycle Services (LCS)
  • Power Platform / Power Automate
  • Power BI and D365 reporting
  • SQL and data analysis
  • Security roles, duties, and privileges
  • SIT, UAT, regression testing, and release management

job.title: Lateral Flow Specialist
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Lateral Flow Specialist in Longmont, CO for a leading diagnostic company. The Process Engineer will support transfer and development of new products and processes.  You will support manufacturing, while maintaining and improving upon existing equipment as well as ensuring product quality and yield. 

Position:  Process Engineer II
Pay: $84,000-105,000 DOE 
Location: Longmont, CO 
Duration: FTE

  • We are looking for either somebody with microarray printing experience, preferably with Biodot equipment.
  • Looking also for lateral flow test manufacturing experience, preferably with reel-to-reel spraying development experience.


Responsibilities

  • Lead efforts to provide sustaining support to operations utilizing continuous improvement principles and technical support to operations utilizing root cause analysis to implement corrective actions.

  • Enables company growth by ensuring on-time equipment milestone deliveries.

  • Recommends and implements equipment and process modifications to improve production efficiencies, manufacturing techniques and production yields for existing products.

  • Assists in developing high level capital equipment integration protocols and procedures for manufacturing. 

  • Develops and conducts statistical analysis such as Design of Experiments (DOE) and Statistical Process Control (SPC) targeting physical cause of failure for yield loss and improving quality. Active database and data management allowing for process performance assessment via GR&R, Yield Tracking and Cpk analysis.

  • Accurately documents all work products to ensure equipment qualifications and in line with and follow IQ, OQ, PQ requirements.

  • Interacts with design staff to ensure that processes and designs are compatible with existing equipment.

  • Translate design requirements into production by defining, designing and/or communicating efficient and capable process tooling.

  • Utilizing GDP, author documents including but not limited to manufacturing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and detailed work instructions.

  • Trains manufacturing staff on proper processes to follow when operating equipment, including wave-guide instrument(s).

  • Ensures that team and staff members follow safety rules and protocol.
Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field required; master’s degree preferred.

  • Five to seven (5-7) years prior experience in an R&D or production environment with proven success of process improvement and scale-up projects.

  • Experience in a regulated environment (FDA, ISO, etc.), preferred.

  • Experience in project management preferred.

  • Experience in the medical device field, specifically invitro diagnostics, preferred.

  • Licenses or certifications such as ISO, PMP, LEAN, IFMA, MPS, Six Sigma, cGMP, preferred.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate technical information to technical and non-technical staff to ensure understanding.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate in problem solving.

  • Excellent data gathering and analysis skills.

  • Excellent electro-mechanical equipment development and troubleshooting skills.

  • Knowledge of QMS, including experience with deviation, CAPA, and other quality related objectives and requirements.

  • Software use and knowledge: Windows, MS Office products, SolidWorks (or similar).

Our client is seeking a DevOps Network Automation Engineer to support critical network operations, automation, observability, and incident management initiatives. This role will help ensure continued stability, visibility, and support across the network environment.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Support and automate enterprise network operations involving Palo Alto firewalls and Cisco networking technologies.
  • Develop and maintain network automation solutions using Python and related tools.
  • Monitor network health, performance, and availability using Splunk and other observability platforms.
  • Support SASE solutions and cloud-based network technologies.

  • Experience with network monitoring, observability, and incident management.
  • Experience using Splunk or a comparable monitoring and log-analysis platform.
  • Familiarity with SASE solutions and cloud technologies.
  • Understanding of software engineering principles, CI/CD, and automated operational processes.

job.title: Senior Solution Architect, Cloud, DevSecOps & Platform Engineering
job.description:
Solution Architect (AWS & Azure)
Direct Hire
Irving, TX (Hybrid)
 
Key Responsibilities
Architecture & Technical Strategy
  • Define and own the target-state architecture for cloud, infrastructure, and platform engineering environments across AWS and Azure.
  • Design scalable, resilient, and secure reference architectures for networking, storage, identity, and container/orchestration platforms.
  • Establish architecture standards, patterns, and guardrails for infrastructure-as-code, cloud landing zones, and platform services.
  • Evaluate emerging cloud, infrastructure, and platform technologies and provide recommendations to modernize the technology stack.
  • Lead architecture reviews and governance forums to ensure solutions align with enterprise standards and long-term strategy.
  • Architect and guide the evolution of CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices across the organization, leveraging tools such as Azure DevOps, Harness, and GitLab.
  • Define the architecture for embedding security into the software development lifecycle, including SAST, DAST, and vulnerability management tooling.
  • Partner with platform engineering teams to design self-service infrastructure, automation, and developer enablement capabilities.
  • Champion policy-as-code, secure configuration management, and compliance automation across cloud and platform environments.
  • Define architecture and standards for observability and monitoring using tools such as New Relic, Dynatrace, and Datadog.
  • Guide the design of monitoring, alerting, and incident response frameworks to improve reliability and reduce time to detect and resolve issues.
  • Champion site reliability engineering (SRE) principles, including SLIs/SLOs and proactive capacity and performance planning, across architecture decisions.
  • Build, lead, mentor, and develop a team of architects and engineers, fostering technical growth and career development.
  • Set team goals, manage performance, and create a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with infrastructure, security, application development, and business stakeholders to align architecture decisions with business priorities.
  • Communicate architecture strategy, trade-offs, and risk clearly to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Manage vendor relationships and evaluate third-party tools and platforms that support the architecture roadmap.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field required.
  • AWS and/or Azure architecture certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert) strongly preferred.
  • Security certifications (e.g., CISSP, Security+) and/or Kubernetes certifications a plus.
  • 8+ years of experience in cloud architecture, infrastructure, or platform engineering, including 3+ years in a people leadership or management role.
  • Deep hands-on expertise designing and implementing solutions on AWS and Azure, including compute, networking, storage, and identity services.
  • Proven experience architecting DevSecOps pipelines using Azure DevOps, Harness, and/or GitLab, including embedded SAST and DAST security scanning.
  • Strong experience with observability platforms such as New Relic, Dynatrace, and/or Datadog.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, ARM/Bicep, CloudFormation) and container/orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, and managing technical teams, including hiring, performance management, and career development.
  • Proven track record influencing enterprise architecture decisions and driving alignment across cross-functional and executive stakeholders.  
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and people management skills.
  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.
  • Deep understanding of DevSecOps principles, secure SDLC, and cloud security best practices.
  • Ability to balance strategic architecture vision with hands-on technical depth.
  • Ability to influence and drive alignment across engineering, security, and business stakeholders.
  • Business acumen in technology transformation and cloud cost management

This position will play a key role in managing day-to-day Amazon marketplace operations, supporting product launches, coordinating artist approvals, and assisting with digital merchandising and marketing initiatives.

The ideal candidate is passionate about music, highly organized, and comfortable working across multiple teams to bring artist brands and merchandise to life on Amazon.

This is an initial three-month temporary assignment with the potential to transition into a full-time, permanent position for the right candidate.




Key Responsibilities


Amazon Marketplace Operations




  • Support daily operations of the Amazon marketplace, including product launches, listing setup, updates, and maintenance.
  • Monitor inventory tracking and ensure product information remains accurate and up to date.
  • Assist with digital merchandising efforts to maintain engaging, high-quality product listings.
  • Provide administrative and sales support for the artist licensed merchandise and retail program.



Artist Submissions & Approvals




  • Coordinate artist merchandise and marketing submissions through established approval processes.
  • Organize submission materials, track feedback, and maintain accurate approval records.
  • Follow up with internal teams and external stakeholders to facilitate timely approvals.
  • Help ensure product launches and marketing initiatives remain on schedule.



Product Content & Digital Assets




  • Coordinate the upload and maintenance of product imagery, descriptions, A+ content, and other digital assets.
  • Ensure Amazon product listings accurately reflect each artist's brand and creative direction.
  • Organize and maintain product information, artwork, and supporting content.
  • Collaborate with creative teams to ensure brand consistency across marketplace listings.



Marketing & Campaign Coordination




  • Support Amazon marketing campaigns by collecting and organizing promotional materials and creative assets.
  • Track campaign deadlines, deliverables, and outstanding requests.
  • Coordinate the distribution of artist artwork and marketing materials to internal teams and external partners.
  • Maintain organized, accessible, and secure digital asset libraries and file-sharing links.



Cross-Functional Collaboration




  • Partner with creative, production, sales, buying, and marketing teams to support successful product launches.
  • Communicate marketplace needs, project updates, and timelines to relevant stakeholders.
  • Assist with troubleshooting operational challenges and coordinating solutions.
  • Help deliver a seamless customer experience across Amazon storefronts.



Qualifications


  • 1–2 years of relevant experience, preferably in e-commerce, Amazon marketplace operations, digital merchandising, retail, or a related field.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and data analysis.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities.
  • Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment.
  • Genuine interest in music, artists, merchandise, and entertainment culture.



Preferred Qualifications




  • Previous experience with Amazon Seller Central, Vendor Central, or other e-commerce marketplace platforms.
  • Familiarity with product listings, digital merchandising, and online retail operations.
  • Experience coordinating creative assets, marketing campaigns, or product launches.
  • Exposure to licensed merchandise, consumer products, or the music and entertainment industry.

job.title: Jr. Buyer
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Jr. Buyer for our beauty and personal care manufacturing client. Candidates must have prior experience within the cosmetics or beauty industry to be considered for this opportunity. In this role, you will support day-to-day purchasing and procurement activities for raw materials, packaging, supplies, and other products essential to manufacturing operations.

Working closely with the Purchasing Director, suppliers, inventory team, and internal departments, the Jr. Buyer will assist with purchase order processing, supplier communications, inventory tracking, purchasing documentation, and procurement data management. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career purchasing professional with cosmetics industry experience looking to further develop their procurement and supply chain expertise within the beauty and personal care manufacturing industry.

Industry: Beauty / Personal Care Manufacturing
Location: Carson, CA
Compensation: $60,000 - 80,000 DOE
Type: Direct Hire

Job Functions
  • Assist with creating, processing, and tracking purchase orders for materials, supplies, packaging, and other products required for company operations.
  • Maintain accurate records of open purchase orders, supplier information, pricing, and purchasing activity.
  • Communicate with suppliers regarding order status, pricing, product availability, and expected delivery dates.
  • Follow up with suppliers regarding delayed, incomplete, damaged, or incorrect shipments and assist with resolving discrepancies.
  • Support inventory tracking activities and help identify potential material shortages or excess inventory.
  • Assist with maintaining appropriate inventory levels based on production and operational requirements.
  • Enter, maintain, and update purchasing and supplier information within company systems and spreadsheets.
  • Review purchase orders, invoices, receiving documentation, and related records for accuracy and completeness.
  • Prepare basic reports related to purchasing activity, inventory, supplier performance, and expenses.
  • Collect and organize purchasing and supplier data to support cost analysis and procurement decision-making.
  • Assist with identifying potential suppliers and obtaining pricing, availability, and product information.
  • Support supplier communication and maintain positive working relationships with vendors.
  • Maintain organized and accurate purchasing files, records, and supporting documentation.
  • Collaborate with Purchasing, Inventory, and other internal departments to support timely material availability.
  • Provide general administrative and operational support to the procurement team.
  • Perform additional purchasing and procurement responsibilities as assigned by the Purchasing Director.
Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Operations, or a related field preferred; equivalent education and/or relevant experience will be considered.
  • Entry level to two (2) years of experience in purchasing, procurement, supply chain, inventory, operations, or administrative support.
  • Previous experience or demonstrated interest in the cosmetics, beauty, personal care, or manufacturing industry is a plus.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate purchasing and inventory records.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with suppliers and internal departments.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple assignments and meet established deadlines.
  • Dependable and responsible with a willingness to learn and develop within purchasing and procurement.
  • Ability to follow direction while also working independently when appropriate.
  • Strong interest in developing a career in purchasing, procurement, or supply chain management.
Physical Job Requirements
  • Full-time, in-office work environment.
  • Typical schedule is Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.
  • Regular use of a computer, keyboard, mouse, telephone, and other standard office equipment.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer.
  • May occasionally require walking to inventory, receiving, warehouse, or other operational areas to support purchasing activities.

job.title: Electrical Design Engineer (mixed/analog)
job.description:
Electrical Design Engineer (Mixed/Analog) — On-Site (Wichita, KS) Build electronics that fly. In this role, you’ll help design avionics, power electronics, and battery system interfaces used in high-performance, safety-critical aircraft applications—working across the full product lifecycle from concept and requirements through testing and certification.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and implement analog front-end circuits (amplifiers, ADC/DAC interfaces, filters) for accurate signal processing.
  • Lead mixed-signal system integration, verifying reliable data conversion, filtering, and conditioning stages.
  • Research and evaluate components, technologies, and methods for new and existing designs.
  • Build, test, and troubleshoot hardware in both office and lab environments (including soldering and hands-on bench work).
  • Validate performance against stringent requirements using lab tools (oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, logic analyzers).
  • Create high-quality engineering documentation (BOMs, ECOs, test protocols, work instructions, and component rationales).
  • Support manufacturing needs by designing/integrating tools for new products as required.
Must-Have Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • 5+ years of analog and mixed-signal design experience (precision instrumentation, signal conditioning, integrated circuit applications).
  • Proficiency with schematic capture/design & simulation tools (PADS, LTSpice, or similar) and PCB layout software.
  • Knowledge of signal integrity, impedance matching, and EMI/EMC design practices (e.g., RTCA DO-160 or MIL-STD-810/461).
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Bring your analog/mixed-signal expertise and help deliver hardware that performs when it matters most—apply today.

job.title: Weekend Shift Analytical Scientist (HPLC/UPLC)
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for an  Weekend Shift Analytical Scientist to join a combined Analytical Development and Quality Control organization supporting a GMP-regulated manufacturing environment. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in GMP analytical testing and hands-on HPLC/UPLC experience and be able to execute established analytical methods with minimal ramp-up time. The role will initially focus heavily on routine analytical, stability, and release testing, with opportunities to expand into analytical development and method generation as the individual gains experience within the organization.

Location: Bristol, PA
Pay: $30-40/hr DOE 
Shift: Fri-Sun 6A- 6P

What We're Looking For:
  • The strongest candidates will have a GMP QC/analytical testing foundation with strong HPLC/UPLC skills and the ability to begin executing established methods quickly.
  • HPLC/UPLC is a a must have!
  • Experience with every analytical technique is not required, as training will be provided.
  • Candidates who demonstrate curiosity and the ability to learn new techniques will have the opportunity to expand beyond routine testing and eventually contribute to analytical development and method generation.
Key Responsibilities
  • Perform routine analytical testing using HPLC and UPLC in a GMP-regulated laboratory environment.
  • Execute established analytical methods supporting release testing, stability studies, and manufacturing operations.
  • Perform analytical testing utilizing techniques such as AEX, SEC, and purity-based assays.
  • Accurately prepare samples, standards, buffers, and reagents in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Review and interpret analytical data while identifying and escalating atypical or unexpected results.
  • Maintain accurate and compliant laboratory documentation in accordance with GMP requirements.
  • Follow established SOPs, analytical methods, laboratory procedures, and data-integrity requirements.
  • Support laboratory investigations, troubleshooting, and resolution of analytical issues as appropriate.
  • Train on additional analytical techniques and instrumentation as required by the organization.
  • Collaborate with QC, Analytical Development, and Manufacturing teams to support a seven-day manufacturing operation.
  • Over time, contribute to analytical method development, optimization, and method generation as experience and training progress.
  • Maintain a safe, organized, and compliant laboratory environment.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant analytical laboratory experience.
  • GMP experience is required.
  • Strong hands-on experience with HPLC and/or UPLC.
  • Experience executing established analytical methods in a regulated laboratory environment.
  • Understanding of fundamental analytical chemistry principles and chromatography.
  • Ability to accurately document laboratory activities and analytical results.
  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a cross-functional team.
  • Willingness to work a flexible/rotational schedule, including potential weekend coverage, to support a seven-day manufacturing operation.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with ADC/AOC analytical testing or characterization.
  • Experience with SEC, AEX, and purity assays.
  • Experience supporting stability and release testing.
  • Experience with paper-based GMP laboratory documentation/notebooks.
  • Exposure to GC, LC-MS, or capillary electrophoresis (CE).
  • Experience with analytical method development, optimization, qualification, or validation.
  • Experience working within a combined QC and Analytical Development environment.
  • Experience supporting pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical manufacturing.

job.title: Antenna Systems Product Manager
job.description:
Antenna Systems Product Manager We’re looking for a technically experienced Antenna Systems Product Manager to lead antenna products from working prototype through commercial introduction and delivery readiness. This person will bridge RF/antenna engineering, materials science, OEM manufacturing partners, and customers to turn advanced antenna technology into reliable, manufacturable, market-ready products that meet performance, cost, and customer requirements.

Hard Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in antenna/RF hardware, RF product development, or technical product management, with a strong understanding of antenna systems and RF principles.
  • Demonstrated experience taking complex hardware from prototype through productization, validation, manufacturing transfer, and production readiness.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, customers, and OEM/contract manufacturing partners to define product requirements, specifications, configurations, schedules, costs, and technical risks.
Nice to Haves

  • Experience working with materials scientists and mechanical engineers on enclosure/packaging, materials selection, environmental durability, and how antenna systems are configured and packaged as commercial products.
  • Experience with the commercial side of hardware productization, including BOM/product costing, supplier quotes, small-batch manufacturing, MOQs, NRE/tooling costs, lead times, and negotiating manufacturing terms.
  • Experience with defense, maritime, ruggedized RF systems, or advanced communications products, particularly in customer-facing environments.
Success in This Role Successfully transition antenna technology from the laboratory into customer-deliverable products, balancing RF performance, reliability, manufacturability, cost, schedule, and customer requirements.

job.title: MANUFACTURING TECHNICIAN - AUSTIN, TEXAS
job.description:
PAY RANGE: $23.00 - $25.00 PER HOUR Why This Opportunity? Applied Materials is a global leader in semiconductor manufacturing technology. This is your opportunity to join an industry-leading company that helps build the equipment used to manufacture the world's most advanced semiconductor devices. If you enjoy working with your hands, troubleshooting equipment, and supporting cutting-edge technology, this could be the opportunity you've been looking for.

Why Applied Materials? • World-renowned semiconductor technology company.
• Strong history of converting successful contractors into permanent employees.
• Outstanding work environment focused on safety, quality, and teamwork.
• Career growth opportunities within manufacturing and engineering operations.
• Work alongside talented engineers, technicians, and manufacturing professionals.
• Gain valuable experience working on advanced semiconductor equipment used around the world.
• Opportunity to expand your skills in electrical, mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic systems.

Position Highlights Location: Austin, Texas

Contract Length: 18 Months

Pay: $23.00 - $25.00 per hour

First Shift

Second Shift: Additional 10% Shift Differential

Weekend Shift Days:  (Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and Monday): Additional 10% Shift Differential

Weekend Shift Swing:  (Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and Monday):  Additional 18% Shift Differential


What You Will Be Doing • Build, repair, test, and troubleshoot electrical, electro-mechanical, pneumatic, and vacuum assemblies.
• Utilize schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, work instructions, and verbal instructions to complete assemblies and repairs.
• Perform electro-mechanical assembly operations and equipment troubleshooting.
• Identify and correct assembly or testing errors.
• Utilize test fixtures, electronic measurement equipment, leak detectors, and vacuum pumps to validate assemblies.
• Receive parts and perform audits to ensure all required materials are available for builds and repairs.
• Inspect parts and completed work for defects and quality compliance.
• Enter production progress, labor, and work order details into computer systems.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives and troubleshoot manufacturing processes.
• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment while following all safety procedures and protocols.
• Properly utilize personal protective equipment (PPE) and cleanroom protocols when required.

What You Need to Bring • Minimum 2+ years of Manufacturing Technician, Engineering Technician, Electronics Technician, Mechanical Technician, or related experience.
• High School Diploma or Associate Degree.
• Strong mechanical aptitude and mechanical assembly experience.
• Electrical and electronic troubleshooting experience.
• Experience working in manufacturing and assembly environments.
• Ability to interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation.
• Hands-on troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

Physical & Environmental Requirements • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
• Frequent bending, kneeling, squatting, twisting, and reaching.
• Ability to climb stairs and ladders.
• Comfortable working in tight spaces.
• Ability to lift materials and equipment as required.
• Ability to distinguish between colors.
• Ability to work in industrial environments with varying noise levels.
• Experience using hand tools, power tools, and material handling equipment.
• May operate forklifts and other manufacturing equipment.

This position may require work within a cleanroom environment utilizing:

• Coveralls
• Hoods
• Booties
• Safety Glasses
• Gloves
• Respirators
• Chemical Aprons
• Face Shields

Why Work Through Yoh? • Weekly Pay
• Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
• Life & Disability Insurance
• Weekly Direct Deposit & ePayroll
• Employee Discount Programs
• Access to Yoh opportunities throughout the U.S., UK, and Canada

Many employees have started in technician and manufacturing roles and advanced into leadership and engineering support positions. If you are dependable, mechanically inclined, and looking for a chance to join one of the world's leading technology companies, I would love to speak with you about this opportunity.

job.title: Quality Control Inspector (Chemistry)
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Quality Control Inspector (Chemistry) for our medical device manufacturing client in St. Paul, MN. In this role, you will be responsible for performing quality control inspections, laboratory testing, and product acceptance activities for sterile and non-sterile medical devices. The Quality Control Inspector (Chemistry) will ensure products meet approved specifications, procedures, customer requirements, and applicable regulatory standards while supporting manufacturing, laboratory, and quality operations.

Industry: Medical Device Manufacturing
Location: St. Paul, MN

Job Functions
  • Perform incoming, in-process, final, and finished product QC inspections to verify conformance to specifications, customer requirements, and quality system requirements.
  • Perform accurate measurements and document inspection and testing results with a high level of attention to detail.
  • Ensure inspections and testing activities are completed in accordance with production schedules and established priorities.
  • Review manufacturing records, sterile processing documentation, test results, certifications, labeling, and related paperwork for compliance with specifications and quality system requirements.
  • Support Warehouse associates to ensure materials are properly handled and stored according to specifications and quality system requirements.
  • Collect, prepare, and submit samples to internal and external laboratories.
  • Prepare sterilization documentation and analyze sterilization and biological indicator results.
  • Perform UV-Vis, FTIR, and basic wet chemistry testing and analyze results against established specifications.
  • Prepare and mix chemical formulations for Production and Manufacturing use.
  • Perform environmental monitoring activities, including temperature and humidity monitoring and controlled environment testing.
  • Identify, document, segregate, and quarantine nonconforming materials to prevent unintended use.
  • Assist with investigations involving products or processes suspected of being nonconforming. 
  • Coordinate Material Review Board activities and support timely disposition of nonconforming materials.
  • Communicate with applicable stakeholders regarding materials awaiting MRB review, action, or disposition.
  • Maintain controlled access to QA Hold and Quarantine areas.
  • Inspect returned goods and ensure nonconforming materials are appropriately segregated.
  • Maintain the equipment calibration program to ensure production, test, and measurement equipment is calibrated by required due dates.
  • Verify equipment is appropriately identified with calibration status and remove equipment from service when calibration is expired or out of specification.
  • Verify preventive maintenance and equipment qualification activities are completed as required.
  • Assist with maintaining Quality Assurance work instructions in accordance with current regulations, standards, and quality system requirements.
Education
  • Licensure and/or Experience· Associate degree or higher in a STEM-related discipline required.
  • 3+ years of experience in quality control and inspection within a medical device manufacturing environment.
  • Experience preparing technical reports, analyses, and documentation using Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to interpret blueprints, technical documentation, specifications, and procedures.
  • Working knowledge of analytical chemistry.
  • Applied knowledge of quality control, inspection methodologies, and test and measurement instrumentation.
  • Experience using measurement and inspection instruments including gauges, micrometers, calipers, indicators, comparators, and microscopes.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce precise measurements, documentation, and quality records.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with auditors, suppliers, management, and cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent hand-eye coordination and visual acuity, including color vision, close vision, and the ability to identify fine details under magnification.

job.title: Shipping Associate / Order Selector
job.description:
Yoh is looking for a Shipping Associate / Order Selector to join our biotechnology client in Pleasanton, CA.

This is a hands-on warehouse role supporting order fulfillment, shipping/receiving, inventory movement, and general warehouse operations. The ideal candidate will be dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where accuracy and attendance are critical.

Candidates with experience in order picking, fulfillment, shipping/receiving, distribution, retail fulfillment, or general warehouse operations are encouraged to apply.

Industry: Biotechnology / Supply Chain
Location: Pleasanton, CA
Schedule: Monday–Friday, first shift. Typical start time is around 8:00 AM; training or operational needs may require a 7:30 AM start. Overtime may be available as needed.
Compensation: $22–$26/hour DOE
Type: 6-Month Contract

Responsibilities
  • Pick, pack, label, and stage orders accurately for internal and external customers
  • Verify items, quantities, and shipment information before orders are released
  • Receive incoming packages and materials, inspect quantities, and route items appropriately
  • Support inventory putaway, stocking, and material movement throughout the warehouse
  • Use RF scanners, handheld devices, and warehouse systems to process and track materials
  • Assist with shipping and receiving activities
  • Support inventory counts and cycle-count activities to help maintain inventory accuracy
  • Maintain organized storage and work areas
  • Follow established warehouse, safety, and quality procedures
  • Support general warehouse and material-handling needs as required
  • Work collaboratively with warehouse and operations team members to meet daily productivity goals

Requirements
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Previous experience in warehouse operations, order picking, fulfillment, shipping/receiving, material handling, or a similar environment
  • Hands-on experience picking and packing orders preferred
  • RF scanner or handheld barcode scanner experience preferred
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain order accuracy
  • Dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions and work independently when needed
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the shift
  • Ability to safely lift up to 50 lbs
  • Comfortable working in cooler or cold-room environments for periods of time as needed
  • Basic computer skills
  • Experience with warehouse management or ERP systems is a plus; Oracle experience is preferred but not required
  • Experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or regulated environments is a plus but not required
  • Willingness to work occasional overtime as business needs require

Preferred Qualifications
  • Order selector, order picker, fulfillment, or pick/pack experience
  • RF scanner experience
  • Shipping and receiving experience
  • Inventory or cycle-count experience
  • Experience working in a fast-paced distribution or fulfillment environment

job.title: Histotechnician (ASCP)
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Histotechnologist II in Austin, TX. This role will support a high-throughput diagnostic laboratory focused on thyroid FNA specimens and requires strong hands-on histology experience, microtomy skills, and the ability to work independently in a collaborative lab environment. HT/HTL certification is strongly preferred, along with 3–4+ years of histology experience. The Histology Technician II performs routine and non-routine activities involved in the preparation of slides for microscopic examination by pathologists. Core duties include sample management specific to site operations, performing staining procedures, equipment maintenance, sample capture, and/or supporting digital pathology. The role requires proficiency in all aspects of microtomy, ensuring compliance with state and national regulatory standards, and effective collaboration with laboratory teams, pre-analytical staff, and pathologists. Flexibility in scheduling and section assignments is essential to meet laboratory needs.

Title: Histotechnologist II
Location: Austin, TX
Pay Range: $41–$44/hr
Shift: Monday–Friday, 1:00 PM–9:30 PM

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Prepares microscopic slides for diagnostic purposes, including processing, embedding, microtomy, and/or mounting of paraffin-embedded samples.
  • Assists in training new personnel and may perform competency assessment.
  • Responsible for specimen reconciling, sample return, sample capture, and ensuring quality throughout the pre-analytical processes; other duties as assigned, (if performed at the specific laboratory location).
  • Performs and quality review of routine H&E staining.
  • Recut blocks as requested by the Pathologist in a manner that meets TAT and quality expectations.
  • Maintains histology equipment per laboratory Standard Operating Procedures and manufacturer recommendations.
  • Files paraffin blocks and microscope slides; pulls slides/ blocks from storage, as requested.
  • Prepares and monitors solutions and reagents for the automated stainers.
  • Participates in projects, research, and validation activities as assigned.
  • Restocks the laboratory to ensure appropriate inventory levels as maintained to meet workload.
  • Maintains equipment and quality records in a manner that meets laboratory and compliance standards; ensures records are accurate and available for audits and review.
  • Must be able to troubleshoot areas of processing, microtomy, staining and equipment.
  • Performs and documents scheduled preventative maintenance.
  • Understands and follows all safety guidelines.
  • Participates in all continuing education programs required to keep certification current, if applicable.
  • Must be able to flex schedule to accommodate workload, including weekend coverage.
  • Respects and maintains the confidentiality of information relative to clients and patients.
  • Compliant with company policies, procedures, safety requirements quality systems, and regulations.
  • May perform other assigned duties as directed by management.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE
  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s or bachelor's degree preferred
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in a histology laboratory required, including microtomy and H&E staining
  • Knowledge of CLIA, New York, CAP and OSHA regulatory requirements
  • HT(ASCP) or HTL(ASCP) certification
#IND-SPG

job.title: Senior Separation Scientist
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Sr. Separations Scientist in Bristol, PA.  The individual will serve as a technical expert in separations-based characterization and method development across process development and CMC activities. The Sr. Separations Scientist will develop and implement advanced chromatographic workflows for structural characterization, impurity analysis, linker-payload assessment, DAR determination, and comparability studies to support clinical development programs.

Position:  Sr. Separations Scientist
Duration: Contract to Perm
Pay: $40-$50/hr DOE
Shift: M-F 8-5pm


Key Responsibilities

• Lead development, optimization, and transfer of chromatographic analytical methods supporting ADCs and related bioconjugate therapeutics.

• Design and execute chromatographic studies for characterization of intact proteins/antibodies, fragment antibodies, small format proteins, peptides, linker-payloads, oligonucleotides, and conjugated species.

• Perform characterization activities including DAR analysis, aggregation, fragmentation and charge variant assessment, free payload and linker impurity analysis, and stability studies.

• Support analytical investigations related to process development, manufacturing deviations, comparability, and product quality assessments.

• Collaborate closely with process development, bioassay, formulation, and quality teams to establish analytical control strategies and critical quality attributes (CQAs).

• Develop robust sample preparation workflows for proteins, peptides, oligonucleotides, and conjugated modalities for chromatographic analyses.

• Interpret complex analytical datasets and communicate findings to cross-functional project teams and client sponsors.

Required Qualifications

• Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related discipline with 0 years of industry experience; M.S. with 2+ years or B.S. with 4+ years of relevant experience.

• Extensive hands-on experience with LCUV characterization of biologics, ADCs, or related conjugated therapeutics.

• Experience with analytical characterization techniques including RPLC/UV, SEC-UV, IEX-UV, non-reduced/reduced cIEF.

• Strong understanding of protein chemistry, conjugation technologies, and biopharmaceutical analytical development.

• Experience with data analysis software such as Waters Empower or equivalent platforms.

job.title: Philanthropy, Social Impact & Environment Coordinator - Internship Opportunity!
job.description:
Philanthropy Social Impact & Environment Coordinator - Internship Opportunity!

*Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorhsip. No C2C!!!


Location: Los Angeles, CA

Industry: Music & Entertainment

Employment Type: Temporary, Part-Time, Internship

Schedule: Approximately 30 hours per week, M-Th

Assignment Duration: January 19, 2027 – Mid April 2027

Pay Rate: $18.42/hourly



About the Opportunity


Client is seeking a passionate, creative, and detail-oriented Philanthropy & Social Impact Intern to support meaningful initiatives that drive positive change.

This is an exciting opportunity for a college student interested in philanthropy, nonprofit partnerships, social responsibility, and community engagement to gain hands-on experience within the music and entertainment industry.

Working alongside the Philanthropy & Social Impact team, this individual will help research and develop charitable initiatives, support impactful campaigns, collaborate with nonprofit partners, and contribute to projects that align with Sony Music Group's commitment to corporate giving and social impact.


About the Department


The department is dedicated to advancing humanitarian efforts, building meaningful partnerships, and expanding philanthropic programs across the company's global footprint. The team also works closely with artists, songwriters, and business partners to support charitable initiatives, raise awareness, and inspire positive change.


Key Responsibilities


Research & Social Impact Initiatives
  • Research emerging social impact opportunities, nonprofit organizations, and potential community partners.
  • Monitor news, social media, and current events related to philanthropy, social justice, civic engagement, and humanitarian issues.
  • Develop profiles and research summaries on prospective nonprofit partners.
  • Assist with evaluating charitable initiatives and identifying opportunities for meaningful engagement.
  • Support data collection, analysis, and reporting to help measure program effectiveness and impact

Communications & Content Development
  • Assist in creating engaging written content, social media posts, and campaign materials.
  • Develop stories highlighting nonprofit partners, grant recipients, and the impact of philanthropic initiatives.
  • Support content development for Heritage Month celebrations, employee engagement initiatives, and other social impact campaigns.
  • Prepare presentations, reports, and supporting materials for internal and external audiences.
Campaigns, Partnerships & Events
  • Collaborate with the team on the planning and execution of philanthropic campaigns and initiatives.
  • Participate in meetings with nonprofit organizations and external partners.
  • Attend cross-functional meetings and contribute ideas to support department projects.
  • Assist with virtual and in-person event planning, coordination, and logistics.
  • Help maintain relationships and coordinate communications with internal and external stakeholders

Administrative & Project Support
  • Maintain organized databases, project trackers, and departmental records.
  • Draft professional emails and assist with ongoing project communications.
  • Help coordinate multiple projects, deadlines, and department priorities.
  • Provide additional administrative and project support as needed

Qualifications
  • Currently enrolled in a college or university program.
  • Strong interest in philanthropy, social impact, nonprofit organizations, or corporate social responsibility.
  • Excellent research, analytical, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Interest in international development, community engagement, humanitarian initiatives, or related social issues.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Experience with or exposure to grant management systems.
  • Previous involvement in volunteer programs, nonprofit organizations, campus initiatives, or community service projects.
  • Interest in the music and entertainment industry.

Why This Opportunity?This internship offers the chance to gain valuable, real-world experience at the intersection of music, philanthropy, and social impact. The selected candidate will contribute to meaningful initiatives, collaborate with experienced professionals, and gain exposure to how a global entertainment organization supports charitable causes and community engagement.

job.title: QC Chemist (HPLC/UPLC)
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for an  QC Chemist (HPLC/UPLC) to join a combined Analytical Development and Quality Control organization supporting a GMP-regulated manufacturing environment. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in GMP analytical testing and hands-on HPLC/UPLC experience and be able to execute established analytical methods with minimal ramp-up time. The role will initially focus heavily on routine analytical, stability, and release testing, with opportunities to expand into analytical development and method generation as the individual gains experience within the organization.

Location: Bristol, PA

What We're Looking For:
  • The strongest candidates will have a GMP QC/analytical testing foundation with strong HPLC/UPLC skills and the ability to begin executing established methods quickly.
  • HPLC/UPLC is a a must have!
  • Experience with every analytical technique is not required, as training will be provided.
  • Candidates who demonstrate curiosity and the ability to learn new techniques will have the opportunity to expand beyond routine testing and eventually contribute to analytical development and method generation.
Key Responsibilities
  • Perform routine analytical testing using HPLC and UPLC in a GMP-regulated laboratory environment.
  • Execute established analytical methods supporting release testing, stability studies, and manufacturing operations.
  • Perform analytical testing utilizing techniques such as AEX, SEC, and purity-based assays.
  • Accurately prepare samples, standards, buffers, and reagents in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Review and interpret analytical data while identifying and escalating atypical or unexpected results.
  • Maintain accurate and compliant laboratory documentation in accordance with GMP requirements.
  • Follow established SOPs, analytical methods, laboratory procedures, and data-integrity requirements.
  • Support laboratory investigations, troubleshooting, and resolution of analytical issues as appropriate.
  • Train on additional analytical techniques and instrumentation as required by the organization.
  • Collaborate with QC, Analytical Development, and Manufacturing teams to support a seven-day manufacturing operation.
  • Over time, contribute to analytical method development, optimization, and method generation as experience and training progress.
  • Maintain a safe, organized, and compliant laboratory environment.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant analytical laboratory experience.
  • GMP experience is required.
  • Strong hands-on experience with HPLC and/or UPLC.
  • Experience executing established analytical methods in a regulated laboratory environment.
  • Understanding of fundamental analytical chemistry principles and chromatography.
  • Ability to accurately document laboratory activities and analytical results.
  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a cross-functional team.
  • Willingness to work a flexible/rotational schedule, including potential weekend coverage, to support a seven-day manufacturing operation.
#IND-SPG

job.title: Zscaler Analyst
job.description:
Position OverviewWe are seeking a hands-on Zscaler Operations Analyst / Engineer to support the rollout, administration, and ongoing operations of an enterprise Zscaler environment.

This individual will take ownership of the operational side of the Zscaler suite, including implementation support, day-to-day administration, troubleshooting, and break/fix activities. A key focus will be supporting the rollout of Zscaler for branch application connectivity, including App Connectors and Branch Connectors.
The ideal candidate will come from a strong network engineering or network operations background and have hands-on experience supporting Zscaler in a production environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Own day-to-day operational support of the Zscaler platform.
  • Support the rollout of Zscaler across branch locations and branch application connectivity.
  • Install, configure, administer, and troubleshoot Zscaler App Connectors and Branch Connectors.
  • Provide hands-on break/fix support for Zscaler-related connectivity and operational issues.
  • Troubleshoot application access, connectivity, routing, DNS, and network-related issues involving Zscaler.
  • Support configuration changes, platform updates, testing, and ongoing optimization of the Zscaler environment.
  • Monitor the environment and investigate issues impacting users, branch locations, applications, or network connectivity.
  • Work closely with network, infrastructure, security, and application teams to troubleshoot cross-functional issues.
  • Help establish an internal Zscaler operational knowledge base, including configurations, troubleshooting procedures, known issues, and resolutions.
  • Develop and maintain operational documentation and runbooks.
  • Serve as a subject-matter resource for ongoing Zscaler operational support.
  • Coordinate with Zscaler support and other vendors as needed to resolve complex technical issues.
  • Support the organization's broader network environment, which currently utilizes HPE/HP networking technology and is expected to transition toward Cisco Meraki.
Required Qualifications
  • Hands-on experience supporting Zscaler in a production enterprise environment.
  • Strong experience with Zscaler App Connector deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Zscaler Branch Connector or comparable branch connectivity implementations.
  • Strong network engineering or network operations background.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex network and application connectivity issues.
  • Solid understanding of:
    • TCP/IP
    • DNS
    • Routing
    • Network security
    • Firewalls
    • Application connectivity
    • SSL/TLS
    • Zero Trust networking concepts
  • Experience providing operational support and resolving production incidents.
  • Ability to independently investigate issues and drive problems through resolution.
  • Strong documentation skills with the ability to build technical procedures, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with multiple components of the Zscaler product suite.
  • Experience with Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) and/or Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA).
  • Hands-on experience with HPE/HP networking technologies.
  • Cisco Meraki experience, especially supporting enterprise or branch networking environments.
  • Experience working within a Zero Trust or SASE architecture.
  • Experience supporting large, distributed environments with multiple branch locations.
  • Previous experience helping an organization establish operational processes around a newly implemented network/security platform.

job.title: Mass Spectrometry Scientist
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Mass Spectrometry Scientist in Bristol, PA.   This individual will serve as a technical expert in mass spectrometry-based characterization and method development across process development and CMC activities.  The experienced LC-MS scientist will develop LC-MS methods for conjugate characterization activities supporting process development of antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), oligonucleotide conjugates, radioconjugates, and other complex bioconjugate modalities.

Position: Mass Spec Scientist 
Duration: contract to perm 
Pay: $40-$45/DOE
Shift:  M-F 8-5pm 

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead development, optimization, and transfer of LC-MS analytical methods supporting ADCs and related bioconjugate therapeutics.
  • Design and execute mass spectrometry studies for characterization of intact proteins/antibodies, fragment antibodies, small format proteins, peptides, linker-payloads, oligonucleotides, and conjugated species.
  • Perform characterization activities including DAR analysis, peptide mapping, PTM identification, conjugation site analysis, aggregation and fragmentation assessment, disulfide scrambling, free payload and linker impurity analysis, and stability studies.
  • Support analytical investigations related to process development, manufacturing deviations, comparability, and product quality assessments.
  • Develop robust sample preparation workflows for proteins, peptides, oligonucleotides, and conjugated modalities for LC-MS analyses.
  • Interpret complex analytical datasets and communicate findings to cross-functional project teams and client sponsors.
  • Support regulatory submissions including IND, BLA, and IMPD analytical sections.

Required Qualifications
  • Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related discipline with 0 years of industry experience; or M.S. with 2+ years of relevant experience.
  • Experience with analytical characterization techniques including intact/reduced, subunit mass analysis, and peptide mapping.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with LC-MS characterization of biologics, ADCs, or related conjugated therapeutics.
  • Hands-on experience with high-resolution mass spectrometry techniques and interpretation of complex datasets.
  • Strong understanding of protein chemistry, conjugation technologies, and biopharmaceutical analytical development.
  • Experience with data analysis software such as Waters Connect, MassLynx, or equivalent platforms

job.title: Utilization Management Nurse Coordinator
job.description:
Utilization Management Nurse Coordinator (RN or LVN) needed for a temp 6+ month, remote contract opportunity with Yoh’s managed care health plan client based out of Redding or Fairfield, CA. Anticipating to be temporary for at least 6 months with potential for temp-to-hire. Multiple openings available!

Training will be onsite (in either Fairfield or Redding) for the first 3 weeks and then will transition to fully remote. 
--> Monday-Friday 8am to 5pm with one weekend per month.

Utilize your clinical expertise to support quality, cost-effective healthcare in a fully remote managed care setting. The UM RN Nurse Coordinator reviews outpatient authorization requests, assesses medical necessity, collaborates with interdisciplinary teams, and helps ensure members receive the right care at the right time while maintaining compliance with regulatory and health plan guidelines.


Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse or Licensed Vocational Nurse license in California
  • Experience in Utilization Management, Prior Authorization, Case Management, or Managed Care
  • Familiarity with CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial health plan guidelines
  • High degree of independence, flexibility, initiative, and commitment
  • Solid critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, member-service oriented environment

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Review outpatient authorization requests using InterQual and established clinical guidelines
  • Evaluate medical necessity, appropriateness of treatment, and benefit coverage requirements
  • Analyze clinical documentation submitted by providers and facilities
  • Approve services within designated RN authority levels and refer complex cases to Medical Directors as needed
  • Communicate with providers to obtain additional clinical information required for determinations
  • Ensure compliance with CMS, NCQA, DHCS, state, federal, and health plan regulations
  • Accurately document review findings in the utilization management system
  • Meet turnaround time requirements for authorization decisions
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and audit activities
  • Collaborate with Case Management, Care Coordination, Disease Management, and Provider Relations teams

What You Need to Bring to the Table:

  • Must be able to work Monday - Friday 8:00am to 5:00pm with one weekend per month
  • At least 3-5 years of clinical nursing experience
  • Experience reviewing outpatient authorizations and medical necessity determinations.
  • Strong understanding of CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial health plan regulations.

What’s In It For You?

  • Great work-life balance with this being 100% remote and primarily Mon-Fri
  • Work at a company that focuses on mission-driven work with real community impact
  • Foot in the door at a company with strong name recognition in Bay Area healthcare
  • Competitive compensation with weekly direct deposit every Friday

KNOW A GREAT HEALTHCARE PRO LOOKING FOR WORK? REFER THEM TODAY!

*Yoh Health Care specializes in occupational/employee health and case management services. We partner with well-known companies, hospitals, and managed care companies nationwide to place top healthcare professionals. To explore our current openings, visit www.yoh.com!

job.title: Transmission Engineer
job.description:
Transmission Engineer - Transmission & Distribution

Join a dynamic team at the forefront of energy infrastructure development as a Transmission Engineer specializing in Transmission & Distribution. This vital role offers the opportunity to design and deliver cutting-edge projects across high voltage transmission lines—both underground and overhead—in regions like Minneapolis and Duluth. Be part of a collaborative environment that shapes the future of power delivery, working through all project phases from conception to construction, ensuring reliable, efficient, and innovative transmission solutions.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering or related field from an ABET-accredited program (Master’s degree preferred).
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in transmission engineering, with 5+ years preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of civil/structural engineering techniques, codes (NESC, NERC, FERC), and standards.
  • Proficiency with design software such as CAD and PLS-CADD.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to analyze, problem-solve, and apply critical thinking in complex environments.
  • Experience in preparing specifications, technical bid summaries, and reports.
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Prior consulting experience in transmission or civil engineering projects.
  • Successful completion of the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam or EIT certification.
  • Experience performing economic conductor selection, grounding calculations, and lightning performance studies.
  • Knowledge of project management and client communication.
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil or related Engineering Technology; a Master’s in Civil Engineering is a plus.
  • At least 3 years of relevant transmission engineering experience, with a preference for 5+ years.
  • Hands-on experience with project design, field inspections, and technical report compilation.
Other Requirements:

  • Ability to travel up to 10% for project site visits.
  • Valid driver’s license and willingness to work in both office and field environments.
  • Commitment to safety, quality, and timely project delivery.
Step into a transformative role where your expertise guides the development of essential energy infrastructure. Bring your skills to a team that values innovation and dedication—apply now and help shape the future of transmission systems!

Our Information Security team is seeking an exceptional Security Architect to engage in API project efforts in Cloud, On-prem and Data security architectures.
