  • Contribute to workflow optimization and process improvement using best practices and technology.
  • Provides expert guidance on service offerings and resolves complex transaction issues.
 
Required Qualification:

  • 5-10+ years of total work experience with at least 5+ years in Trade Finance domain (LC, Document Examination, Guarantees/ Standby LC) is required.  Well versed with UCP, URDG and ISP guidelines are preferred. Applicable local / regional licenses or certifications as required by the business.  Trade Certifications (example: CDCS, CSDG etc.) is added advantage.
  • A strong knowledge of Sanctions, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), and Boycott guidelines, as well as their relevance to Trade Finance, is highly desirable.
  • Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience is required. Advanced/Post graduation degree preferred.

job.title: Senior Project Manager
job.description:
Job title: Senior Project Manager
Location: Parsippany, NJ- 4 days onsite
Type: Contract- W2 only
Duration: 12 Months


Our client is seeking a strong, senior-level Project Manager to join its PMO and manage a portfolio of approximately 2–3 projects. The initial is around ancillary revenue and digital sales; the sponsor is a Senior VP
This is a true project management role. Engineering and Product teams operate in an Agile environment, but the Project Manager will not be responsible for running sprints or writing user stories. Instead, this person will own the overall budget, schedule, risks, stakeholder management, communications, dependencies, and project health.

Key Responsibilities
•    Manage 2–3 complex enterprise projects from planning through delivery.
•    Own project budgets, actuals, committed costs, forecasts, and variances.
•    Manage schedules, milestones, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
•    Create and maintain risk logs, mitigation plans, and escalation strategies.
•    Develop stakeholder and communication plans.
•    Present project status, financials, risks, and issues to senior and executive stakeholders.
•    Partner closely with dedicated Engineering and Product leaders.
•    Identify issues proactively and hold teams accountable for successful delivery.
•    Communicate difficult news regarding budget, scope, schedule, or risk in a professional and effective manner.
•    Bring strong PMBOK practices, discipline, and structure to the broader PMO.

Must-Have Qualifications
•    7+ years of project management experience within large and complex organizations.
•    Strong practical knowledge of PMBOK disciplines.
•    Deep cost management experience, including actuals, committed costs, forecasts, variances, and identifying potential overruns.
•    Strong risk management capabilities, including risk identification, logging, impact assessment, mitigation planning, ownership, and escalation.
•    Proven stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
•    Experience managing project schedules and cross-functional dependencies.
•    Experience partnering with Engineering and Product teams in Agile or hybrid environments.
•    Strong executive presence and ability to influence without direct authority.
•    Comfortable independently driving projects, not simply coordinating meetings and status updates.
•    Ability to work at least four days per week onsite in Parsippany, NJ.

Note: The client emphasized that practical application of project management disciplines is more important than simply holding a PMP certification.

Preferred Qualifications

job.title: Signal Technician / Trainer
job.description:
Join a dynamic team committed to transforming traffic management with innovative solutions! As a Traffic Signal Technician / Trainer, you’ll play a vital role in empowering our partners—distributors, agencies, and contractors—to independently install and maintain cutting-edge traffic technology across California, Arizona, and Nevada. This is your chance to make a tangible impact on public safety and traffic flow while advancing your technical expertise and leadership skills.

Overview
In this hands-on, field-centered role, you'll be the go-to expert for everything Signals —leading training sessions, troubleshooting installations, and supporting project success. Balancing on-site activities with remote collaboration, you’ll ensure our hardware and software solutions are expertly deployed and maintained, championing quality and efficiency at every step.

Key Responsibilities

  • Train and empower partners on hardware installation, system integration, and software management using tools like Download Manager and Installation Assistant.
  • Lead physical installation efforts, working directly in the field to troubleshoot, validate, and optimize deployments.
  • Support project through remote QA, ensuring installations meet standards and providing technical guidance to partners.
  • Collaborate with sales and project teams by reviewing documentation, preparing equipment, and planning installation workflows.
  • Act as the subject matter expert on traffic signal hardware, intersection cabinet architecture, and system integration.
  • Travel approximately 40% to install sites, conduct training, and troubleshoot onsite.
Must-Have Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of traffic signal/ITS field experience.
  • IMSA Level II certification (Level III a plus, or ability to obtain within a few months).
  • Deep knowledge of intersection cabinet architecture and hardware.
  • Field girt with the ability to work calmly under pressure and handle physical installations and troubleshooting.
  • Comfortable with travel and working in diverse environments.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with confidence to lead groups and technical discussions.
This opportunity offers a competitive salary of $100k, with flexibility for the right candidate. If you’re a hands-on traffic tech who thrives in dynamic environments and enjoys educating others, we want to hear from you. Apply now and be part of shaping smarter, safer roads!

job.title: Nurse Practitioner-Occupational Health
job.description:
Occupational Health Nurse Practitioner needed for a contract Job opportunity with one of Yoh’s prodigious clients located in Macungie, PA.

Hours:  Monday -Friday 12 pm-8 pm & 6:30 am-2:30 (varying schedule)

What You’ll Do:
  • Provide on-site services forty (40) hours per week.
  • Triage and treat, as appropriate, work-related and non-work-related injuries and illnesses.
  • Dispense over the counter and prescription medications in accordance with pre-established standing orders to employees with work-related and non-work-related injuries/illnesses
  • Provide on-site specimen/lab collection for employees presenting lab orders from their PCP.
  • Perform urine drug screening and breath alcohol testing in accordance with
  • Provide support and case management for both work-related and non-work-related conditions for the purpose of reducing illness and absenteeism.
  • Coordinate second opinions for employees absent due to workers’ compensation or disability
  • Assist, coordinate and plan monthly health education seminars and general wellness events.
  • Provide onsite patient education regarding illnesses/injuries, medication, treatments, stretching etc.
  • Provide referrals for employees who need the attention of a primary care physician or specialist in adherence with company protocols.
  • Work collaboratively with patients and their PCP/Specialist to facilitate early diagnosis and management of acute and chronic health problems.
  • Perform on-site physical assessments (DOT, return to work, work-related injuries)
 
Required Skills & Qualifications:
  • Successful completion of an accredited Nurse Practitioner program.
  • Current licensure and certification by the Pennsylvania Board of Nursing or Physicians.
  • National Board Certification.
  • At least 2 years of adult medicine experience.
  • Strong clinical evaluation, patient education, and case management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in Occupational Medicine, Workers’ Compensation, or DOT exams.
  • Certifications such as DOT Medical Examiner, Urine Drug Screen Collector, or Breath Alcohol Technician.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Nursing.
  • Previous experience in occupational health settings or corporate health clinics.
  • Familiarity with state and federal regulations related to workplace health.
 
Additional Requirements:
  • Certifications in DOT exams, drug screening, or alcohol testing are highly desirable.
  • Ability to work independently, demonstrate professionalism, and uphold clinical standards.

Work at a company that is committed to specializing in supporting individuals with developmental disabilities (and their families). Provide psychological assessments, behavioral consultations, and clinical support as part of a collaborative, interdisciplinary team.
 

Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Active Psychologist license in state of California
  • At least two years of experience with developmental disabilities or behavioral health
  • Strong communication, teamwork, and clinical documentation skills
  • Knowledge of the principles, methods, techniques, and materials of psychology in serving the developmentally disabled

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Evaluate cognitive and adaptive functioning, develop behavior support plans, and offer guidance to clients, families, and staff to promote independence and quality of life
  • Assist in matters related to psychology, specifically to the provision of comprehensive services to people with developmental disabilities
  • Participate as teacher/consultant to personnel involved in the development and delivery of services to people with developmental disabilities

  • Great work-life balance with flexible schedule options (Monday through Friday highly desired!)

job.title: Fleet Compliance Documentation Management
job.description:
Fleet Compliance and Materials Coordinator
The AV Compliance Fleet team is seeking a highly organized and reliable specialist to support vehicle registration, compliance documentation, materials coordination, and fleet operations in Mountain View. This six-month assignment requires work from the Mountain View office five days per week, with frequent travel to the Industry Business Center and FedEx locations.

Scope:
• Prepare and assemble vehicle registration packets and supporting documentation.
• Transport registration materials to the Industry Business Center for processing.
• Retrieve completed documents, permits, and license plates.
• Log, organize, and track all materials and registration activity.
• Package and ship completed materials to designated offices.
• Maintain accurate records, trackers, and status updates.
• Coordinate deadlines and follow-ups across fleet, compliance, and operations teams.
• Support additional documentation, materials coordination, and fleet compliance activities.
• Use Google Workspace tools, including Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and Docs.
• Safeguard all documents, permits, license plates, and related materials.
• Travel frequently between Mountain View, the Industry Business Center, and FedEx locations.

Required:
• Experience in project coordination, materials coordination, compliance, fleet operations, document control, or a related field.
• Exceptional organization, attention to detail, reliability, and trustworthiness.
• Experience managing documents, deadlines, trackers, and multiple priorities.
• Proficiency with Google Workspace.
• Strong communication and follow-up skills.
• Ability to work independently and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
• Valid driver’s license and ability to travel locally.
• Ability to work 30–40 hours per week for six months.

Pluses:
• Vehicle registration, DMV, fleet compliance, or permit experience.
• Experience with shipping, FedEx, inventory, or materials intake.
• Experience working with government agencies or external processing centers.
• Automotive, autonomous vehicle, transportation, or mobility industry experience.
• Prior senior materials coordination, operations coordination, or project support experience.

job.title: Modern Web Application Solutions Architect
job.description:
*** THIS ROLE IS NOT OPEN TO 3RD PARTY CANDIDATES ***
 
  1. Dallas, Texas 75201 - Local candidates only
  2. Hybrid - 3 days/week
  3. 6 months
  4. Architecture and deployment experience with Red Hat OpenShift.
  5. Experience with public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  6. Experience with API management, gateway technologies, enterprise identity solutions, and messaging/event-streaming technologies such as Kafka.
 
Modern Web Application Solution Architect

ROLE OVERVIEW
We are seeking an experienced Modern Web Application Solution Architect to join an Application Architecture & Reliability (AAR) team at Oncor. This role will provide architecture leadership for the design, modernization, and delivery of enterprise web applications. The architect will work across application development, security, infrastructure, DevSecOps, integration, and enterprise architecture teams to define solutions that are secure, scalable, resilient, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards. The ideal candidate has strong architecture experience across modern front-end and server-side technologies, particularly React/Next.js, Angular, Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, APIs, and containerized application platforms. Experience designing applications for Red Hat OpenShift is strongly preferred. Electric utility industry experience is beneficial but not required.
 
Solution & Application Architecture
  • Define end-to-end solution architecture for modern enterprise web applications.
  • Translate business, functional, and non-functional requirements into practical application architectures and technical designs.
  • Define application boundaries, components, services, APIs, integrations, data flows, and runtime/deployment architectures.
  • Select appropriate architectural patterns based on application requirements, enterprise standards, and delivery constraints.
  • Develop architecture artifacts including solution diagrams, component models, deployment views, integration designs, sequence diagrams, and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
  • Evaluate architectural alternatives and clearly communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, risks, and dependencies.
Modern Web Architecture
  • Provide architecture direction for applications using React, Nest.js, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  • Define patterns for client-side rendering, server-side rendering, static generation, backend-for-frontend (BFF), and other modern web approaches where appropriate.
  • Guide modular application design and appropriate use of component-based architectures, micro-frontends, microservices, and modular monolith patterns.
  • Establish patterns for state management, session management, caching, content delivery, and web performance optimization.
  • Guide teams on maintainability, reuse, dependency management, framework lifecycle, and technology currency.
API & Integration Architecture
  • Define API architecture and integration patterns using REST, GraphQL, asynchronous messaging, and event-driven approaches as appropriate.
  • Establish patterns for API versioning, error handling, security, observability, resiliency, and lifecycle management.
  • Guide integration with enterprise services, systems of record, identity platforms, data services, and external systems.
  • Ensure application designs appropriately address latency, failure handling, retry behavior, timeouts, circuit breaking, and other distributed-system concerns.
Cloud-Native, Security & Reliability
  • Design applications for containerized and cloud-native runtime environments, including Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift.
  • Guide containerization, configuration, secrets, resource management, health checks, autoscaling, ingress/routing, and deployment considerations.
  • Incorporate security throughout application architecture, including authentication, authorization, identity integration, encryption, API security, secrets management, and secure development practices.
  • Define non-functional requirements for availability, scalability, performance, resiliency, recoverability, and maintainability.
  • Design applications with appropriate fault tolerance, graceful degradation, failure isolation, and recovery patterns.
Observability & Architecture Leadership
  • Define application observability requirements covering logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, monitoring, and alerting.
  • Participate in production-readiness and architecture reviews for critical applications.
  • Lead architecture and technical design reviews throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with enterprise architects, application teams, security, DevSecOps, infrastructure, data, and integration organizations.
  • Identify reusable architecture patterns and opportunities to standardize common application capabilities.
  • Support application modernization assessments, target-state architectures, transition roadmaps, reference architectures, and technical guardrails.
Required Qualifications
  • Significant experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale applications, including experience as a Solution Architect, Application Architect, Technical Architect, or equivalent technical leader.
  • Strong understanding of modern web application architecture and software engineering practices.
  • Strong knowledge of modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems and experience with React/Next.js and/or Angular.
  • Strong understanding of Node.js application and API architectures.
  • Experience with REST APIs, distributed systems, integration patterns, and service-oriented or microservices architectures.
  • Experience designing applications for containerized environments using Docker, Kubernetes, or comparable technologies.
  • Strong understanding of application security, identity, authentication, authorization, CI/CD, and modern software delivery practices.
  • Experience designing for availability, scalability, performance, resiliency, and observability.
  • Ability to work across multiple technical organizations and communicate effectively with engineering teams, architects, technology leaders, and business stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Architecture and deployment experience with Red Hat OpenShift.
  • Experience with public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience with API management, gateway technologies, enterprise identity solutions, and messaging/event-streaming technologies such as Kafka.
  • Knowledge of service mesh, distributed tracing, and cloud-native observability technologies.
  • Experience with DevSecOps and automated software delivery practices.
  • Experience modernizing legacy applications into modern web and cloud-native architectures.
  • Experience in large, complex, highly regulated, utility, energy, or critical-infrastructure environments; utility experience is not required.
Desired Characteristics
  • Strong architectural judgment and ability to balance strategic direction with pragmatic delivery.
  • Comfortable moving between high-level architecture and detailed technical discussions.
  • Able to challenge designs constructively and explain the reasoning behind architecture decisions.
  • Effective at influencing technical outcomes across organizational boundaries without requiring direct authority.

job.title: Licensed Mental Health Clinician
job.description:
Yoh is seeking a Licensed Mental Health Clinician for a contract assignment with a respected client located in Newark, NJ. The Clinician will deliver comprehensive behavioral health services to students, including intake assessments, individual and group therapy, crisis response services, and evaluations to assess mental health risks and support student well-being.

**NJ Applicable Licenses: LPC, LCSW, LMFT, or Licensed Psychologist

Schedule: Monday-Friday 8am-4:30pm
Duration: 3 month contract with possible extension or direct placement
Pay: $40-62/hr DOE

job.title: R&D Technician FIB-SEM (ONSITE)
job.description:
R&D Technician FIB-SEM (ONSITE) needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh Staffing’s client working in Wilmington, DE.
  • Pay Rate: $28-31/hr
  • Shift: M-F 4:00 pm - 12:30 am (some flexibility may be available in daily start/finish times). Will be trained during daytime hours (~8:30 am - 5 pm) for the first three months.
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Operation of a focused-ion beam scanning electron microscope (FIB-SEM) in support of the Leveraged Analytical Sciences group.
  • The candidate will work under the direction of experienced scientists to provide analytical support for Research and Development (R&D), Technical Service and Development (TS&D), and Manufacturing.
  • Prepare samples for analysis, following established procedures using equipment such as mechanical polishers, plasma or sputter coaters, and FIB-SEM cross-section milling and lift-out procedures.
  • Perform FIB-SEM analyses including imaging, energy-dispersive x-ray spectroscopy (EDS), and electron backscattered diffraction (EBSD), and assess basic data quality.
  • Review and organize collected data for reporting to customers.
  • Perform routine instrument maintenance, following established procedures.
  • Dispose of laboratory waste according to established protocols.
  • Adhere to all safety protocols.

Required:
  • 1+ years of experience performing FIB-SEM analyses and x-ray spectroscopy in an R&D environment
What’s In It For You?
  • This is a unique opportunity to support our client; one of the area’s largest chemical manufacturing companies. Medical benefits and 401K are available.

job.title: Family Nurse Practitioner
job.description:
Nurse Practitioner needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh’s Primary Care located in Windsor, WI. This clinic provides care to patients ages 2+. Clinical knowledge and experience in primary care, acute care, and occupational health are expected with an ability to provide comprehensive, patient-centered care across a variety of healthcare needs. Strong communication, teamwork, and clinical decision-making skills as well as exceptional customer service is a top priority, with an emphasis on creating a welcoming, respectful, and positive patient experience.
 
Schedule: Mon, Tues 6:30a-4:30p, Wed, Thurs 11a-7p, Fri 8a-12p
Duration: 1/4/27-5/5/27 with training in mid December (PTO coverage)
Pay: $55-70/hr DOE
 
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Performs physical examinations and preventive health measures within prescribed guidelines and instructions of Physician.
  • Orders, interprets, and evaluates diagnostic tests to identify and assess patients’ clinical problems and health care needs.
  • Records physical findings, and formulates plan and prognosis, based on patient’s condition. Provides written home-going instructions.
  • Collaborates with Physician and other health professionals to prepare comprehensive patient care plan as necessary.
  • Prescribes or recommends medications or other forms of treatment such as physical therapy, inhalation therapy, or related therapeutic procedures.
  • Refers patients to Physician for consultation or to specialized health resources for treatment.
  • Maintains medical records using (In some health centers it may be using Electronic Medical Record software).
  • Educates and coaches nursing staff on best nursing practices.
  • May require other duties as assigned.
 
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • All nurse practitioner licenses/certificates to practice
  • Current national certification (ANCC or AANP required)
  • Master Degree in Science of Nursing (if Master Degree in Science certificate does not state Nursing on it then a copy of transcripts is required)
  • BLS certification
  • Some experience in urgent care, primary care, emergency, occupational health or related is required

job.title: Assembler
job.description:
Assembler

Join a dynamic team dedicated to precision and excellence as an Assembler, where your skills contribute directly to the safety and reliability of aircraft instruments used worldwide. In this role, you’ll work on the assembly and final testing of innovative avionics and aircraft components, ensuring each product meets the highest standards of quality and performance. Your meticulous attention to detail and mechanical aptitude will play a vital part in keeping pilots and passengers safely flying.

Required Skills:

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Minimum of two years’ electronics education, training, or equivalent experience
  • At least one year of hands-on assembly experience with avionic equipment such as pressure gauges, batteries, and inverters
  • Proficiency with hand tools and electronic testing equipment
  • Solid understanding of advanced analog and digital electronics
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and results-driven mindset
  • Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and prioritization skills
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication abilities
Nice to Have Skills:

  • PCB soldering proficiency (training available if needed)
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • High school diploma or GED, supplemented by at least two years of electronics training or equivalent work experience
  • One or more years specifically in avionic assembly
Other Requirements:

  • Ability to perform repetitive tasks with high precision
  • Good eye-hand coordination and dexterity
  • Physical ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs occasionally
  • Comfort with handling small objects and using fine tools like screwdrivers, tweezers, and wire cutters
If you’re passionate about contributing to high-quality aerospace manufacturing and thrive in a detail-oriented environment, we want to hear from you! Take the next step in your career—apply today and help keep the world flying safe!

job.title: Nurse Practitioner/Physicians Assistant -Occupational Health
job.description:
Part-time Nurse Practitioner/Physician Assistant-Occupational Health (1st shift) needed for an opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Brookville, OH.

Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Nurse Practitioner/Physician Assistant
  • Occupational Health/Employee Health/Urgent Care/Emergency Medicine

Hours: 24 hours/week-flexible-6am-2:30 pm

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Performs emergency care for occupational and non-occupational injuries and illnesses for employees.
  • Renders on site medical care for non-emergency occupational injuries and illnesses, including assessment, diagnosis, and appropriate treatment
  • Performs assessments and dispositions for employee Surveillance Physicals, taking into consideration the pre-physical test results.
  • Recommends patient specific over the counter and prescription medications and treatments for administration and distribution by nurses.
  • Prepares concise and timely documentation of all patient medical assessment and treatments in the corporate electronic medical recordkeeping system.
  • Provides accurate and consistent OSHA Recordkeeping (OSHA 300 Log & 301’s).
  • Job-site evaluations for ergonomic assessments.
  • Perform Fitness for Duty evaluations.
  • Evaluates, validates, and tracks restrictions.
  • Serves as a resource for ADAPT job placement in the absence of plant physician.
  • Works with the Emergency Response Team.
  • Supports wellness initiatives – Health Education and counseling, disease prevention, health promotion.
  • Assigned medical services will be under the supervision and within the scope of practice of the plant Medical Director.
  • Completes other assignments as requested and assigned.
  • May have access to personal health information (“PHI”) necessary to fulfill the above duties and responsibilities.
  • Access to use and ability to disclose PHI is further defined by each organization/department.
 
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Advanced Degree from an Accredited Physician Assistant Program of Study. Active and unrestricted Physician Assistant license in the appropriate state.
  • Valid DEA certification.
  • Current CPR certification.
  • Minimum two (2) years of experience as a Physician Assistant in an occupational health environment or related field.
  • Knowledgeable of State and Federal OSHA rules and regulations.
  • Demonstrates effective oral and communication skills.
  • Adept with basic computer systems and documentation.
  • Able to work flexible hours, if necessary, to meet the customers’ requirements.
 
Physical Effort:
  • Work is performed in various health care settings and not limited to clinics, schools, hospitals, nursing homes, doctor’s offices or occupational settings.
  • Work environment involves occasional exposure to communicable diseases, blood borne pathogens and/or potentially infectious or hazardous materials and situations that require following extensive safety precautions and may include the use of protective equipment (e.g. face masks, goggles, latex or non latex gloves).
  • Work environment may involve occasional exposure to potential electrical shock, and to x-ray/electromagnetic energy.
  • Able to spend varying amounts of time sitting, standing, and walking. Able to frequently bend, stoop, squat, kneel and reach freely.
  • Sufficient endurance to perform the required physical and mental tasks over extended periods of time.
  • Requires normal, correctable vision and hearing and the ability to identify and distinguish colors. Requires excellent hand-eye coordination and fine motor function necessary to operate equipment safely and calculate/prepare medications and other procedures.
  • Able to successfully work in areas that are confined and/or crowded. Medium physical activity may require frequent lifting, carrying, pushing, or pulling up to 50 lbs.

  • Weekends and holidays off
  • Join Yoh’s extensive talent community that will provide you with access to Yoh’s vast network of opportunities.

job.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
job.description:
Senior DevOps Engineer
12 month contract (W2 ONLY, NO C-C)
Plano, TX (Hybrid – Local candidates only)
 
Position Overview
This role will focus on CI/CD enablement, site reliability engineering, observability, incident management, and operational readiness for critical technology platforms.
The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with Jenkins and CI/CD pipelines, along with a solid understanding of production operations, monitoring, incident response, and software development practices.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Design, enhance, and support CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and related DevOps tools.
  • Improve deployment automation, release processes, and engineering workflows.
  • Support site reliability engineering initiatives focused on system availability, performance, and resilience.
  • Develop and maintain observability solutions, including monitoring, logging, alerting, and dashboards.
  • Help ensure applications and platforms are prepared for on-call support and production operations.
  • Participate in incident management, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and service restoration.
  • Support the Technology Operations Center (TOC) during production incidents and operational events.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, infrastructure teams, and other technology partners.
  • Contribute to automation and process improvements that increase operational efficiency.
  • Use software engineering principles to troubleshoot issues and improve tools and platforms.
  • Work within an IDE and demonstrate familiarity with modern software development workflows.
  • Document procedures, technical solutions, operational standards, and lessons learned.
 
Required Qualifications
  • Strong experience building and supporting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with Jenkins.
  • Experience with SRE practices and production reliability.
  • Experience with observability tools, monitoring, logging, alerting, and performance analysis.
  • Experience supporting on-call readiness and production operations.
  • Experience with incident management and troubleshooting in enterprise environments.
  • Some programming or scripting experience.
  • Familiarity with software development tools and integrated development environments (IDEs).
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
 
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting large-scale financial services or enterprise technology environments.
  • Experience with Technology Operations Centers or similar production support organizations.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation, cloud platforms, or containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with release management, change management, and production-readiness reviews.
  • Experience participating in post-incident reviews and implementing corrective actions.

job.title: Multi Family AHP Analyst
job.description:
Are you an affordable housing professional with experience in LIHTC and multifamily real estate? We are seeking an experienced Multi-Family AHP Analyst for a long-term hybrid contract opportunity in Irving, TX. This role offers the chance to apply your financial analysis, affordable housing, and compliance expertise while supporting the evaluation, funding, and ongoing monitoring of multifamily affordable housing projects.

For immediate consideration send resumes to:
Melissa W. Werner, Principal Recruiter, Yoh Staffing, melissa.werner@yoh.com

BASIC PURPOSE
Responsibilities include the evaluation, underwriting, selection and compliance of Affordable Housing Program (AHP) applications; technical assistance to member institutions and community organizations concerning the Affordable Housing Program as well as the Community Investment Program; review, analyze and process requests for grant funds from member institutions and community organizations and assist in preparation of departmental marketing materials. Ensure compliance of AHP projects to the program rules and regulations. Hi

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Analyze AHP Rental and Owner-Occupied disbursement requests to ensure all required documentation is in compliance with AHP regulations and departmental policies and procedures. Make approval/denial recommendations for funding to AHP General Fund Manager.
  • Participates in the analysis, review, and selection of Affordable General Fund Housing program applications. 
  • Provide technical assistance to member institutions, non-profit organizations and community/government leaders on the features and uses of the Affordable Housing Program.
  • Interacts with other analysts on complex issues regarding applications, modifications, fundings and monitoring.
  • Analyze complex multi-family rental project disbursements to ensure project is viable for funding, as assigned. 
  • Review and approve HELP, SNAP and AHP owner-occupied disbursements request when designated.
  • Perform the compliance review of AHP rental projects to ensure that AHP compliance requirements are being met. (Income targeting and rent compliance)
  • Provide the management team with updates and status reports on project completion/modification, as assigned. Make recommendations concerning the continued viability of said projects.
  • Analyze and review project status reports and other information to ensure that projects are in compliance with AHP regulations and departmental policies. 
  • Up to 10% travel required to participate in various speaking engagements and promotional appearances (local, state-wide, regional, or national).
  • Develop a working knowledge of the Bank's other products and services, especially those offered by the Community Investment Department.
  • Develop and maintain knowledge of local, state, and national programs that are involved in financing affordable housing development; provide assistance and update policies and procedures to ensure effective administration of the Affordable Housing Program.
  • Perform user acceptance and validation testing and maintenance of internal systems and applications.  Ensure implementation is in compliance with department internal controls, policies and procedures, FHFA regulations and Bank policy.
  • Participate in the planning and organizing of the AHP workshops and webinars.
  • Perform regular and ad hoc activities in support of the operational needs of the department. 
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  •  
JOB  REQUIREMENTS:
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Economics, Real Estate, Public Policy, Urban Planning. A master’s in public administration preferred.
  • 4-6 years financial analysis and credit underwriting experience associated with commercial real estate/multi-family properties, housing development, commercial finance or other demonstrated affordable housing experience. 
  • Completion of major corporate bank credit training or equivalent experience preferred.
  • Excellent presentation, interpersonal, oral and written communication skills.
  • Advanced experience with PowerPoint, Excel, Adobe Acrobat and Word.
  • Ability and flexibility to travel and/or make presentations at Bank and industry functions, workshop, conferences, etc.
  • Grow America (fka the National Development Council) or other comparable professional housing certification preferred.

•

job.title: Nurse Practitioner or PA-C – Occupational Health
job.description:
Occupational Health Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant needed for a temp contract opportunity with Yoh’s manufacturing client located in Rothschild, WI. Flexible scheduling for 1 to 5 days a week!
The clinic offers occupational and preventative care for employees. You will be the only provider onsite, working alongside an Athletic Trainer. The position is focused on the protection of individuals from occupational and environmental hazards, illness and injury prevention, and health promotion. Job is anticipating to be temporary for about three months, with possibility for extension.
--> SHIFTS: Open availability for one to five days a week, between Monday and Friday. Preferred hours are 8:00am to 4:30pm, but can be flexible.

Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Active/unrestricted Nurse Practitioner (ANP/FNP) or Physician Assistant (PA-C) license in state of Wisconsin
  • Minimum of (3) years' experience at a provider level
  • Previous experience in: Occupational/Employee Health, Emergency Medicine, Urgent Care, Corrections, Primary Care, Internal Medicine, Orthopedics, Family Practice, or Critical Care type setting
  • Must be confident with drawing blood

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Assessment, triage, treatment, and education for employee health concerns
  • Medical surveillance: hearing conservation (audiometry exams), spirometry, drug testing, phlebotomy, etc.
  • Perform onsite physical assessments (pre-placement, return-to-work, fitness-for-duty) and coordinate treatment planning
  • Ambulatory care such as treating sore throats, ear aches, rashes, pink eye, etc.
  • Provide onsite testing for strep pharyngitis, UTI, influenza, hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia
  • Work collaboratively to recognize environmental hazards and/or stresses in or from the workplace that may cause sickness, impaired health, or discomfort among the workers; create preventative measures that ensure the health and safety of employees
  • Provide support and case management for both work-related and non-work-related conditions for the purposes of reducing illness and absenteeism
  • Provide proactive and mobile engagement with the workforce from a prevention standpoint; seek out interactions with employees and build relationships
  • Respond to medical emergencies onsite and provide emergency medical care as-needed

What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Nationally Certified (ANCC or AANP) or NCCP
  • Current BLS
  • Trained in spirometry (NIOSH Certified)
  • Audiometry testing certified (CAOHC/COHC)
  • Certified Drug Test Collector/Certified DOT Specimen Collector
  • Computer skills with previous experience using EMR and MS Office products
  • Interpersonal skills necessary to interview, teach and counsel patients and interact with multidisciplinary team members (EHS, HR, Medical Director)
  • Must be able to meet the physical demands of onsite work needs; ability to lift, push or pull up to 50 pounds, frequent standing, walking, sitting, squatting

What’s In It For You?
  • Grow your expertise in occupational medicine, injury prevention, ergonomics, and workplace wellness
  • Quality-focused clinical environment with dedicated time to educate, coach, and support patients
  • Great work-life balance with no nights, holidays, or weekends
  • Unique, interesting, and rewarding work environment getting to make a real impact on both individual well-being and workplace culture. You're not just treating illness - you're preventing it, promoting healthier work environments, and helping employees stay safe!
  • Weekly direct deposit every Friday!


KNOW A GREAT HEALTHCARE PRO LOOKING FOR WORK? REFER THEM TODAY!

*Yoh Healthcare specializes in occupational/employee health and we place healthcare professionals on jobs nationwide with well-known Fortune 500 companies. Feel free to reach out to hear about the latest Medical Assistant, Nurse, Nurse Practitioner, and Physician Assistant openings!


Recruiter: Leah Tesfai
Phone: 510.418.9406

Materials Coordinator - SF: Monday - Friday. 2PM-10PM.

Scope:
• Handle the following – Receive, unpack, check & verify merchandise/product ensuring accuracy.
• As needed take receiving exceptions.

• Pick parts for order fulfillment, shipments, scrap requests, etc.

  • Performs physical examinations and preventive health measures within prescribed guidelines and instructions of Physician.
  • Orders, interprets, and evaluates diagnostic tests to identify and assess patients’ clinical problems and health care needs.

job.title: Equipment Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring an Equipment Maintenance Technician for our biopharmaceutical customer in the Greater Philadelphia Region.  You will be a critical member responsible for performing preventative maintenance, corrective maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and installation of GMP manufacturing equipment, laboratory equipment, facility systems, and supporting utilities. This hands-on role ensures equipment reliability, regulatory compliance, and operational readiness to support clinical and commercial manufacturing operations.

Location: Bristol, PA 
Pay: $80-105k DOE
Duration: FTE
Shift: M-F days with some weekend availability as needed
 

Responsibilities:
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical, mechanical, instrumentation, and control systems line diagrams and prints 
  • Familiarity with servicing of equipment consisting of boilers, chillers, air compressors, deionized water generation, HVAC, piping distribution systems, generators, GMP suite maintenance, and building maintenance/upkeep 
  • Support the daily Facilities and Engineering work flow through escorting and supervising contractors/vendors, performing equipment moves, handling equipment deliveries, transferring equipment/materials between offsite storage, and other tasks as assigned 
  • Perform corrective maintenance and emergency repairs to minimize equipment downtime. 
  • Follow Good Documentation Practices (GDP) and cGMP requirements when documenting maintenance activities. 
  • Support equipment purchases such as uncrating, moving, installing, and connecting required plant utilities to the point of use 
  • Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and process equipment failures. 
  • Work may include systems repairs/modifications encompassing HVAC, VFD’s, piping/plumbing, lighting, flooring, drywall, grounds, painting, and other areas that are not noted 
  • Ensure all maintenance activities are performed safely and in accordance with OSHA, environmental, and company safety requirements. 
  • Support shutdown activities, equipment relocations, facility projects, and capital improvement initiatives. 
  • Participate in the on-call rotation to support manufacturing and facility operations outside normal business hours. 
  • Maintain F&E owned areas and ability to perform work in accordance with site expectations and pharmaceutical industry standards 

Qualifications:
  • 1-3 years minimum experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, research, or equivalent highly regulated environment. 
  • Supported maintenance activities within utility areas, labs, and classified cleanrooms with following gowning procedures and safety protocols 
  • Supporting electrical/mechanical/facility installation projects 
  • Experience with BMS/EMS systems 
  • Experience using CMMS systems such as Blue Mountain, Maximo, Qualer, or equivalent 
  • Strong electrical and mechanical capabilities/aptitude 
  • Work collaboratively and productively across multiple site departments 
  • Associate degree in Mechanical Technology, Electrical technology, Mechatronics, or related technical discipline

job.title: Senior Azure Data Engineer
job.description:
Senior Azure Data Engineer (Azure Databricks)
Direct Hire
Plano, TX (Hybrid)
 
Overview
We’re partnering with a confidential, enterprise-scale organization to hire a Senior Azure Data Engineer with deep expertise in Azure Databricks to help design, build, and optimize a modern lakehouse data platform. You’ll develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, implement Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) patterns, and enable advanced analytics in a high-volume environment. This role collaborates closely with data architects, data scientists, business stakeholders, and cloud/infrastructure teams to deliver secure, reliable, high-performance data solutions.
What You’ll Do
  • Design and build scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks (PySpark, Spark SQL).
  • Develop ingestion workflows from multiple source systems (e.g., Event Hub, APIs, Azure SQL, Blob Storage) into Bronze/Silver/Gold layers.
  • Implement best practices for Delta Lake and Unity Catalog (schema evolution, versioning, governance).
  • Optimize pipeline performance and cost through partitioning, caching, clustering, and Spark tuning.
  • Integrate Databricks with ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Synapse, Event Hub, Key Vault, and Azure DevOps.
  • Implement secure access controls using managed identities, RBAC, and data protection practices (e.g., masking).
  • Partner with analytics and business teams to deliver trusted datasets, metrics, and KPIs.
  • Provide technical leadership through mentoring, code reviews, and architectural guidance.
  • Work with enterprise architecture and security teams to align with data privacy/security policies.
  • Implement data quality checks, alerting, and lineage tracking using tools such as Great Expectations, Unity Catalog, and data observability platforms.
  • Build monitoring dashboards, alerts, and recovery mechanisms for critical pipelines.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of data engineering experience, including 3+ years with Azure Databricks / Apache Spark (PySpark).
  • Strong experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks notebooks, and SQL-based warehousing patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with ADLS Gen2, Event Hub, ADF, Key Vault, Synapse.
  • Strong coding skills in Python and SQL; familiarity with Scala is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling (OLTP/OLAP), star/snowflake schemas, and performance tuning.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD for Databricks using Databricks CLI, Terraform, and/or Azure DevOps.
  • Databricks certification (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional).
  • Streaming/real-time pipelines (Structured Streaming, Event Hub, Kafka).
  • ML platform exposure (e.g., MLflow or supporting ML pipelines).
  • Reporting/consumption layer experience (e.g., Power BI, Purview, Microsoft Fabric).
  • Knowledge of governance/compliance standards (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2).

  • 6 month contract 
  • $100-120/hr on W2 
Why PlayStation?
PlayStation isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Today, we’re recognized as a global leader in entertainment producing The PlayStation family of products and services including PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, PlayStation®VR, PlayStation®Plus, PlayStation™Now, acclaimed PlayStation software titles from PlayStation Studios, and more.
 
About The Role:
PlayStation Global Program Management Office drives delivery of highly impactful program solutions worldwide. We are looking for an experienced Senior Program Manager with a strong player-focused mindset and a proven track record of delivering software and driving results that support player needs, business goals, and organizational priorities. This role will be responsible for driving programs and projects from inception through deployment over a worldwide scale. The candidate will successfully partner with a globally distributed cross-functional team (product engineering, product management, business operations, marketing, consumer support, legal, finance) to ensure product and operational readiness for market delivery.
 
You will bring your expertise to deliver complex programs by demonstrating excellent planning, execution, partner, risk and dependency management skills. You will be hands on to tackle challenges, an advocate and the biggest supporter for the program organization.
 
What You'll Do:
  • Own and drive end-to-end delivery of multiple strategic and complex cross-regional, cross-functional initiatives with multi-level dependencies.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop full program plans including timelines, dependencies, risk factors, success criteria, and outcomes, while keeping them energized and focused on delivering priority programs
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Senior Leadership to drive programs strategically
  • Understand strategy, objectives, priority and goals to translate into tactical execution plans
  • Identify, understand, visualize and manage upstream/downstream dependencies
  • Anticipate and remove obstacles proactively and effectively
  • Ensure clear communication for status reporting, issues and challenges to leadership, relevant partners, and team members
  • Lead continuous improvement efforts to optimize productivity and processes for the organization
  • Bring clarity, calm and process to ambiguous, stressful and/or sophisticated situations
  • Build a strong cohesive program team and create a fun and collaborative environment that cultivates creativity, innovation, learning and inclusivity
  • Drive software development programs that involve integrating server and client engineering work from inception to delivery to internal / external customers
 
Basic Qualifications:
  • 5+ years of program management experience with software development and delivery at scale
  • Bachelor’s degree, technical education and/or work experience in technical domain
  • Consistent track record of managing schedules, scope, budgets, dependency, issues/risks, communications, quality/testing plans, and release plans of complex programs
  • Shown technical proficiency and an ability to understand technology, designs, challenges and risks
  • Proven understanding of Software Development Lifecycle, Design/System Thinking, Agile frameworks, preferably Scrum and Kanban, and Program Management Methodologies to implement the right practice for the programs
  • Experience in leading complex, business-critical programs with dependencies across multiple teams to include Product Management, User Experience, Legal, Marketing and other business teams
  • Experience creating and delivering executive-level summary reports and presentations
  • Excellent listening, written, and verbal communication skills across all levels
  • Strong decision-making skill, conflict resolution and navigating through the organization
  • Experience in initiating and driving process improvements
  • Experience with collaboration tools (Jira, Confluence, Trello, Google Drive, and Microsoft Teams, etc)
 
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience working with globally distributed teams and multicultural working environments
  • Experience in a high transaction network based services, video gaming industry or social media
  • Domain expertise in one or more of the following areas: video gaming, accounts platform, trust & safety, account management, process implementation, mobile, and/or web development
  • Understanding of Japanese language and culture

job.title: Senior Azure .NET Developer
job.description:
Senior Azure .NET Developer
irving, TX (Hybrid)
Direct Hire

Position Summary
As an experienced Senior Software Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in driving the design, development, and implementation of robust, scalable, secure, and modern application architecture, with deep expertise in .NET, Azure technologies, and Azure Cosmos DB.
Beyond technical execution, this role calls for someone who takes full ownership and accountability for outcomes — running toward problems, especially in production, rather than waiting to be asked. You will understand enterprise requirements end-to-end and think several steps ahead to design solutions that stand the test of time. You will act as a hands-on architect and the team's go-to technical resource, reasoning through trade-offs with data and bringing well-communicated recommendations to the Senior Management and architecture team.
What This Role Requires
  • Hands-On Ownership: Personally designs, builds, reviews, troubleshoots, and supports critical components — this is a hands-on technical lead role, not a coordination-only architect position.
  • Decision-Ready Judgment: Frames problems with supporting data, weighs tradeoffs, and brings a clear recommended path with business and technical impact — not just options.
  • Go-To Resource: The person developers and stakeholders bring hard technical questions to — across Azure and C#/.NET — and trust to give a clear, confident answer.
  • Constructive Challenge: Pushes back constructively on weak assumptions and shortcuts, balancing delivery urgency with long-term maintainability.
  • Accountability: Owns outcomes beyond code complete: requirements clarity, dependencies, test readiness, release planning, observability, rollback, documentation, and hypercare.
  • Force Multiplier: Builds reusable patterns, standards, templates, and runbooks, and develops secondary ownership so critical knowledge is never a single point of failure.
  • AI-Forward: Actively explores, adopts, and introduces AI-driven SDLC practices — then drives their adoption across the team, validating all AI-generated output through rigorous human review and testing.
Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Requirements & End-to-End Ownership
  • Understand requirements in full enterprise context — source-of-truth decisions, upstream/downstream systems, business rules, data ownership, security, and support impact.
  • Lead technical discovery into solution designs, technical stories, acceptance criteria, dependency and data mappings, exception scenarios, estimates, risks, and implementation plans.
  • Own delivery from design through testing, deployment, production validation, support transition, and continuous improvement — escalating risks early with options and recommendations.
  • Assess scope changes for architecture, schedule, testing, data, dependency, and operational impact before committing.
Architecture & Technical Direction
  • Own Azure and C#/.NET architecture, implementation, and engineering standards, aligning key architecture decisions with the Senior Manager and architecture team.
  • Design cloud-native, API-led, event-driven, and data-integration solutions; document decisions, alternatives, and tradeoffs in language suited to developers, leadership, and business partners.
  • Evaluate scalability, security, resiliency, performance, observability, maintainability, cost, and supportability before implementation.
  • Mentor engineers through design and code reviews, pairing, and feedback; establish patterns for error handling, retries, idempotency, and reusable integration components.
Hands-On Engineering
  • Build industry-grade applications, APIs, microservices, and integrations using C#, .NET, and ASP.NET Core, engineered to meet sub-150ms API response targets.
  • Must have strong, hands-on expertise with Azure Event Hubs, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Data Factory (ADF), and Azure Cosmos DB.
  • Working knowledge of Azure Functions, App Service, Container Apps/AKS, API Management, Azure Front Door, Key Vault, Application Insights, and Azure DevOps.
  • Apply strong practices for asynchronous processing, concurrency, dependency injection, authentication/authorization, data modeling, API contracts, retries, circuit breakers, idempotency, and dead-letter recovery.
  • Front-end contribution (React.js, Next.js) as needed is a plus, not required — primary depth stays in backend and integration engineering.
Performance, Data & Cost Engineering
  • Diagnose end-to-end performance using correlated telemetry across edge, API, compute, messaging, database, and batch layers.
  • Use workload evidence — latency, throughput, error/retry rates, CPU/memory, Cosmos DB RU consumption and partitioning — to guide decisions rather than guesswork.
  • Tune Cosmos DB partitioning, throughput, and indexing; balance real-time and batch workloads without defaulting to capacity increases.
  • Evaluate Azure cost and capacity tradeoffs, and recommend savings without weakening reliability.
DevSecOps & Release Engineering
  • Champion automated unit, integration, contract, regression, and performance testing with meaningful coverage as part of CI/CD quality gates.
  • Build and improve Azure DevOps YAML pipelines, environment promotion, approvals, and reliable rollback strategies.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (Bicep or equivalent) for repeatable application and platform deployments.
  • Embed secure engineering practices: managed identity, secrets management, least privilege, and vulnerability remediation.
Observability, Reliability & Production Support
  • Design structured logging, correlation IDs, distributed tracing, metrics, and alerts that minimize noise and speed root-cause analysis.
  • Define production-readiness criteria, runbooks, failure modes, and post-deployment validation.
  • DR Champion: Own disaster recovery strategy end-to-end — RPO/RTO targets, failover, backup/restore, recovery automation, and periodic DR testing.
  • Lead complex incident investigation with urgency, converting lessons learned into durable engineering improvements.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation, remaining available to support production issues as needed.
AI-Enabled Engineering
  • Be a front-runner in adopting approved AI-assisted practices across the SDLC — planning, coding, testing, documentation, review, and troubleshooting.
  • Validate all AI-generated output through human review, automated testing, and security controls.
  • Build reusable prompts, repository instructions, and guardrails that capture team learning and promote consistent, secure AI usage.
  • Track and communicate AI's impact on delivery speed, quality, and incident resolution.
Collaboration & Communication
  • Partner with product, QA, security, infrastructure, data, support, and onshore/offshore engineering teams.
  • Lead with empathy and accountability: listen, explain reasoning, challenge respectfully, and follow through on commitments.
  • Provide concise, accurate status, risk, and completion updates, keeping delivery status current.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with strong depth in C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, and Azure backend/integration services.
  • Proven, end-to-end ownership of production Azure solutions — from requirements and architecture through deployment, observability, and support.
  • Demonstrated expertise with cloud-native applications, microservices, event-driven architecture, and distributed-system failure handling.
  • Strong, hands-on expertise with Azure Event Hubs, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Cosmos DB, including production troubleshooting and performance optimization.
  • Solid experience with automated testing, Azure DevOps CI/CD, Git, Infrastructure as Code, containers, and observability tooling.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor developers, conduct design/code reviews, communicate tradeoffs, and lead through ambiguity.
  • Practical, responsible experience using AI development tools, including output validation and data protection.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate; Azure Solutions Architect Expert strongly preferred.
  • Experience with disaster recovery, high-availability architecture, distributed tracing, and production on-call support.
  • Cosmos DB partitioning/RU optimization, Azure performance engineering, and FinOps practices.
  • Experience standardizing AI-assisted engineering workflows or reusable development automation.
  • Experience in retail, distribution, supply chain, or heavy-duty aftermarket domains.
Success Measures
  • Risks, dependencies, and non-functional requirements are surfaced before development and QA.
  • Solutions reach production with automated tests, observability, documented support ownership, and validated rollback/recovery.
  • Technical debt is prevented where practical, or explicitly documented and bounded when intentionally accepted.
  • Develops clean designs, and reusable engineering assets grow over time.
  • AI-assisted development shows measurable improvement while maintaining human validation and quality.

job.title: Research Associate I/II – Molecular Biology (RT-qPCR & Cell Culture)
job.description:
Research Associate I/II – Molecular Biology (RT-qPCR & Cell Culture)

Location: South San Francisco, CA (100% Onsite)
Pay Rate: $35–$45/hour W2, depending on experience
Employment Type: Full-Time, Contract-to-Hire (6–9 Months)

Yoh Life Sciences is seeking a hands-on Research Associate I/II to join a growing biotechnology company developing innovative therapies for age-related and chronic diseases.

This position is ideal for a molecular biologist with strong, practical experience performing RNA extraction, cDNA synthesis, and RT-qPCR for gene-expression analysis, including high-throughput 384-well plate workflows.

The team needs someone who can contribute immediately at the bench, independently execute established protocols, troubleshoot experimental issues, and consistently generate accurate, reproducible data.

You'll support early-stage drug discovery programs through molecular biology assays, mammalian cell culture, biomarker analysis, and ex vivo tissue research.

Both experienced Research Associates and exceptional early-career scientists with substantial hands-on laboratory experience are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently execute complete gene-expression analysis workflows, including RNA extraction from cells and tissues, RNA quality and concentration assessment, cDNA synthesis, RT-qPCR assay setup, and data analysis.
  • Prepare and run 384-well RT-qPCR plates, including accurate sample dispensing, multichannel pipetting, serial dilutions, appropriate assay controls, and reproducible plate preparation.
  • Analyze RT-qPCR results using appropriate reference genes, controls, and normalization methods; interpret experimental findings and identify technical or biological variability.
  • Troubleshoot assay performance issues, including inconsistent Ct values, contamination, poor RNA quality, amplification efficiency, and unexpected experimental results.
  • Perform Western blot, ELISA, and other molecular or protein-based assays, including sample preparation, protein quantification, and biomarker measurements.
  • Maintain mammalian cell cultures using aseptic techniques, including passaging, counting, thawing, cryopreservation, and routine culture maintenance.
  • Support ex vivo studies through tissue processing and primary cell isolation from rodent and/or human donor samples.
  • Execute established SOPs with precision, speed, and consistency while managing multiple experiments and competing research priorities.
  • Maintain accurate laboratory records, document experimental deviations, analyze results, and communicate findings clearly to research teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Biology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Cell Biology, or a related life science discipline.
  • Approximately 1–3+ years of substantial hands-on laboratory experience in academic or industry research. Exceptional early-career candidates with strong, repeated laboratory experience will be considered.
  • Direct, hands-on experience performing RNA extraction, cDNA synthesis, and RT-qPCR for gene-expression analysis, including assay preparation, controls, and interpretation of results.
  • Hands-on experience with 384-well qPCR plate workflows, including accurate pipetting, plate preparation, and consistent experimental execution.
  • Strong understanding of RT-qPCR principles, assay controls, normalization, data interpretation, and troubleshooting.
  • Excellent pipetting technique, including multichannel pipetting, serial dilutions, and high-throughput plate-based assays.
  • Hands-on experience with mammalian cell culture and aseptic techniques.
  • Experience performing Western blot and ELISA assays.
  • Experience with tissue processing and/or primary cell isolation from rodent or human samples.
  • Ability to independently execute established protocols, maintain detailed experimental documentation, and produce reproducible results with minimal supervision.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to explain experimental methods, results, and scientific conclusions.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or CRO industry experience, particularly in fast-paced research environments.
  • Experience performing repeated, high-volume RNA extraction and RT-qPCR experiments across multiple projects.
  • Experience with biomarker assays involving plasma, serum, tissue lysates, or cell culture samples.
  • Experience handling primary cells, human donor tissue, or rodent tissue.
  • Familiarity with automated liquid handling platforms and high-throughput molecular assay workflows.
  • Experience with GraphPad Prism, Excel, or electronic laboratory documentation systems.
  • Experience supporting translational research, pharmacodynamic studies, or early-stage drug discovery programs.


What We're Looking For

We're particularly interested in candidates who:

  • Have personally performed RNA extraction through RT-qPCR and gene-expression analysis on a regular basis—not simply supported or analyzed these workflows.
  • Are comfortable preparing and running 384-well qPCR assays with high accuracy and reproducibility.
  • Can explain why an assay works, what the controls demonstrate, and how experimental results support scientific conclusions.
  • Can troubleshoot technical problems independently rather than relying on extensive guidance.
  • Enjoy hands-on bench work and can maintain productivity across multiple concurrent experiments.
  • Can contribute quickly in a fast-paced research environment with minimal ramp-up time.


Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • Contribute directly to early-stage drug discovery programs focused on age-related and chronic diseases.
  • Work alongside experienced scientists in a collaborative, hands-on research environment.
  • Gain exposure to molecular assays, biomarker analysis, mammalian cell culture, and ex vivo research across multiple programs.
  • Opportunity for permanent conversion based on performance and business needs.


Additional Details

  • Full-time, 100% onsite in South San Francisco, CA.
  • Initial contract duration of approximately 6–9 months.
  • Occasional weekend cell culture maintenance may be required.
  • No live animal handling is required.
  • Final candidates will complete an onsite practical laboratory assessment to demonstrate technical proficiency.
  • Candidates should be prepared to discuss the scientific principles, controls, troubleshooting approaches, and results of assays they have personally performed.


Apply Today

If you have strong hands-on experience with RNA extraction, RT-qPCR gene-expression analysis, 384-well plate workflows, and mammalian cell culture, we'd like to hear from you.

Please submit an updated resume highlighting the molecular biology assays, plate formats, cell culture procedures, and tissue-based experiments you have personally performed.

job.title: Client Service Associate
job.description:
Financial Client Service Associate
Position Summary:
We are seeking a Client Service Associate to join a professional financial services team and provide day-to-day support to advisors and their clients. This individual will help manage client requests, maintain account information, coordinate meetings, and assist with the administrative and operational needs of the office.

The successful candidate will be organized, responsive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a client-facing environment. Strong communication skills and a high degree of professionalism are essential.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients by responding to questions, requests, and account-related needs via phone, email, and in-person interactions.
  • Assist financial advisors with daily scheduling, including coordinating appointments, preparing materials, organizing client meetings, and completing post-meeting follow-up.
  • Handle a variety of account servicing activities, including new account setup, account transfers, beneficiary updates, required minimum distributions, address changes, and other client maintenance requests.
  • Keep client information and documentation current and accurate within internal CRM and account systems.
  • Follow established operational and regulatory procedures, including applicable FINRA and SEC requirements, while maintaining strict confidentiality of client and account information.
  • Communicate with third-party custodians, investment providers, financial institutions, and other external partners to facilitate transactions and resolve account-related issues.
  • Assist with general branch administration, including preparing documents, coordinating mail and correspondence, supporting client events and educational sessions, and assisting with newsletters or digital communications.
  • Contribute to a positive office environment by identifying opportunities to improve processes, enhance client service, and support the broader team.
Ideal Candidate:
We are looking for someone who takes ownership, works well with others, and genuinely enjoys helping people. The ideal candidate is comfortable in a fast-paced environment, approaches challenges with a solutions-oriented mindset, and consistently follows through on commitments.

Strong candidates will demonstrate sound judgment, integrity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn. We value individuals who take pride in their work, look for ways to improve the client experience, and contribute positively to a collaborative team environment.

Qualifications:
  • Ability to work on-site Monday through Friday.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to quickly learn and effectively navigate CRM and other business systems.
  • Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to prioritize competing responsibilities while working independently and as part of a team.
  • Professional demeanor with a high level of discretion, integrity, and confidentiality.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Associate's or bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Degree or educational background in finance, accounting, business, or a related field is a plus.
  • Previous experience in financial services, wealth management, banking, or a client-facing administrative environment is beneficial.

job.description:
Process Engineer – Pharmaceutical Manufacturing

Location: Noblesville, IN 46060
Employment Type: Direct Hire | Full-Time
Salary: $80,000–$110,000 annually
Schedule: Monday–Friday | Onsite

Yoh Life Sciences is seeking an experienced Process Engineer to support a pharmaceutical manufacturing operation in Noblesville, Indiana.

This position is ideal for a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex manufacturing challenges, improving equipment reliability, optimizing production processes, and driving measurable operational improvements in a regulated environment.

What You'll Do
  • Lead manufacturing process improvement initiatives focused on equipment reliability, efficiency, throughput, and operational performance.
  • Troubleshoot manufacturing equipment and recurring process issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable corrective actions.
  • Develop, monitor, and improve process performance indicators (KPIs) to support manufacturing objectives.
  • Lead root cause investigations, author deviations, and develop corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs).
  • Prepare technical documentation, including engineering protocols, reports, and process improvement documentation.
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, and Validation teams to ensure compliance with cGMP requirements.
  • Support equipment qualification, process validation, change control, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Assist with the development and maintenance of manufacturing procedures, batch records, and training materials.
  • Coordinate engineering projects, track milestones, and provide input on project costs and resource requirements.

What We're Looking For
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering required. Mechanical Engineering preferred; Chemical, Biochemical, Biotechnology, or related engineering disciplines considered.
  • 5+ years of relevant engineering experience in a cGMP manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated experience improving manufacturing processes, equipment performance, and operational reliability.
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting production equipment and resolving manufacturing issues.
  • Experience leading formal root cause analysis and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
  • Working knowledge of cGMP, validation, quality systems, and document control.
  • Experience developing or utilizing process KPIs to measure and improve manufacturing performance.
  • Strong technical documentation, project management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with automated visual inspection systems or pharmaceutical packaging equipment.
  • Background supporting automated manufacturing lines, equipment optimization, or reliability improvement initiatives.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, medical devices, or other highly regulated production environments.

Why Consider This Opportunity?
  • Direct-hire opportunity with an established pharmaceutical manufacturing organization.
  • Opportunity to lead meaningful equipment and process improvements.
  • Collaborative, cross-functional engineering environment.
  • Work on manufacturing operations where quality, reliability, and continuous improvement are essential.

Interested?
Apply today to connect with Yoh Life Sciences and learn more about this Process Engineer opportunity in Noblesville, Indiana.
