job.title: ERP Transformation Lead – Microsoft Dynamics 365
job.description:
ERP Transformation Lead – Microsoft Dynamics 365 This is a long-term opportunity for an ERP professional interested in influencing a significant technology transformation while developing an ongoing role within the organization. Candidates should be comfortable working in a hybrid environment and committing to the full implementation lifecycle.

Employment Type: Full-Time, Direct Hire
Salary: $110,000-$135,000 Annually, Based on Experience
Work Arrangement: Hybrid, Tuesday–Thursday
Location: North Dallas Texas (Richardson TX)

POSITION OVERVIEW An established organization is seeking an experienced ERP Transformation Lead to serve as a key internal resource during a major Microsoft Dynamics ERP implementation. This position will bridge business operations, technology teams, and an external implementation partner to ensure the new platform supports organizational requirements, improves operational efficiency, and delivers long-term business value.
  • The ideal candidate brings strong functional expertise in Microsoft Dynamics AX and Dynamics 365, with the ability to evaluate business processes, guide system decisions, challenge implementation recommendations, and represent internal stakeholder interests throughout the transformation.
  • The ERP initiative is scheduled to begin in the first quarter of 2027, with an anticipated implementation timeline of 18–24 months. This individual will play an integral role throughout the project lifecycle and transition into an ongoing ERP support and optimization function following deployment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Serve as the primary functional liaison between internal business departments, IT leadership, and the third-party ERP implementation team.
  • Evaluate current operational workflows and translate business objectives into system requirements, configuration recommendations, and implementation priorities.
  • Facilitate discussions with stakeholders to identify process inefficiencies, application limitations, and opportunities to leverage standard Microsoft Dynamics functionality.
  • Provide functional guidance across ERP modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Fixed Assets, Inventory Management, and Warehouse Operations.
  • Assess proposed system designs, integrations, and customization requests to ensure solutions align with business goals and minimize unnecessary complexity.
  • Influence ERP-related decisions by recommending process improvements, resolving functional challenges, and balancing operational requirements with platform capabilities.
  • Coordinate data conversion activities, including legacy system mapping, data integrity reviews, cleansing strategies, and reconciliation of financial and operational information.
  • Develop testing strategies, coordinate cross-functional validation efforts, and oversee System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Collaborate with technology and business teams to establish appropriate system access, role-based permissions, security controls, and compliance procedures.
  • Support organizational readiness through training materials, knowledge transfer, process documentation, and end-user adoption initiatives.
  • Participate in deployment planning, issue resolution, post-implementation stabilization, and ongoing system enhancements.
    Provide continued functional support and contribute to future ERP improvements following completion of the initial implementation.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Strong hands-on functional experience with Microsoft Dynamics AX, Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, or comparable Microsoft Dynamics ERP environments.
  • Experience participating in ERP implementations, enterprise system conversions, or large-scale business application modernization projects.
  • Working knowledge of finance, accounting, inventory, supply chain, or warehouse-related ERP processes.
  • Ability to evaluate functional requirements, conduct process assessments, and translate business needs into effective system solutions.
  • Experience collaborating with external implementation consultants, systems integrators, and internal business stakeholders.
  • Understanding of ERP testing methodologies, data migration activities, configuration management, and system deployment processes.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify operational gaps, assess technical recommendations, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

job.title: Lead Systems Analyst with Investment Management - MDM - Remote
job.description:
Lead Systems Analyst Master Data Management

Role Summary

We are seeking a Lead Systems Analyst with strong master data management experience to analyze business needs, define practical system and data solutions, and guide delivery across investment-data and reference-data environments. Financial-services experience is required.

Responsibilities

Elicit, challenge, document, and prioritize requirements for MDM, reference data, EDM, and related investment-data capabilities.

Analyze processes, data flows, entities, attributes, ownership, stewardship, and integration points.

Translate business needs into functional specifications, source-to-target mappings, data rules, process flows, and acceptance criteria.

Support MDM analysis and design, including master-data creation, matching, quality, governance, and distribution.

Partner with developers, data teams, vendors, and business stakeholders through build, QA, UAT, defect resolution, and release readiness; communicate clearly and surface risks early.

Required Qualifications

Lead-level experience as a Business Systems Analyst, Systems Analyst, Data Analyst, or similar role supporting enterprise data platforms.

Investment Management experience - Investment management, asset management, custodial, performance, IBOR, portfolio, security, or reference-data experience; MDM solution design, data quality, lineage, stewardship, governance, and integration experience; or experience with investment-data organizations, and custodians. 

Experience working in an OCIO would be a +

Hands-on experience with an MDM, client master, product master, reference-data, or data-governance platform. Informatica MDM, Salesforce, or EDM is valuable.  Markit EDM is a big + 

Requirements elicitation, process and data analysis, data modeling, mappings, SQL, testing, and stakeholder-management experience.

Ability to explain technical topics clearly, ask strong questions, handle ambiguity patiently, and convert needs into actionable delivery work.

 

Success Measures

The successful candidate will improve requirements quality, clarify data ownership and definitions, reduce rework, and deliver reliable master and reference data to downstream consumers. This is a substantive hands-on systems-analysis role, not a high-level-only architecture position.

job.title: Quality Assurance Analyst III
job.description:
Quality Assurance Analyst III

Job Details:

Duration: 24 months contract W2
Location: Hybrid 2x a week onsite in Audubon PA
Pay Rate: $56.34-$69.72 hourly W2

** Client is not able to do sponsorship of visa or C2C** 




Responsibilities
 
The Quality Analyst will be responsible for test planning, test monitoring and control, test analysis and design, test implementation and test execution, evaluating exit criteria and reporting, and test closure.
 
The Quality Analyst will be directly involved in hands-on, technical work including test data provisioning and test data management. Specific duties include the following.
 
  • Test planning: define the overall strategic and tactical objectives for testing software changes at different test levels. Work with developers, project managers and business customers to define the strategy to be used, such as risk-based testing. Test levels include component testing, integration testing, system testing and acceptance testing. Test types include functional testing, non-functional testing, structural ("white-box") testing, confirmation testing and regression testing.
 
  • Test monitoring and control: continuously compare test progress with the plan, adjust the plan and testing activities as necessary, and provide status reports.
 
  • Test analysis and design: transform testing objectives into test conditions and test cases. The test basis includes documented requirements, system architecture, behavior and structure of the software, existing data and data flows. Using structural ("white-box") test techniques, among others, design tests, or provide input into test design by identifying specific test conditions and high-level test cases.
 
  • Test implementation and test execution: develop and prioritize test procedures, set up the test environment and test data, and execute tests. Test changes to the database components of the system under test. Testable components include views, procedures and functions, data conversion and migration programs. Support business customers and others in acceptance testing. Includes identifying database model changes in higher environments (Production and Stage), and making those changes in the lower environments (Test and Development).
 
  • Evaluating exit criteria and reporting, and test closure: asses test execution against the objectives defined in the test plan. Specific tasks and deliverables are defined at the team or project level.
 
  • Identify the necessary test data to support test conditions and test cases as they are defined. Includes data to force error and boundary conditions. Analyze input data, including electronic files, message traffic and variations of user input.
 
  • Provide expected test results, and/or repeatable methods of generating expected test results, based on currently existing data. Includes preparing database queries and guides for testers to use.
 
  • Provide tools and methods to compare expected and actual test results. Includes bi-directional comparisons of database data with electronic files, message streams, and front-end displays.
 
  • Provide high-quality, realistic, fit for purpose and referentially intact test data. Capture end-to-end business processes and the associated data for testing. Subset production data: extract subsets of production data from multiple sources to meet test cases and/or to supply input values for data-driven testing. Create realistic test data sets small enough to support rapid test runs but large enough to accurately reflect the variety of production data.
  • Provide test data management. Script the setup of data in the application database to put it in a state that allows a specific set of test cases to be run against it. Script the creation of data files and message streams which require changing variables (usually date or timestamp related) in order to test applications which process them. Script database cleanups.
 
  • Ensure compliance with Client Software Testing standards and policies
 
 
Required Skills
  • 7+ years of experience as a quality assurance analyst or tester
  • Strong customer and business focus
  • Strong communication skills
  • Experience with user-centered design and usability testing
  • Experience with (Atlassian toolset) and Confluence
  • Understanding of Oracle database and and able to write SQL queries
  • Experience with test driven or behavior driven development practices
  • Someone who is energetic and passionate about their work, extremely positive and solution driven
  • Someone who has worked on large teams, on projects that have different business owners
  • Experience using iterative development methodologies, specifically Agile Scrum
  • Scripting experience using applicable languages
  • Salesforce experience required
  • Experience using automated testing tools – SOAPUI, TOSCA, Scriptless Automation
  • Experience hands-on testing complex technical applications
  • Experience in communicating with Business Leadership and stakeholders

job.title: Product Manager – Autonomous Mobility/ Commercial Auto Insurance
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting opportunity for a Product Manager – Autonomous Mobility/ Commercial Auto Insurance to join our insurance and mobility client. This is a foundational role responsible for defining the organization’s commercial auto strategy and determining how it should participate in emerging mobility markets, including autonomous vehicles, connected fleets, rideshare, and delivery platforms. The ideal candidate will bring strong commercial auto product expertise, a thoughtful perspective on the future of mobility, and the executive presence to develop and sell a new product vision from the ground up.

Title: Commercial Auto Product Manager, Emerging Mobility
Compensation: $194,300–$259,100 base salary, depending on experience, plus 20% target incentive
Type: Full-Time, Direct Hire
Location: Costa Mesa, CA or Dallas, TX
Industry: Insurance / Mobility Technology

This role is expected to be onsite most days in the Costa Mesa office. Relocation assistance may be considered for an exceptional candidate. Fully remote work is not currently planned, although limited flexibility may be explored for an outstanding candidate.

Position Overview The organization does not currently offer commercial auto insurance products and is beginning to define its strategy in this space. This person will serve as the initial product leader for the initiative, helping the business understand the opportunity, evaluate potential paths forward, and build the foundation for a future commercial auto and emerging mobility product organization.

The initial focus will be on light commercial auto and mobility segments that align with the organization’s existing operational and underwriting capabilities. This is not a heavy trucking role. The position will initially be heavily focused on strategy, market analysis, product vision, business cases, and executive alignment before transitioning into broader product development and team-building responsibilities.

Over time, the role is expected to transition from the emerging mobility strategy team into the broader insurance product management organization, potentially within 12 to 36 months as the product vision and operating model take shape.

Key Responsibilities Commercial Auto and Mobility Strategy
  • Define the organization’s long-term commercial auto and emerging mobility product strategy.

  • Evaluate opportunities across light commercial fleets, connected vehicles, autonomous vehicles, rideshare, delivery, and other evolving mobility models.

  • Explain the key differences between personal auto and commercial auto products, including risk, pricing, underwriting, coverage, claims, and operational considerations.

  • Develop a clear point of view on how autonomous and connected mobility will impact commercial insurance.

  • Monitor emerging mobility trends, competitors, OEM activity, insurance innovation, technology providers, and regulatory developments.

  • Identify where the organization can create a differentiated position in the market.

Business Case and Product Vision
  • Develop a practical roadmap for moving from the current state, with no commercial auto product, to a scalable product offering.

  • Evaluate potential paths, including building the capability internally, acquiring or partnering with an existing organization, or choosing not to enter specific market segments.

  • Analyze the investment, talent, technology, regulatory, operational, and risk requirements associated with each path.

  • Prepare recommendations and business cases for executive leadership.

  • Sell the product vision to senior executives and create alignment around the recommended strategy.

  • Define the capabilities, resources, partnerships, and organizational structure required to execute the strategy.

Product Design and Insurance Expertise
  • Provide expertise on commercial auto product structure, coverage design, underwriting, rating, pricing, and risk selection.

  • Partner with actuarial teams to evaluate pricing methodologies, risk models, exposure data, loss trends, and portfolio economics.

  • Help determine which commercial auto risks and vehicle types align with the organization’s existing capabilities.

  • Identify future coverage needs created by autonomous systems, connected vehicles, fleet operations, and changing liability models.

  • Establish the foundation for product governance, regulatory review, underwriting guidelines, and operational processes.

  • Support the development of product requirements and implementation plans as the strategy advances.

Team and Capability Development
  • Define the roles and capabilities needed to build a future commercial auto product team.

  • Recommend the organizational structure and talent profile required for execution.

  • Help recruit and build the team responsible for launching and managing the product.

  • Establish relationships across insurance product management, actuarial, underwriting, claims, legal, compliance, technology, operations, and marketing.

  • Transition from primarily strategic work into product development and execution as the initiative progresses.

Partnership and Market Development
  • Evaluate potential relationships with OEMs, autonomous vehicle companies, mobility platforms, fleet operators, telematics providers, data companies, and insurance technology partners.

  • Assess embedded insurance and partnership-based distribution opportunities.

  • Represent the organization in relevant insurance, mobility, and technology discussions.

  • Develop external market perspective and bring new insights to internal stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, insurance, finance, economics, management, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.

  • Significant experience developing or managing commercial auto insurance products.

  • Strong understanding of the differences between personal auto and commercial auto insurance.

  • Experience with commercial auto pricing, underwriting, actuarial models, risk selection, coverage structures, or portfolio performance.

  • Experience developing product strategy, business cases, market-entry plans, or new insurance capabilities.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate in an environment where the product, process, and team are still being built.

  • Strong understanding of emerging mobility, autonomous vehicles, connected vehicles, telematics, rideshare, delivery, or commercial fleet trends.

  • Ability to clearly explain how changes in mobility and vehicle technology may affect insurance products, pricing, underwriting, liability, and claims.

  • Proven ability to present recommendations and influence senior executives.

  • Strong written, verbal, analytical, and presentation skills.

  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with practical execution.

  • Ability to work onsite most days in Costa Mesa, California, or relocate to the area.

  • Willingness to travel periodically for executive meetings, industry events, and stakeholder discussions.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working with autonomous vehicle companies, OEMs, commercial fleet operators, mobility platforms, telematics providers, or embedded insurance programs.

  • Experience with light commercial fleets, delivery vehicles, rideshare, or other emerging commercial mobility segments.

  • Experience working with an insurance carrier, insurtech, mobility company, or transportation technology organization.

  • Experience launching a new insurance product or building a new insurance capability from the ground up.

  • Experience evaluating build, buy, partner, or acquisition strategies.

  • Experience with E&S, specialty, non-standard, or other complex insurance products.

  • Experience with state insurance filings, regulatory approvals, product governance, or compliance.

  • CPCU, AINS, ARM, or another insurance designation.

  • Experience building and leading a product management or insurance strategy team.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique
  • Build the commercial auto strategy from the ground up.

  • Define how a major insurance organization approaches emerging mobility.

  • Work directly with senior executives and influence a significant new business direction.

  • Shape the product vision, operating model, partnerships, and future team.

  • Help determine whether the organization should build, buy, or partner to enter the market.

  • Join at the earliest stage of a long-term commercial auto and autonomous mobility initiative.

job.title: Material Handler
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Material Handler for our manufacturing client. In this role, you will be responsible for pulling, kitting, and restocking raw materials and finished products to support production operations. The Material Handler will operate applicable industrial equipment, maintain clean work areas, comply with written manufacturing procedures, and support production teams in both cleanroom and non-cleanroom environments. This position also supports inventory accuracy, material flow, and adherence to quality and safety standards.

Industry: Medical Device
Location: Santa Fe Springs
Compensation: $19 - $20/hr 
Shift: 2nd shift Mon-Fri 2:40pm to 11:10pm 
 

Job Functions
  • Pull, pick, kit, and restock raw materials and products to support production operations.
  • Work in both cleanroom and non-cleanroom manufacturing environments.
  • Support production teams by ensuring timely and accurate material availability.
  • Work closely with customer service and sales teams in a supporting role, as needed.
  • Understand and follow manufacturing paperwork and instructions.
  • Perform physical counting, reconciliation, and reorganization of materials.
  • Retrieve, replenish, and verify materials, including material notification when required.
  • Perform required system transactions related to inventory and material movement.
  • Operate and monitor select automated production equipment; reset or service equipment as needed.
  • Drive company vehicles between facilities, as required.
  • Perform additional tasks as assigned by the General Manager, Operations Manager, Production Manager/Supervisor, Manufacturing Lead, or Line Trainer.
  • Learn, follow, and adhere to Manufacturing Procedures (MPs) and company quality policies.
  • Complete manufacturing paperwork accurately and verify documentation.
  • Complete required training objectives and demonstrate training effectiveness as outlined in the training plan.

Education, Licensure and/or Experience Education
  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent required.

Skills and Experience
  • Previous experience and/or training as a Material Handler preferred.
  • Basic mathematical skills to use assembly and inspection tools (e.g., rulers, gauges, reticles).
  • Introductory-level computer proficiency.
  • Ability to read, write, and communicate effectively in English regarding manufacturing procedures, workflows, equipment setup, and work instructions.
  • Ability to lift up to 25 pounds and stand and/or sit for up to 8 hours.
  • Ability to distinguish between colors, as required for product identification and signaling systems.
  • Strong manual dexterity to handle, count, and manipulate materials.
  • Ability to perform repetitive tasks throughout an entire shift.
  • Ability to learn and work in a cleanroom environment.
  • Ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods, with occasional movement to transport materials or communicate with manufacturing leadership.
  • Ability to operate equipment to assemble or prepare parts manually and inspect work accuracy per manufacturing processes.

Physical Job Requirements
  • Manufacturing and cleanroom work environment.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, sit, and use hands to manipulate, handle, or feel objects, tools, controls, and office equipment.
  • The employee frequently is required to talk and hear.
  • The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Noise levels in the work environment are typically very quiet.

job.title: Quality Control Inspector
job.description:
Put your inspection skills and attention to detail to work in medical device manufacturing. Yoh Life Sciences is seeking a Quality Control Inspector for a client in Reno, NV. In this hands-on role, we are looking for candidates with experience in quality inspection, and warehouse operations.  Candidates with experience in medical device manufacturing are preferred. This position combines quality inspection with hands-on warehouse support. You’ll inspect incoming materials and work in progress, maintain accurate records, and help keep materials and finished products moving through the operation. If you enjoy detailed work and variety in your day, this role offers exposure to quality, assembly, and inventory activities within a medical device environment.

Industry: Medical Device Manufacturing
Location: Onsite in Reno, NV

What You’ll Do:
  • Inspect products during manufacturing to support consistent quality.
  • Perform receiving inspections on incoming raw materials.
  • Capture inspection results and maintain accurate quality control records.
  • Help develop and improve quality control processes.
  • Learn assembly processes and provide production support as needed.
  • Keep purchase orders and related records organized and accessible.
  • Maintain an organized warehouse and control raw material storage and handling.
  • Prepare, package, and ship finished products.
  • Complete inventory counts and keep inventory records accurate.
  • Follow quality system requirements and good documentation practices throughout daily work.

Experience That Can Help You Succeed:
  • Background in medical device manufacturing.
  • Must have experience with and knowledge of ISO 9001 and/or ISO 13485 quality systems.
  • Experience inspecting incoming materials, in-process products, and finished goods.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and blueprints.
  • Familiarity with precision inspection tools, including calipers, micrometers, and microscopes.
  • Experience recognizing and documenting nonconforming materials or products.
  • Hands-on experience with inventory control and warehouse activities.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing records and accurate production documentation.
  • Experience using ERP, electronic quality management, or similar business systems.
  • English/Spanish bilingual skills are a plus.

job.title: Bioinformatics Scientist / Senior Bioinformatics Scientist
job.description:
Senior Bioinformatics Scientist, Oncology Diagnostics

Location: Sunnyvale, California
Work Arrangement: Onsite or hybrid, based on business requirements
Employment Type: Direct Hire, Full-Time
Salary Range: $175,000–$205,000 annually

Yoh is partnering with a privately held molecular diagnostics company developing blood-based technologies for earlier cancer detection. We are seeking a Senior Bioinformatics Scientist to take a leading, hands-on role in the development, optimization, and validation of computational workflows supporting a next-generation oncology diagnostic platform.

This position sits at the intersection of bioinformatics, next-generation sequencing, statistical modeling, and molecular assay development. The successful candidate will transform sequencing data into reliable analytical outputs, improve the detection of low-frequency molecular signals, and help establish a reproducible, scalable, and validation-ready bioinformatics workflow.

This is an opportunity for an experienced bioinformatics scientist to have meaningful technical ownership within a growing, cross-functional organization. The role will work closely with assay development, molecular biology, laboratory automation, biostatistics, quality, clinical, and regulatory partners.

What You Will Do
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain end-to-end bioinformatics workflows for targeted, cell-free DNA sequencing assays.
  • Process and analyze sequencing data across FASTQ, BAM/CRAM, VCF, and assay-specific intermediate formats.
  • Develop and monitor quality metrics related to sequencing performance, mapping, coverage, library complexity, molecular error rates, contamination, and sample-level performance.
  • Develop or optimize methods for detecting low-frequency molecular signals in noisy sequencing data.
  • Apply molecular barcodes, error-correction, background-noise modeling, or related approaches appropriate to the assay.
  • Partner with assay scientists to understand biological, technical, and pre-analytical sources of variation.
  • Develop and evaluate statistical models or classification methods used to distinguish cancer-associated signals from non-cancer background.
  • Assess model performance using appropriate training, tuning, cross-validation, and independent test datasets.
  • Evaluate the effects of cfDNA input, sequencing depth, sample quality, batch effects, and other technical variables on assay performance.
  • Design and support bioinformatics verification and analytical validation activities.
  • Define computational quality-control criteria, acceptance thresholds, failure conditions, and reproducibility requirements.
  • Develop modular, maintainable, version-controlled software using Python, R, or other appropriate languages.
  • Implement reproducible workflows using Nextflow, Snakemake, WDL, or a comparable workflow-management framework.
  • Use automated testing, containers, execution logging, data lineage, and version tracking to support reliable software releases.
  • Investigate pipeline failures, discrepant results, unexpected performance, and potential sources of false-positive or false-negative calls.
  • Prepare clear technical documentation supporting software verification, analytical validation, design controls, and future regulatory activities.
  • Communicate findings and technical recommendations to both computational and non-computational stakeholders.
Required Qualifications
  • Ph.D. in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Biostatistics, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or an M.S. with substantial relevant industry experience.
  • Hands-on experience developing and maintaining NGS bioinformatics pipelines.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, R, or both, including development of reusable and well-tested analytical code.
  • Experience with sequencing quality control, alignment, variant or molecular-feature detection, and statistical analysis.
  • Strong understanding of experimental design, model evaluation, data quality, and analytical reproducibility.
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix environments with Git and reproducible computational workflows.
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot complex bioinformatics problems and drive technical deliverables.
  • Strong communication skills and experience working across scientific and technical disciplines.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with cfDNA, ctDNA, liquid biopsy, cancer genomics, or blood-based molecular diagnostics.
  • Experience detecting ultra-low-frequency molecular signals.
  • Familiarity with unique molecular identifiers, molecular barcodes, error-corrected sequencing, or background-noise suppression.
  • Experience developing or validating computational pipelines for oncology or clinical diagnostic applications.
  • Knowledge of analytical validation concepts such as limit of blank, limit of detection, precision, reproducibility, interference, and robustness.
  • Experience with statistical classification, predictive modeling, feature selection, and evaluation of clinical biomarkers.
  • Experience with Nextflow, Snakemake, WDL, Docker, Apptainer/Singularity, cloud infrastructure, or high-performance computing.
  • Familiarity with regulated software development, design controls, software verification and validation, change control, and traceability.
  • Experience integrating computational workflows with LIMS, laboratory automation, or clinical reporting systems.
  • Experience supporting clinical studies, regulated product development, or molecular diagnostic commercialization.
What Success Will Look Like During the first 6–12 months, the successful candidate will be expected to:

  • Establish or materially strengthen a reproducible end-to-end NGS analysis pipeline.
  • Implement documented sequencing- and sample-level quality metrics and failure criteria.
  • Improve the reliability of low-frequency molecular signal detection and classification.
  • Establish a bioinformatics verification and analytical-validation plan with predefined acceptance criteria.
  • Demonstrate reproducibility and traceability across representative datasets and software versions.
  • Deliver controlled technical documentation, automated testing, and versioned software releases.
  • Build productive working relationships across assay development, laboratory automation, clinical, quality, and regulatory functions.
Compensation The anticipated base salary range for this position is $175,000–$205,000 annually. Actual compensation will depend on qualifications, relevant experience, technical depth, and the final level of the position.

job.title: Technical Program Manager / Agile Delivery Lead
job.description:
Technical Program Manager / Agile Delivery Lead
12 + month contract (W2 ONLY, NO C-C)
Dallas, TX (Hybrid)
 
Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager or Agile Delivery Lead to support the Enterprise Business Systems team. This role will lead complex, cross-functional technology initiatives supporting business applications and FinTech-related capabilities.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise software delivery, stakeholder management, Agile methodologies, and technical program leadership. Must have demonstrated experience leading large or complex technical projects, coordinating multiple teams, and driving successful delivery.
This individual must be comfortable moving between technical details and high-level business objectives, facilitating technical discussions, representing customer needs, and identifying risks and opportunities before they impact delivery.
 
Responsibilities
  • Lead complex, cross-functional technology programs from kickoff through delivery and operational handoff.
  • Serve as a Scrum Master or Agile Delivery Lead, facilitating ceremonies and promoting effective Agile practices.
  • Coordinate work across engineering, product, business systems, infrastructure, and other stakeholder teams.
  • Define project scope, objectives, milestones, dependencies, and delivery plans.
  • Develop, own, and maintain team roadmaps aligned with business and technology objectives.
  • Manage risks, issues, dependencies, assumptions, and decisions throughout the program lifecycle.
  • Partner with technical teams to support sound architecture, integration, scalability, and operational-readiness decisions.
  • Facilitate technical discussions while ensuring business and customer requirements remain central to decision-making.
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels, including senior and executive leadership.
  • Prepare and deliver clear program updates, presentations, status reports, and executive communications.
  • Promote transparency regarding progress, risks, tradeoffs, and delivery expectations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, tools, team performance, and delivery practices.
  • Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Proactively identify issues, remove roadblocks, and drive decisions to maintain momentum.
  • Represent multiple perspectives and challenge assumptions to improve program outcomes.
 
Requirements
  • 7+ years of experience in technical program management, Agile delivery, project management, software delivery, or a related role.
  • Demonstrated success leading large, complex, or highly cross-functional technology initiatives.
  • Experience supporting enterprise business applications, FinTech, financial services, or similar environments preferred.
  • Strong hands-on experience with NetSuite.
  • Experience leading projects through the full delivery lifecycle, from planning and kickoff through implementation and release.
  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, Scrum practices, and software development lifecycles.
  • Experience serving as a Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, or equivalent delivery leadership role.
  • Proven ability to coordinate multiple teams, manage dependencies, and drive accountability.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across organizational levels.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and solutions-focused.
  • Ability to understand technical concepts, participate in architecture and engineering discussions, and translate complex information for business stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • PMP, CSM, SAFe, or other relevant Agile or project management certification.
  • Experience managing enterprise business systems or NetSuite implementations and integrations.
  • Experience with roadmap development, release planning, dependency management, and executive reporting.
  • Experience driving process improvement and continuous delivery improvements.
  • FinTech, payments, accounting, ERP, or financial systems experience.
 
Ideal Candidate Profile
The successful candidate is a hands-on delivery leader who can organize complex work, create clarity across teams, communicate effectively with executives, and proactively address risks. They are comfortable operating at both the strategic and tactical levels and are not limited by job title—the client will consider strong Agile Delivery Leads, Scrum Masters, or Technical Project Managers with comparable experience leading complex technical programs.

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Quality Engineer for our client in Saint Paul, MN. In this role, you will support medical device manufacturing operations, collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve technical quality issues, and drive process improvements in a regulated environment. The ideal candidate is a motivated, independent Quality Engineer with hands-on experience in process and equipment validation (IQ/OQ/PQ), manufacturing quality investigations, risk management, and statistical analysis. Experience applying ISO 14971 principles to process FMEA and validations is highly desirable.

Industry: Medical Device
Location: Saint Paul, MN
Compensation: $80,000–$90,000 annually
Type: Direct Hire

Job Functions
  • Plan, execute, and document process and equipment validations, including Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), and Performance Qualification (PQ).
  • Develop validation protocols, establish acceptance criteria, analyze results, and prepare technical summary reports.
  • Support manufacturing risk assessments, Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and quality investigations.
  • Collect, analyze, and present manufacturing quality data using statistical methods to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
  • Utilize quality engineering tools, including Minitab, Statistical Process Control (SPC), Design of Experiments (DOE), process capability studies, Gage Repeatability and Reproducibility (GRR), and trend analysis.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing and engineering teams to investigate production issues, identify root causes, and implement process improvements.
  • Support Quality Management System (QMS) activities, including complaint analysis, risk assessments, and process/equipment/software verification and validation.
  • Monitor manufacturing processes, quality metrics, and product performance to ensure compliance with internal procedures and applicable regulatory standards.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, validation records, and quality reports in accordance with established QMS requirements.

Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related technical discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years of quality assurance experience in a medical device or pharmaceutical manufacturing environment.
  • Experience with FDA-regulated quality systems (21 CFR Part 820, 210, and/or 211, as applicable) and ISO 13485.
  • Knowledge of process and equipment validation methodologies, including IQ/OQ/PQ.
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis and Minitab, including process capability, normality assessments, hypothesis testing, ANOVA, sampling plans, and Design of Experiments (DOE).
  • Experience supporting manufacturing quality investigations, risk assessments, and corrective and preventive actions.
  • Strong technical writing skills, including the ability to develop and maintain validation protocols, technical reports, and quality documentation.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate across multiple departments.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment while maintaining accuracy and regulatory compliance.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience applying ISO 14971 risk management principles to process FMEA and manufacturing validations.
  • Hands-on experience with Statistical Process Control (SPC) and Lean Six Sigma methodologies.
  • ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or equivalent quality certification.
  • Experience with electronic QMS platforms such as TrackWise, Arena, or uniPoint.
  • Familiarity with medical device manufacturing equipment and environments, including sealers, cleanrooms, DI water systems, or HVAC systems.

  • Oversee the execution and processing of trade finance products while ensuring quality, accuracy, and compliance.
  • Drive process improvements, workflow optimization, and technology-driven operational enhancements.
  • Provide subject matter expertise on complex trade finance transactions and operational issues.
  • Manage multiple projects and transformation initiatives simultaneously while ensuring business objectives are achieved.

job.title: Cloud Engineer, Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Cloud Engineer – Microsoft 365, Azure & Google Cloud to join a growing enterprise organization undergoing a major cloud modernization initiative. This hands-on role will be responsible for securing, administering, and improving Microsoft 365, Azure, Google Cloud, and Google Workspace environments. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with Microsoft 365 E5 security, Intune, Azure administration, identity management, and Google Cloud technologies.

Title: Senior Cloud Engineer – Microsoft 365, Azure & Google Cloud
Compensation: $190,000–$230,000 base salary 
Type: Direct Hire
Location: Remote or hybrid; Southern California and West Coast candidates preferred
Travel: Occasional travel to regional offices
Industry: Financial Services / Data Centers

Responsibilities
  • Administer and support Microsoft 365, Azure, Google Cloud, and Google Workspace environments.

  • Help secure and optimize Microsoft 365 E5 capabilities, including Entra ID, Conditional Access, Defender, and Purview.

  • Manage Microsoft Intune for Windows, macOS, and mobile devices.

  • Implement device-compliance policies, BitLocker key management, application deployment, and endpoint security controls.

  • Support Windows Autopilot deployments and certificate-based Wi-Fi initiatives.

  • Manage Azure subscriptions, resource groups, policies, monitoring, patching, and Azure Arc.

  • Support identity, SSO, access management, and authentication initiatives.

  • Assist with Google Cloud administration, Google Workspace support, and multi-cloud operations.

  • Support cloud migrations and provide technical guidance on improving migration efficiency and reliability.

  • Partner with infrastructure, security, application, and business teams to support new cloud-based and AI-assisted applications.

  • Troubleshoot escalated cloud, endpoint, identity, and security issues.

  • Document standards, procedures, and operating practices while helping cross-train existing IT resources.

Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, or enterprise systems administration.

  • Strong hands-on Microsoft 365 and Azure experience.

  • Deep experience with Microsoft Intune and endpoint management.

  • Experience with Microsoft 365 E5 security capabilities, including Conditional Access, Defender, and Entra ID.

  • Strong understanding of SSO, identity and access management, device compliance, and endpoint security.

job.title: IT Security Analyst- Remote
job.description:
IT Security Analyst ( Remote) 

Contract Length: 7 Months
Potential Extension: Yes
Pay Rate: $50-$60 hourly W2 

We are seeking an experienced Information Security Advisor to join a growing security advisory team that supports enterprise-wide technology initiatives. This role focuses on providing security guidance, risk assessments, threat modeling, and security architecture recommendations across a diverse technology landscape that includes on-premises, cloud, hybrid, and SaaS environments.

This is an excellent opportunity to work on large-scale transformation initiatives, including cloud adoption and modernization efforts, while partnering with business and technology teams to ensure security is embedded throughout the project lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities
  • Provide security guidance during the planning, design, development, and implementation of technology solutions.
  • Conduct Threat Risk Assessments (TRAs) and threat modeling activities for applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and enterprise initiatives.
  • Review and assess security controls to ensure alignment with organizational standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Perform security advisory reviews for complex applications, platforms, and network environments.
  • Analyze security risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Support cloud initiatives by providing quality assurance reviews of threat assessments and security architecture designs.
  • Collaborate with technology, infrastructure, development, and business teams to implement secure-by-design principles.
  • Evaluate existing security solutions and recommend enhancements to address emerging threats and evolving business needs.
  • Review vulnerability reports, validate security controls, and assess remediation plans.
  • Provide guidance on security policies, standards, and best practices.
  • Support security posture reviews and ensure appropriate security controls are implemented and maintained.
  • Conduct industry research and benchmarking to identify emerging threats, trends, and mitigation strategies.
  • Build strong relationships with business stakeholders and provide ongoing security consultation.
Required Qualifications
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience performing security assessments for applications, infrastructure, and network environments.
  • 3+ years of experience conducting Threat Risk Assessments and threat modeling across on-premises, cloud, hybrid, and SaaS environments.
  • 2+ years of experience in security architecture, security engineering, software development, or hands-on implementation of security solutions.
  • 3+ years of experience reviewing vulnerability reports, validating control effectiveness, and assessing server hardening requirements.
  • Strong understanding of U.S. regulatory requirements and security compliance practices.
  • Experience identifying security risks and providing practical remediation recommendations.
  • Strong knowledge of application security controls, compensating controls, and security best practices.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with ServiceNow.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CRISC, or similar.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and standards including:
    • NIST 800-53
    • ISO 27001 / ISO 27002
    • ISO 27017 / ISO 27018
    • PCI DSS
    • CIS Controls
Desired Skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex security concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong documentation and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
Education
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  • Equivalent combination of education and professional experience will be considered.

We’re seeking a contractor to support FR 2052a liquidity reporting execution, including governance and control documentation across technology and report ownership (attestations, issues, change management)

Possibility of extension and conversion to FTE
Location: Hybrid 3x a week in NYC

job.title: Scientist III - Analytical Development
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Scientist III, Analytics – Product Development for our pharmaceutical client in Corona, CA. In this role, you will provide advanced analytical, quality, and laboratory support for pharmaceutical R&D programs focused on the development and approval of generic drug products for U.S. and international markets. The Scientist III will independently perform analytical testing, method development and validation, laboratory investigations, technical documentation, and regulatory support while collaborating with internal Product Development teams, CROs, and CMOs. The ideal candidate will bring extensive pharmaceutical R&D experience, strong analytical chemistry expertise, and a thorough understanding of FDA, ICH, cGMP, and cGLP requirements.

Industry: Pharmaceutical / Product Development
Location: Corona, CA
Compensation: 80k + ; based upon experience
Type: Direct Hire

Job Functions
  • Independently perform analytical testing with limited or no supervision and communicate results to management within established timelines.
  • Perform testing of raw materials, in-process samples, finished products, and stability samples using compendial and non-compendial methods.
  • Perform analytical method development, evaluation, validation, and verification utilizing HPLC, GC, and other laboratory techniques.
  • Conduct analytical testing using wet chemistry, spectrometry, chromatography, physical testing, and other applicable techniques.
  • Operate analytical instrumentation including HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, balances, and other laboratory equipment.
  • Accurately document all laboratory testing in accordance with Good Documentation Practices, company policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Write, review, and execute analytical study plans, protocols, and reports.
  • Develop and review method development, method validation, and technology transfer protocols and reports.
  • Author technical documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies, guidance documents, validation protocols, and method transfer documentation.
  • Review laboratory notebooks, instrument logbooks, calculations, and data entries for accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
  • Conduct thorough laboratory investigations of Out-of-Specification (OOS), Out-of-Trend (OOT), and other aberrant analytical results.
  • Determine root causes of laboratory investigations, develop and implement appropriate Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs), and prepare investigation reports.
  • Review Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) documentation and related analytical documents for regulatory submissions.
  • Perform gap assessments of CMC and analytical documentation and provide recommended courses of action to management.
  • Support cGMP, cGLP, and safety audits conducted by FDA, OSHA, client companies, and other regulatory organizations.
  • Maintain familiarity and compliance with applicable FDA, ICH, and other regulatory guidelines and requirements.
  • Perform preventive maintenance, calibration, and qualification of laboratory equipment and analytical instruments.
  • Maintain laboratory Quality Systems related to samples, standards, reagents, equipment qualification, preventive maintenance, periodic calibration, stability chambers, and controlled-environment storage cabinets.
  • Collaborate with internal Product Development teams, CROs, and CMOs to establish timelines, understand analytical work requests, identify and resolve issues, and communicate results.
  • Support study design and ensure analytical development and technology transfer activities are completed in accordance with regulatory requirements and established timelines.
  • Provide effective and timely analytical support for R&D activities associated with the development and approval of generic drug products for U.S. and international markets.
  • Prepare sample and standard reconciliation reports and other analytical reports as required.
  • Support QC data management activities, including data review and control charting.
  • Utilize Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and related applications for data analysis, technical documentation, and communication.
  • Maintain strict adherence to laboratory compliance and safety programs.
  • Maintain a clean and safe laboratory environment, including proper cleaning and storage of laboratory equipment and glassware.
  • Perform additional laboratory activities and responsibilities as assigned by management.
Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biological Sciences, or a related scientific discipline required.
  • Minimum of five (5) to ten (10) years of relevant Pharmaceutical R&D experience with demonstrated accomplishments.
  • Strong expertise in analytical chemistry principles, methodologies, and laboratory techniques.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, wet chemistry, spectrometry, chromatography, and related analytical instrumentation.
  • Demonstrated experience with analytical method development, evaluation, validation, verification, and technology transfer.
  • Strong knowledge of laboratory Quality Systems, safety requirements, and laboratory support processes.
  • Thorough familiarity with FDA and ICH guidelines and other applicable pharmaceutical regulatory requirements.
  • Knowledge of cGMP and cGLP requirements within a pharmaceutical R&D environment.
  • Experience conducting and documenting OOS, OOT, and aberrant result investigations, including root cause analysis and CAPA.
  • Experience reviewing CMC and analytical documentation supporting regulatory submissions.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently write SOPs, policies, guidance documents, analytical study plans, protocols, and technical reports.
  • Strong understanding of pharmaceutical terminology, laboratory operations, and regulatory expectations.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external partners, including CROs and CMOs.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and complete assignments with limited supervision.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and similar applications.
  • Familiarity with pharmaceutical information systems, computers, office equipment, and related administrative procedures.
Physical Job Requirements
  • Pharmaceutical R&D laboratory and office environment.
  • Regularly required to perform hands-on analytical laboratory testing and operate analytical instrumentation and equipment.
  • Regular handling of laboratory samples, standards, reagents, chemicals, and glassware in accordance with established safety procedures.
  • Regular use of computers and related systems for data analysis, technical documentation, and communication.
  • Must be able to maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory workspace while adhering to laboratory safety and compliance requirements.

job.title: Laboratory Technician II – Medical Devices (2nd Shift)
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Laboratory Technician II for our medical device manufacturing client. In this role, you will be responsible for performing laboratory testing, environmental monitoring, equipment calibration, and quality control activities to support manufacturing operations. The Laboratory Technician II will conduct chemical, biological, and physical testing of medical devices, support sterilization processes, maintain laboratory equipment and documentation, and ensure compliance with established quality and safety procedures. The ideal candidate will have hands-on laboratory experience within a medical device, pharmaceutical, or nutraceutical manufacturing environment, strong attention to detail, and the ability to maintain accurate and complete laboratory records.

Industry: Medical Device Manufacturing
Location: Santa Fe Springs, CA (100% Onsite)
Schedule: Second Shift, 2:40 PM–11:10 PM
Compensation: $25–$28/hr based upon experience
Type: Direct Hire

Job Functions
  • Perform routine laboratory testing, sampling, measuring, recording, and analysis of biological, chemical, and physical materials.
  • Calibrate laboratory testing equipment and maintain accurate equipment calibration and maintenance records.
  • Operate autoclave equipment to perform steam sterilization processes.
  • Conduct environmental monitoring of cleanroom facilities in accordance with established procedures.
  • Prepare and mix chemical solutions used in laboratory and manufacturing processes.
  • Perform daily Quality Control (QC) checks of in-process batch mixing and passivation chemistry.
  • Prepare materials and product loads for Ethylene Oxide (EO) and gamma sterilization.
  • Coordinate the submission of test samples to external laboratories and retrieve testing reports.
  • Perform analytical and microbiological testing of medical devices, including:
    • Total Organic Carbon (TOC)
    • pH testing
    • Optical Density (OD)
    • Osmolality
    • Viscosity
    • Bioburden
    • Bacterial Endotoxin Testing (BET)
  • Maintain laboratory supply inventory to ensure materials and equipment are available for testing activities.
  • Perform package visual inspections, seal strength testing, and package integrity testing.
  • Accurately document laboratory testing results, equipment maintenance, and Quality Control activities in accordance with Good Documentation Practices (GDP).
  • Ensure laboratory records are complete, accurate, legible, and maintained according to established procedures.
  • Read and interpret technical drawings, written instructions, and laboratory procedures.
  • Communicate effectively with supervisors and team members, follow instructions carefully, and escalate unexpected testing results or laboratory issues as appropriate.
  • Ensure laboratory activities are performed according to established procedures and health and safety guidelines.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory work environment.
  • Comply with all company policies, procedures, safety regulations, and Quality System requirements.
  • Understand and adhere to the company's Quality Policy.

Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Education and experience commensurate with the responsibilities of the position.
  • Minimum of one (1) to three (3) years of laboratory experience within the nutraceutical, medical device, or pharmaceutical industry.
  • Experience performing laboratory testing, Quality Control inspections, and analytical measurements.
  • Familiarity with laboratory equipment calibration, preventive maintenance, and documentation.
  • Experience with chemical preparation, environmental monitoring, or sterilization processes.
  • Familiarity with laboratory testing techniques such as TOC, pH, optical density, osmolality, viscosity, bioburden, or bacterial endotoxin testing.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical drawings, written instructions, procedures, and laboratory documentation.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain complete, accurate, and legible testing results, measurements, and laboratory records.
  • Understanding of Good Documentation Practices (GDP), laboratory SOPs, and quality system requirements.
  • Basic mathematical skills, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, percentages, and accurate material counts.
  • Ability to interpret and follow written, verbal, and diagram-based instructions.
  • Effective verbal communication and active listening skills, with the ability to follow directions and respond to questions from supervisors and management.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to maintain laboratory supplies, equipment, and documentation.
  • Ability to perform assigned laboratory tasks while following established quality and safety procedures.

Physical Job Requirements
  • Laboratory, cleanroom, and medical device manufacturing environment.
  • Occasionally required to stand, walk, reach with hands and arms, talk, and hear while performing laboratory activities.
  • Ability to occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Regular handling of laboratory samples, chemicals, glassware, and testing equipment in accordance with established safety procedures.
  • Must be able to follow applicable laboratory safety, cleanroom, and manufacturing procedures.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

job.title: Senior Angular UI Developer
job.description:
Job Title: Senior Angular UI Developer
Location: Jersey City, NJ - 3 days onsite
Type: Full Time
Salary: $150000/yr - $175000/yr


Our client is a mission-driven financial institution that enables access to capital for agriculture and rural America. Through the issuance of debt securities and the delivery of critical financial and technology services, the Corporation provides dependable credit and financial services nationwide.
 
About the Role: Seeking a hands-on Senior Angular UI Developer to build secure, responsive, and accessible enterprise web applications. This individual contributor will collaborate with Product, UX, Architecture, QA, and backend teams to deliver intuitive user experiences using Angular, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.

The developer will build and enhance applications that support the Funding Corporation’s financial and operational processes. The primary users are internal and external business and technology teams, and the applications support critical workflows related to debt issuance, funding operations, and enterprise services.

The successful candidate will contribute to the modernization of established enterprise applications, with an initial focus on strengthening secure, reusable Angular architecture and improving critical financial and operational workflows. The current front-end environment includes Angular-based applications integrated with enterprise services, and the team’s near-term goals include delivering production-ready features, improving performance and accessibility, and expanding consistent engineering standards across the platform.
Key Responsibilities

Application Development
  • Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise single-page applications using Angular 16+ and TypeScript, including standalone components, services, guards, interceptors, and reusable UI modules.
Enterprise UI Architecture
  • Define scalable front-end patterns for routing, forms, state management, API integration, and component composition while contributing to architectural decisions and technical standards.
Data & Grid Development
  • Build and optimize AG Grid Enterprise solutions for large datasets, including filtering, editing, validation, exports, and real-time updates.
API & Service Integration
  • Integrate REST APIs using typed request and response models, reusable service abstractions, and centralized error handling, logging, and retry patterns.
Authentication & Authorization
  • Implement secure Keycloak authentication and authorization using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, RBAC, route and permission guards, token refresh, session management, and cross-tab logout handling.
State Management
  • Build maintainable reactive state solutions using Angular Signals, RxJS, Observables, and BehaviorSubjects, with attention to performance and scalability.
Forms & Validation
  • Build accessible, dynamic forms with reusable validation, conditional logic, and Reactive Forms; use Template-Driven Forms where appropriate.
Real-Time Communications
  • Develop responsive, event-driven interfaces using STOMP, WebSockets, SharedWorker, and cross-tab communication patterns.
  Requirements Qualification & Experience
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of professional front-end development experience, including at least 5 years building enterprise applications with Angular.

job.description:
Title::  Desktop Support Engineer
Location:  Jersey City, NJ
Type: Hybrid ( 3 days onsite)
Terms - 3 Months Contract to Hire
Pay Rate:  $50/hr-$55/hr
Salary: $95K-$120K base+ 10% Bonus
                  

The team is looking to add a Level 2/Level 3 Desktop Support Engineerto support a rapidly growing user base that has more than doubled over the past year.
The role is heavily focused on supporting Windows 11 laptops, Citrix-hosted VDI, Microsoft Intune, and Microsoft 365.

The individual will serve as the primary point of contact for endpoint issues, troubleshoot problems, perform deployments, onboard and offboard users, and escalate infrastructure issues to specialized teams when necessary.

  • Strong experience supporting Windows 11 desktops and laptops.
  • Hands-on administration and support of Microsoft Intune (device deployment, Autopilot, endpoint management, onboarding/offboarding).

  • Level 2/Level 3 desktop troubleshooting experience.

  • Mobile device management for iPhones, iPads, and Android devices through Intune.

Soft Skills They Are Looking For
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills.
  • Comfortable supporting everyone from executives and C-level leadership to end users.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical abilities.
  • Ability to work independently in a small team.
  • Adaptable with a willingness to learn new technologies.
  • Calm under pressure during mission-critical production issues.
  • Follows documented procedures and delivers consistent solutions.

job.title: Cloud Architect – Microsoft Azure & Google Cloud
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting opportunity for a Cloud Architect – Microsoft Azure & Google Cloud to join a growing enterprise organization modernizing its infrastructure and expanding its cloud capabilities. This is a hands-on architecture role responsible for developing cloud strategy, establishing technical standards, guiding implementations, and helping the organization transition from on-premises infrastructure to a secure multi-cloud environment.

The ideal candidate will be strongest in Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365, with meaningful experience across Google Cloud, identity, security, governance, enterprise applications, and cloud modernization.

Title: Cloud Architect – Microsoft Azure & Google Cloud
Compensation: $230,000–$280,000 base salary + bonus
Type: Direct Hire
Location: Remote or hybrid; Southern California and West Coast candidates preferred
Travel: Occasional travel to regional offices
Industry: Financial Services / Data Center

Responsibilities
  • Develop and execute cloud architecture strategies across Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud.

  • Establish standards for cloud governance, security, identity, networking, monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and application hosting.

  • Design and manage Azure subscriptions, resource groups, policies, landing zones, networking, and identity services.

  • Establish Google Cloud organizational structures, IAM, organization policies, networking, billing, and hosting standards.

  • Lead Microsoft 365 architecture and security initiatives, including Entra ID, Conditional Access, Defender, Purview, and Intune.

  • Develop a roadmap for transitioning workloads from on-premises infrastructure to cloud platforms.

  • Provide architecture and implementation guidance for new cloud-based and AI-assisted applications.

  • Support enterprise application, ERP, and Dynamics 365 hosting or integration initiatives.

  • Define best practices for SSO, identity and access management, secrets management, monitoring, patching, and compliance.

  • Evaluate technical designs and remain hands-on during implementation, troubleshooting, and proof-of-concept work.

  • Partner with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable, secure cloud solutions.

  • Serve as a senior technical resource and help guide, mentor, and cross-train infrastructure engineers.

  • Drive innovation and make recommendations regarding future cloud capabilities and platform investments.

Qualifications
  • 8+ years of experience in cloud architecture, infrastructure engineering, or enterprise technology.

  • Deep hands-on experience designing and implementing Microsoft Azure environments.

  • Strong Microsoft 365 architecture and security experience, including Entra ID, Conditional Access, Defender, Purview, and Intune.

  • Meaningful experience with Google Cloud Platform and Google Workspace.

  • Strong knowledge of cloud networking, identity, governance, security, monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and migration planning.

  • Experience with Azure Arc, hybrid-cloud environments, patching, and enterprise infrastructure modernization.

  • Experience supporting ERP platforms, enterprise applications, or Dynamics 365 is preferred.

  • Experience working with AI-assisted application development or helping business teams adopt AI-enabled solutions is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable being hands-on and implementing solutions rather than focusing exclusively on strategy or documentation.

  • Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Able to work independently, challenge assumptions, and provide direction in a lean, growing organization.

job.title: Scientist / Senior Scientist
job.description:
Yoh is seeking a Senior Scientist, Analytical Validation – NGS & Molecular Diagnostics for an exciting opportunity with an innovative biotechnology client in the South Bay Area.

This role will be responsible for designing, executing, analyzing, and documenting analytical validation studies supporting advanced molecular diagnostic and next-generation sequencing (NGS) assays. The successful candidate will play a key role in establishing assay performance, reproducibility, robustness, and readiness for future clinical and regulatory milestones.

We are looking for a scientist who combines strong molecular biology expertise with analytical rigor, statistical thinking, and hands-on experience in cell-free nucleic acid workflows, NGS technologies, and regulated assay development environments.

Department: Assay Development / Research & Development
Location: Sunnyvale, CA
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: $160,000 - $220,000 (DOE)

Responsibilities:

Analytical Validation Strategy & Execution
  • Design and execute analytical validation studies for molecular diagnostic assays and NGS-based testing platforms.
  • Develop scientifically sound study designs, acceptance criteria, sample size calculations, and statistical analysis plans.
  • Lead studies evaluating:
    • Limit of Blank (LoB), Limit of Detection (LoD), and Limit of Quantitation (LoQ), as applicable
    • Analytical sensitivity and specificity
    • Repeatability and reproducibility
    • Operator, instrument, reagent lot, and workflow variability
    • Method comparison and analytical agreement
    • Interference, contamination, carryover, and assay robustness
    • Specimen and reagent stability
  • Identify assay failure modes and implement corrective actions to improve performance and reliability.
Molecular Biology & NGS Assay Development
  • Perform and optimize workflows involving plasma processing, cell-free nucleic acid extraction, quantification, and quality assessment.
  • Execute NGS library preparation workflows including:
    • End repair
    • Adapter ligation
    • Indexing
    • Amplification
    • Target enrichment
    • Library quality control
  • Evaluate the impact of DNA input quantity, library efficiency, sequencing depth, and molecular background noise on assay performance.
  • Develop and qualify controls, reference materials, and test specimens for validation studies.
  • Support characterization of low-abundance molecular signals and assay sensitivity limits.
NGS Data Analysis & Performance Assessment
  • Operate and troubleshoot NGS instrumentation and associated workflows.
  • Analyze sequencing and library quality metrics, including:
    • Read depth
    • Coverage uniformity
    • Mapping performance
    • Library complexity
    • Duplication rates
    • On-target performance
  • Collaborate with bioinformatics teams to evaluate analytical pipeline performance and quality-control thresholds.
  • Perform statistical analyses using tools such as R, Python, JMP, SAS, or equivalent platforms.
  • Generate technical summaries, validation reports, and performance assessments.
Automation & Workflow Optimization
  • Partner with automation engineers to transfer molecular workflows onto automated liquid-handling platforms.
  • Evaluate variability introduced by automation and support workflow qualification activities.
  • Assess contamination control strategies, sample tracking systems, and recovery procedures.
  • Support high-throughput laboratory process development and operational scale-up.
  • Contribute to SOP development, troubleshooting guides, and workflow documentation.
Quality & Regulatory Support
  • Author validation protocols, reports, deviation investigations, and technical documentation.
  • Maintain traceable documentation for samples, instrumentation, reagents, software, and analytical methods.
  • Support quality-system initiatives and documentation practices consistent with regulated laboratory environments.
  • Collaborate with Quality and Regulatory teams on validation strategies, verification activities, design controls, and submission-support documentation.
Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Work closely with assay development, bioinformatics, automation, clinical, quality, and regulatory teams.
  • Present study results, technical findings, and recommendations to project stakeholders.
  • Lead technical investigations and support risk mitigation activities.
  • Contribute to assay development strategy, validation planning, and project execution.
Required Qualifications:
  • Ph.D. in Molecular Biology, Genetics, Genomics, Biochemistry, Bioengineering, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with cell-free nucleic acid workflows, liquid biopsy technologies, or low-input molecular assays.
  • Strong background in NGS library preparation, sequencing workflows, and molecular assay development.
  • Experience designing and executing analytical validation studies for molecular assays or NGS-based products.
  • Working knowledge of:
    • Analytical sensitivity and specificity
    • LoB, LoD, and LoQ studies
    • Precision and reproducibility assessments
    • Interference and robustness testing
    • Statistical study design and analysis
  • Experience analyzing complex experimental data and applying appropriate statistical methodologies.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, experimental design, and scientific communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a multidisciplinary environment.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience supporting development or validation of liquid biopsy, cell-free DNA (cfDNA), or other advanced molecular diagnostic assays.
  • Experience with targeted sequencing, low-frequency variant detection, DNA methylation analysis, or related technologies.
  • Familiarity with FDA-regulated diagnostic development programs and analytical validation frameworks.
  • Knowledge of CLSI guidance and quality-system requirements applicable to molecular diagnostics.
  • Experience with laboratory automation and liquid-handling systems.
  • Proficiency in R, Python, JMP, SAS, or similar analytical tools.
  • Experience with design controls, risk management, CAPA, method transfer, and assay lifecycle management.
  • Experience supporting medium- to high-throughput laboratory operations.
