job.title: Scientist II, Analytical Product Development
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Scientist II, Analytics – Product Development for our pharmaceutical client in Corona, CA. In this role, you will provide analytical support for pharmaceutical product development programs, helping advance the development and approval of generic drug products for U.S. and international markets. The Scientist II will perform analytical testing, method development, validation and verification, laboratory equipment maintenance, technical documentation, and data review while collaborating with internal product development teams, CROs, and CMOs. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in analytical chemistry and hands-on experience with HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, and other pharmaceutical laboratory techniques.

Industry: Pharmaceutical / Product Development
Location: Corona, CA
Compensation: $65,000 - $75,000 per year; based upon experience
Type: Direct Hire

Job Functions
  • Perform analytical testing of raw materials, in-process samples, finished products, and stability samples using compendial and non-compendial methods.
  • Perform method development, evaluation, validation, and verification using HPLC, GC, and other analytical laboratory techniques.
  • Utilize analytical techniques including wet chemistry, spectrometry, chromatography, and physical testing.
  • Perform testing using instrumentation including HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, balances, and other laboratory equipment.
  • Accurately document laboratory testing according to Good Documentation Practices (GDP), company procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Analyze testing results and communicate findings to management in a timely manner.
  • Write, review, and execute study plans, analytical protocols, validation protocols, technical transfer protocols, and associated reports.
  • Author technical documents including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), method validation protocols/reports, and method transfer protocols/reports.
  • Review laboratory documentation, including notebooks and instrument logbooks, for calculations, data entry accuracy, and regulatory compliance.
  • Perform preventive maintenance, calibration, qualification, and routine monitoring of laboratory equipment and analytical instruments.
  • Maintain laboratory Quality Systems related to samples, standards, reagents, equipment qualification, preventive maintenance, periodic calibration, stability chambers, and controlled-environment storage cabinets.
  • Prepare sample and standard reconciliation reports and other laboratory reports as required.
  • Assist with analytical data management, including data review and control charting.
  • Collaborate with internal product development teams, CROs, and CMOs to establish timelines, understand analytical work requests, resolve technical issues, and communicate results.
  • Support the creation of study designs, method development protocols and reports, and technology transfer protocols and reports.
  • Provide timely analytical support for R&D activities associated with the development and approval of generic pharmaceutical products for U.S. and international markets.
  • Utilize Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and related software for data analysis, technical documentation, and communication.
  • Maintain strict compliance with laboratory procedures and applicable compliance programs.
  • Maintain a clean and safe laboratory work environment, including proper cleaning and storage of laboratory equipment and glassware.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as assigned by management.
Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in a science-related field required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of three (3) to six (6) years of relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of one (1) year of experience in a relevant area of Pharmaceutical R&D.
  • Strong knowledge of basic analytical chemistry principles and techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with analytical instrumentation and techniques, including HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, wet chemistry, chromatography, and spectrometry.
  • Experience with analytical method development, validation, verification, and/or method transfer.
  • Familiarity with pharmaceutical R&D environments, terminology, procedures, and regulatory expectations.
  • Knowledge of Good Documentation Practices and laboratory compliance requirements.
  • Experience preparing and reviewing analytical protocols, reports, SOPs, and other technical documentation.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and similar programs.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external partners, including CROs and CMOs.
  • Ability to organize and manage analytical activities while meeting established project timelines.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate laboratory documentation and data integrity.

job.title: Product Data & Digital Operations Specialist - W2 contract opportunity
job.description:
Product Data & Digital Operations Specialist - EST hours!

  • 12-Month Contract
  • Fully Remote (Must Be Able to Work EST Hours)
  • 40 Hours per Week
  • Pay Rate: $35-$40/hour on W2
  • Candidates must be authorized to work directly on a W2 basis without sponsorship. No C2C arrangements.

Summary Sony Electronics is seeking a detail-oriented and technically minded Product Data & Digital Operations Specialist to support the management and governance of product information, digital assets, content syndication, and launch operations across multiple business systems.

This role serves as a key operational resource for maintaining product data accuracy, supporting new product launches, managing content syndication feeds, coordinating downstream integrations, and ensuring data consistency across various platforms.
The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, comfortable working with large datasets, and excels at coordinating activities across business, technical, and vendor teams.

Key Responsibilities Product Information Management (PIM)
  • Support day-to-day administration and maintenance of the Pimcore platform.
  • Execute product setup, updates, validation, and lifecycle management activities.
  • Review and maintain product attributes, specifications, images, documents, and marketing assets.
  • Monitor data quality and identify inconsistencies across systems.
  • Assist in governance and process improvement initiatives related to product data.
Product Launch Management
  • Support launch readiness activities, including embargo management, feed refreshes, testing, validation, and go-live support.
  • Track launch status and escalate issues impacting launch schedules.
  • Partner with business units to ensure timely availability of product content and assets.
Content Syndication Operations
  • Support onboarding and setup of new SKUs and product pages.
  • Monitor syndication feeds and investigate content delivery issues.
  • Coordinate with external vendors and retailers to resolve content discrepancies.
  • Assist in testing and validation of syndicated content updates.
Downstream System Support
  • Investigate and troubleshoot issues impacting data flow to internal downstream systems and syndication partners.
  • Coordinate with technical teams and vendors to drive issue resolution.
Operational Reporting & Analysis
  • Analyze product data quality trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Assist with audits, cleanup initiatives, and process documentation.
  • Maintain SOPs, workflows, and operational guides.
Cross-Functional Coordination
  • Serve as a liaison between business units, marketing, service, operations, IT, vendors, and offshore support teams.
  • Participate in project meetings and provide operational support for system enhancements.
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT) and deployment validation activities.
  • Assist in gathering and documenting business requirements.
Required Qualifications Education
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Information Systems, Digital Operations, or a related field.
Experience
  • 3-5 years of experience supporting digital commerce, product information management, content operations, or related disciplines.
  • Experience working with product databases, content management systems, or PIM platforms.
  • Experience supporting product launches or operational programs.
  • Experience working across multiple stakeholders and departments.
Technical Skills
  • Experience with product data management or content platforms.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and data analysis.
  • Familiarity with APIs, data feeds, data imports, and system integrations.
  • Experience working with digital asset management systems.

job.title: GPU Infrastructure Support Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: AI Infrastructure Support Engineer
Location: New York, NY
Type - Hybrid 4 days Onsite
Terms; Full Time
Salary- $140000/yr - $170000/yr


Our client provides a range of financial products and services in the United States and internationally. It operates through Securities Services, Market and Wealth Services, Investment and Wealth Management, and Other segments. The Securities Services segment offers custody, trust and depositary, accounting, exchange-traded funds, middle-office solutions, transfer agency, services for private equity and real estate funds, foreign exchange, securities lending, liquidity/lending services, and data analytics.

In this role, you'll make an impact in the following ways: 

  • Deliver operational support and drive issue resolution for AI infrastructure, GPU platforms, and associated production services.
  • Support the deployment, orchestration, and monitoring of AI/ML workloads across distributed environments using Kubernetes and Docker.
  • Apply hands-on expertise with NVIDIA GPU infrastructure, including A100, H100, and B200 nodes, to support provisioning, utilization, performance tuning, and ongoing platform operations.
  • Build, maintain, and optimize automation scripts and tooling using Ansible, Python and Shell scripting to improve efficiency and reliability.
  • Manage incidents, service requests, and change activity through enterprise workflow and ticketing platforms such as JIRA and ServiceNow.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams across engineering, platform, and operations to implement DevOps best practices, including CI/CD using GitLab, containerized deployment models, and secure access management through Azure AD.
  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation, including runbooks, standard operating procedures, support guides, and infrastructure architecture artifacts.
  • Diagnose and resolve networking, storage, and system performance issues affecting AI infrastructure and high-performance compute workloads.
  • Participate in a rotating on-call support model, including occasional weekend coverage, to help maintain high availability and operational excellence.
 

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong experience supporting AI infrastructure, GPU platforms, or high-performance compute environments in enterprise or production settings.
  • Hands-on experience working with NVIDIA GPU nodes, including A100, H100, and B200 systems.
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes and Docker for deploying, managing, and troubleshooting distributed workloads.
  • Proficiency in Ansible,  Python and Shell scripting for automation, tooling, and operational support tasks.
  • Experience with DevOps practices and tools, including GitLab CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and container-based delivery models.
  • Familiarity with enterprise ticketing and service management platforms such as JIRA and ServiceNow.
  • Good knowledge of networking, storage, Linux systems administration, and infrastructure troubleshooting in complex technical environments.
  • Understanding of identity and access management, including secure access controls such as Azure AD.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes and collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Willingness to participate in on-call rotations and provide occasional weekend support as needed.

job.title: Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability
job.description:
Job Title: Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability
Type: Full Time
Location: Holmdel, NJ
Salary: $180000 + bonus



Position Summary The Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability is responsible for defining and executing the enterprise observability strategy, operating model, and platform roadmap that enable proactive, predictive, and resilient technology operations.

This leader owns the enterprise capabilities for monitoring, telemetry, event intelligence, operational analytics, and observability engineering, ensuring technology services are observable, measurable, actionable, and continuously improving.
The role serves as the operational intelligence leader across Enterprise Technology, providing the platforms, standards, insights, and governance required to improve service reliability, accelerate issue detection and resolution, and support modern operational practices.
This leader partners closely with infrastructure, cloud, middleware, application, security, resiliency, and service management teams to build a unified enterprise-wide observability capability.

Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Observability Strategy
  • Define and execute the enterprise observability vision, strategy, operating model, and multi-year roadmap.
  • Establish standards and governance for monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, telemetry, alerting, and service observability.
  • Lead the evolution of observability capabilities from reactive monitoring toward proactive, predictive, and automated operations.
  • Drive enterprise adoption of modern observability practices, frameworks, and engineering standards.

Observability Platform Ownership
  • Own the strategy, architecture, lifecycle, and operation of enterprise monitoring and observability platforms.
  • Lead platform modernization, tool rationalization, capability expansion, and service offering improvements.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, platform investments, and cost optimization efforts.
  • Ensure scalability, availability, resilience, and ongoing enhancement of observability tooling and services.

Monitoring and Telemetry Services
  • Establish enterprise monitoring and instrumentation standards across infrastructure, cloud, middleware, applications, databases, and digital services.
  • Improve monitoring coverage, telemetry quality, alert effectiveness, signal quality, and operational visibility.
  • Drive adoption of distributed tracing, service dependency mapping, and end-to-end transaction monitoring.
  • Ensure service health and operational data are consistently available across the technology landscape.

Operational Intelligence and AIOps
  • Lead implementation of operational analytics, event intelligence, anomaly detection, predictive insights, and AIOps capabilities.
  • Develop dashboards, scorecards, and reporting that provide actionable operational intelligence to technology leadership.
  • Enable intelligent event correlation, noise reduction, automated diagnostics, and automated operational workflows.
  • Partner with engineering and operations teams to use observability data for continuous improvement and outage prevention.

Reliability and Incident Enablement
  • Partner with technology teams to improve detection, response, recovery, and root cause analysis capabilities.
  • Establish observability practices that improve service reliability, operational resilience, and customer experience.
  • Drive post-incident learning and identification of automation opportunities.
  • Provide enterprise visibility into technology health, performance trends, capacity risks, and reliability risks.

Leadership and Talent Development
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of observability engineers, platform engineers, and operational intelligence specialists.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, operational excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional partnership.
  • Lead organizational adoption of observability best practices through enablement, coaching, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Establish strong partnerships across technology, cybersecurity, architecture, engineering, operations, resiliency, and service management functions.

Qualifications
  • 10+ years of experience in infrastructure operations, platform engineering, observability, reliability engineering, or related technology disciplines.
  • 5+ years of experience leading enterprise-scale engineering or operational teams.
  • Deep expertise in observability platforms, monitoring technologies, telemetry pipelines, logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and operational analytics.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing enterprise monitoring strategies and improving operational reliability at scale.
  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms, hybrid infrastructure, automation, DevOps practices, and modern operational architectures.
  • Experience leading organizational transformation and driving adoption of new operational capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and strategic planning skills.

Success Measures
  • Increased enterprise monitoring and observability coverage.
  • Reduced mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR).
  • Improved signal quality and reduced alert fatigue.
  • Increased adoption of observability standards and platform capabilities.
  • Improved service reliability, operational resilience, and operational efficiency.
  • Expansion of predictive analytics, automation, and AIOps capabilities across Enterprise Technology.

job.title: Senior Market Data Analyst - onsite Boston
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Principal to lead our Market Data and Security Master functions within the Central Data function. This is a hands-on leadership role at the center of the firm’s investment, operations, risk, and technology workflows which involves owning the integrity of reference data that powers trading, portfolio management, performance, valuation, and reporting firmwide.

The firm is undergoing a strategic data transformation, and this role will be central to its success. The successful candidate will be ready to enhance the firm’s market data strategy and contribute meaningfully to broader data quality, data governance, and AI enablement initiatives. They will sit within a small, high-impact team supporting firmwide shared data needs including product master, security master, reference data and vendors, data quality, and data governance. The role combines deep subject matter expertise in financial instrument and market reference data with strong commercial discipline and the relationship-building skills needed to operate as a trusted partner to functional leaders across the firm

Key Responsibilities

Security & Product Master
  • Own end-to-end governance of the firm’s security master, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness across all instruments (equities, fixed income, derivatives, FX). Contribute to the fund master function as needed, including support on setup and review of hedge fund and private market products.
  • Establish and maintain golden-source standards, data models, identifier hierarchies (CUSIP, ISIN, SEDOL, FIGI, LEI, internal IDs), and instrument lifecycle workflows from onboarding through retirement.
  • Define and enforce data quality controls, exception management, and reconciliation processes across the front-to-back data flow; resolve breaks impacting trading, operations, accounting, and risk.
  • Oversee corporate actions, pricing, ratings, classifications, and issuer/entity reference data, including legal entity hierarchies and counterparty data.
Market Data Strategy & Delivery
  • Establish and own the firm’s market data strategy, shaping how the firm sources, integrates, and consumes market data over the coming years.
  • Lead sourcing, integration, and quality assurance of real-time, intraday, and end-of-day market data feeds across asset classes.
  • Manage entitlements and permissioning, ensuring adherence to licensing terms and redistribution policies.
  • Translate evolving investment, trading, and operational data requirements into scalable, well-controlled solutions, working hand-in-hand with the teams that consume the data.
  • Monitor industry trends — new content sets, regulatory changes, and vendor product evolution — and ensure the firm’s market data capabilities stay ahead of business needs.
Data Transformation, Governance & AI Enablement
  • Contribute as a leader to the firm’s broader data transformation agenda, including data quality, data governance, and AI enablement initiatives.
  • Ensure the firm’s reference and market data foundations are fit for purpose to support advanced analytics and AI use cases.
  • Partner with Technology and other Data Management leaders on platform modernization, lineage, metadata, and control frameworks.
Stakeholder Partnership & Delivery Management
  • Build productive relationships with functional leaders across Research, CIO, Operations, Reporting, Risk, Finance, Compliance, and Technology.
  • Establish and maintain a prioritization framework and delivery roadmap that balances competing demands, trade-offs, and aligns the team’s work with business outcomes.
Vendor Management & Budget Stewardship
  • Own commercial relationships with major market and reference data providers. Lead contract negotiation, renewals, and rationalization. Identify opportunities cost savings.
  • Own the market and reference data budget end-to-end including forecasting, tracking actuals against budget, and ROI tracking for new spend.
Required Qualifications
  • 7–10 years of experience in market data and/or reference data within an investment manager, hedge fund, asset owner, or comparable financial services environment.
  • 3+ years management experience
  • Expertise across security master and market data domains. Strong working knowledge of the major market and reference data providers and their content sets across asset classes.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships. Familiarity with market data licensing and usage restrictions.
  • Demonstrated ability to build cross-functional relationships with senior business stakeholders and translate their needs into delivery plans.
  • Experience contributing to or leading data transformation initiatives, including data quality and data governance programs.
  • Deep understanding of instrument data across asset classes, including identifiers, classifications, corporate actions, and pricing.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to operate fluently across business stakeholders, technologists, and vendors.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; finance, economics, computer science, or related field preferred.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Exposure to private markets and alternatives reference data.
  • Experience contributing to AI / ML enablement from a data foundations perspective.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks) and data governance tooling (Collibra, Alation).
  • CFA, CIPM, or DAMA-CDMP certifications viewed favorably.

Job Titile:Senior Help Desk Analyst
Terms - 3 Months contract to Hire
Location : Jersey City, NJ - Hybrid ( 3days onsite)
Industry- Financial

Objective:
Ensure the timely and effective deployment of Windows updates to corporate workstations.  Work with users to ensure hardware and applications on desktops meet their business needs. Work within a small dynamic team and adjust to changing requirements or responsibilities easily and effectively. Respond to help desk requests and other technical problems to ensure that the day-to-day workflow of the Company is uninterrupted.

Responsibility
The position involves dealing with computer and data security on a daily basis.  The organization recognizes its vulnerability to the danger of data corruption or illegal access to our systems.  For this reason, this individual must be of high caliber, honest and conscientious.

  • Test and install Windows desktop updates.
  • Install, configure, maintain, and administer desktops, laptops, printers, and mobile phones.
  • Perform routine tasks within the IS Operations group such as backups, documentation, disaster recovery testing, production releases, system maintenance and integrated troubleshooting throughout the environment.
  • Work effectively with the business users and the Information Services team members.
  • Set and meet project schedules.
  • Ensure desktop efficiency, integrity and security.   

Qualification:

•    University or Technical Trade School degree in a related curriculum.
•    Minimum of five years of Windows Desktop Administration experience.

Success in the position will build on the following skills and personal strengths:

•    Microsoft Windows Desktop Operating Systems on physical hardware or VDI
•    Microsoft Office Application Suite (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
•    Adobe Acrobat
•    Trellix End Point Security
•    Citrix Workspace App
•    Microsoft Configuration Manager/Windows Server Update Services
•    Microsoft Intune
•    Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
•    Ability to solve problems quickly and effectively.
•    Ability to set and meet reasonable project deadlines.

job.title: Process Engineer III
job.description:
Yoh presents an excellent long-term Process Engineer III opportunity with a trusted, long-term client located in Rancho Cordova, CA.
 
This position requires a Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent experience. Schedule is full-time M-F (7am-8am start time, 8 hour shift) and may require flexibility to work some evenings and overtime due to projects.
 
Key Responsibilities:
  • Follows listed PPE requirements and chemical handling requirements, addresses safety issues promptly, and communicates safety issues to fellow employees.
  • Technical lead in PHA and PSSR reviews. Develop safe solutions to encountered safety problems.
  • Uses engineering skills to design projects for enhanced safety, quality and or productivity improvements.
  • Follows cGMP guidelines for operation comments and batch records, other change control requirements, and related documentation practices.
  • Monitors existing processes, ensuring that batch records are maintained, variances are investigated, and day to day activities are properly planned.
  • Conducts product changeovers, preparation of cleaning instruction, and leading in set up operations.
  • Leads in the generation of GMP documentation and operator training, including comments and variances.  Provide technical knowledge to variance and CAPA investigations.
  • Prepares new batch records and work instructions.
  • Troubleshoots processes to reduce downtime, improve cycle time, and increase productivity.
  • Provides team leadership to projects.
  • Activates and qualifies facilities and equipment.
  • Modifies piping and instrumentation drawings, flow sheets, and emission calculations.
  • Independently evaluates, selects, and applies engineering techniques, procedures and criteria using judgement in making adaptations and modifications.
  • Works with senior staff oversight to resolve problems encountered in the manufacturing environment.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.
 
 
Qualifications:
  • 4-9 years of related experience and a bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent required.
  • At least one (1) year of relevant experience in a cGMP environment preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal and verbal communication skills.
  • Must have a high consciousness for personal safety.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Team oriented.
  • Highly motivated and willingness to learn.

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Quality Engineer for our client. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting product and manufacturing quality through inspection and testing strategies, defect analysis, statistical analysis, documentation control, and continuous improvement initiatives. The Quality Engineer will work closely with Development, Product, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to ensure products and processes meet company, customer, and industry quality standards. This position requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify quality issues, develop effective solutions, and drive improvements in a regulated environment.

Industry: Medical Device 
Location: Redondo Beach, CA
Compensation: $99k-104k/yr


Job Functions
  • Review and thoroughly understand product functional and design specifications.
  • Develop and implement methods and procedures for inspecting, testing, and evaluating the precision and accuracy of products and production equipment.
  • Design or specify inspection and testing mechanisms and equipment.
  • Conduct Quality Assurance testing to ensure products meet established requirements.
  • Perform statistical analysis to evaluate products or materials that do not meet required standards and specifications.
  • Conduct defect analysis utilizing statistical quality and process analytical methods.
  • Prepare and maintain Quality reports and support documentation control systems.
  • Review returned materials and verify customer complaints, developing action plans to address identified discrepancies.
  • Communicate with customers regarding Quality issues and resolutions as required.
  • Partner with operators and technicians to identify and resolve day-to-day Quality Assurance issues.
  • Prioritize and manage multiple projects while working within design specifications and budget requirements.
  • Maintain knowledge of evolving Quality Assurance codes, regulations, and industry standards.
  • Document test cases and interpret technical and business objectives.
  • Work closely with Development and Product teams to support Quality initiatives.
  • Identify software bugs and support appropriate testing and resolution activities.
  • Recommend changes and improvements to enhance overall product quality.
  • Ensure products comply with company and applicable industry Quality standards.
  • Develop and implement systems that promote conformity and accuracy throughout the production process.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop solutions for identified Quality and product issues.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management.

Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering required; Master's degree in Engineering preferred.
  • Professional certifications or 10+ years of equivalent work experience may be considered.
  • Previous experience working in a Quality Assurance environment required.
  • Knowledge of ISO 13485 and applicable EU standards.
  • MDR experience is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Quality Assurance and testing tools.
  • Knowledge of SQL and scripting.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify issues and develop effective solutions.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Physical Job Requirements
  • Full-time, onsite work environment.
  • Regular use of a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other standard office and technical equipment.
  • Ability to work within manufacturing, Quality, and product development environments as required.
  • Must be able to review detailed technical documentation, specifications, test results, and Quality records for extended periods.

job.title: QC Chemical Laboratory Technician
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a QC Laboratory Technician in Port Neches, TX. The QC Laboratory Technician will perform sampling and testing of raw materials, in-process materials, and finished products in a chemical manufacturing environment. Experience with GC, HPLC, wet chemistry, titrations, viscosity testing, and StarLIMS is preferred.

Duration: Temp-to-Hire
Location: Port Neches, TX
Salary Range: $22/hr
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 1st Shift during training for abut 1 month. Then rotating 12-hour day and night shifts; 4:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. / 4:00 p.m.–4:00 a.m.
Industry: Chemical/Polymer Manufacturing


Key Responsibilities
  • Collect samples from all areas of plant operations according to established hourly schedules.
  • Perform chemical and physical testing of raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products.
  • Conduct testing using Gas Chromatography, HPLC, viscosity and rheological-property testing, titrations, chemical extraction techniques, and other wet chemistry methods.
  • Perform color, texture, appearance, and other product consistency analyses.
  • Accurately record test results in StarLIMS or applicable laboratory databases.
  • Apply basic Statistical Process Control and Statistical Quality Control methods to monitor process performance.
  • Complete retesting and additional analyses as required.
  • Communicate product quality concerns, out-of-specification results, and testing updates to shift supervision.
  • Notify laboratory supervision of equipment, testing, documentation, or process issues.
  • Operate, calibrate, troubleshoot, and maintain laboratory equipment, including GC, HPLC, balances, gauges, and precision measuring devices.
  • Conduct basic safety audits of laboratory equipment and work practices.
  • Perform basic mathematical calculations and use laboratory computer applications for data analysis and reporting.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and compliant laboratory and work area.
  • Support plant and laboratory emergency procedures as directed by the Site Emergency Director.
  • Work overtime as needed to provide vacation, illness, staffing, or production coverage.
  • Perform other laboratory-related duties as assigned by management.

Required Qualifications
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Technology, Polymer Science, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of one year of hands-on quality-control laboratory experience; polymer-industry experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience with GC, HPLC, titration, extraction methods, viscosity, or rheological testing.
  • Familiarity with StarLIMS or comparable laboratory information management systems preferred.
  • Proficiency with basic mathematics, computers, data entry, and laboratory reporting.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and work effectively under time pressure.
  • Self-motivated, dependable, flexible, and willing to work rotating shifts.
  • Ability to read and follow written procedures, policies, technical manuals, schedules, training materials, and handwritten or printed instructions.

Physical and Environmental Requirements
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 30 pounds routinely and up to 50 pounds occasionally.
  • Ability to stand for extended periods while performing laboratory testing.
  • Ability to bend, twist, stoop, kneel, reach, and perform fine-manipulation tasks.
  • Ability to collect samples throughout an active manufacturing plant in rain, heat, cold, and other weather conditions.
  • Ability to work in hot areas and around loud process equipment.
  • Ability to wear required PPE, which may include a hard hat, safety glasses, hearing protection, respirator, steel-toed footwear, gloves, or other protective equipment.
  • Ability to maintain good housekeeping practices in the laboratory and plant areas.
  • Ability to respond appropriately during site emergencies.
  • Ability to work rotating 12-hour day and night shifts and overtime when required.

Estimated Max Rate: $22.00

job.title: Lead / Senior Java Angular Spring Developer - NJ - RTH
job.description:
Senior Java Developer:
We are seeking a highly experienced full stack Senior Java Developer to lead the design and development of scalable, high-performance, enterprise-grade full stack application in our BI & Enterprise Reporting team. This role requires deep hands-on expertise in Java/J2EE, API-driven architecture, and modern front-end frameworks (Angular), along with strong architectural and problem-solving skills.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for translating business and technical requirements into robust application designs, driving best practices across the development lifecycle, and ensuring high-quality, secure, and maintainable solutions. This position involves close collaboration with cross-functional teams, mentoring developers, and playing a key role in technical decision-making.

Main areas of responsibilities:
  • Lead the design, development, and implementation of Java-based, full-stack web applications - emphasis on hands on development.
  • Architect and develop API-heavy, service-oriented and microservices-based applications using RESTful and SOAP web services.
  • Design and document Low-Level Designs (LLD) aligned with high-level architectural standards.
  • Apply appropriate design patterns and architectural principles to build scalable, reusable, and maintainable solutions.
  • Develop and promote reusable components and frameworks across multiple applications.
  • Ensure seamless integration between front-end (Angular) and back-end services.
  • Perform code reviews, enforce coding standards, and ensure internal quality assurance for application components.
  • Analyze and resolve complex production issues, often under tight timelines and high-pressure situations.
  • Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, and stakeholders to understand and clarify requirements using tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes in containerized and cloud-native environments.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level developers and provide technical guidance to the development team.
  • Continuously evaluate and recommend improvements to application architecture, performance, and security.


Requirements:

Experience & Skills
  • 10+ years of experience as a Full Stack Java/J2EE Developer, with strong exposure to analysis, design, development, and implementation of enterprise web applications.
  • Proven expertise in applying design patterns and best practices.
  • Strong proficiency in Core Java and object-oriented design principles.
  • Hands-on experience preparing technical documentation, including low-level designs.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to troubleshoot and resolve critical issues in production environments.

Technical Skills
  • Languages: Java, J2EE, XML, SQL
  • Technologies: Core Java, J2EE, Web Services: SOAP and RESTful APIs
  • Web Development: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, Angular 17 or above
  • Tools & Platforms: Jenkins, Jira, IntelliJ IDEA, Apache Tomcat 9, Kubernetes, OpenShift
  • Frameworks: Spring Boot, Hibernate
  • Databases: Oracle (schema design, performance tuning, and efficient SQL development)

job.title: Senior HR Coordinator
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Senior HR Coordinator for our client. In this role, you will provide comprehensive Human Resources support while serving as a resource and mentor to newer HR team members. The Senior HR Coordinator will independently manage more complex HR administrative functions, including leave of absence administration, workers’ compensation, benefits, onboarding, payroll support, compliance reporting, and audit documentation. This position requires strong knowledge of HR regulations, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to handle confidential employee information with professionalism and discretion.

Industry: Human Resources / Life Sciences
Location: Onsite El Monte
Compensation: $60-$62k DOE
Type: Direct Hire


Job Functions
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and handle employee and organizational information with the highest level of discretion.
  • Provide guidance, support, and technical training to Human Resources Coordinators and newer team members.
  • Lead HR projects and initiatives as assigned by Human Resources leadership.
  • Administer the full lifecycle of employee leaves of absence.
  • Administer and coordinate workers’ compensation claims.
  • Respond to employee questions and provide accurate guidance regarding company policies, procedures, and HR practices.
  • Support new-hire onboarding and process employee personnel changes.
  • Assist with timekeeping corrections, attendance tracking, and supporting documentation for payroll processing.
  • Support benefits administration, including open enrollment and processing employee enrollments and changes through applicable benefits portals.
  • Assist with the preparation and administration of employee termination packages.
  • Maintain HR files, records, and reporting documentation required for SOX audits.
  • Provide the Corporate HR Manager with required documentation during internal and external audit processes.
  • Collect and maintain new-hire demographic information, including veteran status, EEO-1 information, and location data, to support compliance reporting.
  • Conduct and support personnel file audits to maintain the accuracy and integrity of employee records.
  • Lead the planning and coordination of HR events and employee-related activities.
  • Ensure HR activities are performed in accordance with applicable labor regulations, HIPAA requirements, wage and hour laws, and company policies.
  • Perform additional duties and HR projects as assigned.

Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of Human Resources administration experience required.
  • Strong knowledge of basic labor regulations, HIPAA compliance requirements, and wage and hour laws.
  • Experience administering employee leaves of absence and workers’ compensation claims.
  • Experience supporting benefits administration, onboarding, payroll/timekeeping, and employee record management.
  • Experience supporting HR compliance reporting and audit documentation.
  • Previous experience with HRIS and payroll systems required; Paycom experience is a plus.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and related applications.
  • Strong written communication skills with excellent grammar and spelling.
  • Excellent verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate confidently and clearly with employees and leadership.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and integrity.
  • Ability to establish priorities, manage multiple responsibilities, and work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to interpret and follow HR policies, procedures, instructions, and compliance requirements.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently resolve routine HR issues.
  • Ability to quickly learn new HR processes, systems, regulations, and procedures.
  • Strong resourcefulness with the ability to identify and utilize appropriate resources to resolve questions and issues.
  • Typing proficiency of 50+ words per minute preferred.

Physical Job Requirements
  • Professional office environment.
  • Regular use of a computer, keyboard, mouse, telephone, and other standard office equipment.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer.
  • Regularly required to communicate with employees, HR team members, and organizational leadership.
  • Ability to maintain and review electronic and physical employee records and documentation.

job.title: Business Analyst with Performance Reporting / Privates-Alts - Boston - Addepar
job.description:
Onsite in Boston
BSA experience with direct performance reporting experience
Privates / alts experience
experience with Addepar or related product would be ideal.    

Job Description / Position Responsibilities
We are seeking a Principal–level Technical Business Analyst to join Transformation Office and play a key role in the delivery of complex portfolio of investment management and reporting projects. This role sits at the intersection of business, product, and technology, requiring strong technical curiosity coupled with structured analysis, delivery ownership and confident stakeholder engagement.

You will operate semi-independently in a high-impact, internal-customer-facing role, working closely with business and technology teams to define, design, and deliver change. Your primary stakeholders will be a range of internal subject matter experts spanning front and middle/back office teams plus Data and Technology delivery leads

Key Responsibilities include:
  • Shape business case for major technology spend coordinating with business stakeholders
  • Lead delivery of one or more workstreams in a complex, multi-functional global transformation programme through the complete SDLC, including vendor management
  • Manage stakeholder expectations around progress, requirements gathering, solution definition, constraints, risks, and dependencies clearly and proactively
  • Work with business owners to extract and formally document process flows, business rules, and detailed requirements
  • Research, analyse, and produce impact assessments across teams, systems, and processes
  • Apply a broad range of Business Analysis tools and techniques to ensure clarity, completeness, and shared understanding
  • Work closely with vendor and technology teams to:
    • Document functional designs and sequence diagrams
    • Define work breakdown structures
    • Clearly articulate what needs to be built and tested
  • Shape and contribute to innovative, practical solution designs
  • Integrate business and technical perspectives into a coherent end-to-end solution vision
  • Participate in and drive testing activities including test planning and scripting; test execution and defect triage
  • Identify and communicate technical constraints, risks, and dependencies impacting delivery
  • Lead change management efforts to drive adoption, including defining and implementing KPI / OKRs post implementation
 

Attributes / Required Skills
  • 7-10 years’ experience as a Technical Business Analyst, Project Manager, or hybrid PM/BA in a technology or software delivery environment
  • Hands-on delivery experience on projects involving Addepar (highly desirable), Total Plan Manager (aka Burgiss Caissa), Canoe Intelligence, Simcorp Dimension, Geneva, etc.
  • Strong experience designing and implementing alternatives or private markets workflows across hedge funds, private equity, private debt, fund of funds and so on
  • Large project experience through full SDLC, adept at Agile software delivery
  • The ability to engage and communicate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders of all levels, and coordinate teams of business users and technical staff across multiple locations
  • A curious and analytical approach with the ability to identify areas for process improvements or improving business functionality
  • Preferred but not mandatory: Prior experience within the Financial Services industry at an Outsourced Chief Investment Office (OCIO), Wealth Management, or Asset Management firm or experience working in Alternatives via technology consultancy
  • Ability to understand and query relational databases and programming languages (for example, but not limited to, SQL, Python, Java)
  • Prior experience in building visual mock-ups (for example, but not limited to, using Balsamiq, Lucid, Visio)
  • Proficiency in building process diagrams, creating user stories, building Gantt charts and entity relationship diagrams
  • A strong academic record, or equivalent experience; a Bachelor’s degree is desirable but not essential

job.title: EH&S Specialist
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a EH&S Specialist in Baytown, TX. The EH&S Specialist is responsible for maintaining health, safety, and environmental policies and procedures throughout the chemical warehouse operations. The ideal candidate has experience in ensuring compliance with local, state, and federal regulations, promoting a safe working environment, and minimizing the environmental impact of operations. This position supports the HSEQ Manager in the day-to-day administration, documentation, tracking, and maintenance of the facility’s Environmental, Health, and Safety programs.
 
Title: EH&S Specialist
Duration: Direct Hire
Location: Baytown, TX
Salary Range: $55,000 - 68,000/annual (DOE)
Shift: M-F 8-5pm


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
Environmental Compliance & Reporting
  • Maintain environmental compliance records and documentation in accordance with established EHS programs and procedures.
  • Compile information and prepare routine environmental reports, including supporting documentation for Tier II, TRI, waste reporting, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain chemical inventory records and associated documentation.
  • Maintain environmental compliance calendars and track reporting and renewal deadlines.
  • Maintain records associated with SPCC, stormwater, waste, and other established environmental programs.
  • Organize, and verify data used for regulatory and internal reporting.
  • Ensure environmental documentation remains organized and readily available for audits and regulatory inspections.
  • Escalate upcoming deadlines, discrepancies, or potential compliance concerns to the HSEQ Manager.
Waste Management & Tracing
  • Assist in managing day-to-day hazardous and non-hazardous waste documentation and tracking.
  • Maintain waste profiles, manifests, shipping records, disposal documentation, and related files.
  • Track waste accumulation dates, quantities, shipments, and applicable regulatory timelines.
  • Maintain records for waste characterization and approved disposal profiles.
  • Assist in monitoring established waste accumulation areas and notify the HSEQ Manager of documentation or compliance concerns.
  • Ensure waste documentation is complete and traceable from generation through final disposal.
EHS Records & Data Management
  • Assist in maintaining EHS databases, spreadsheets, compliance records, and established tracking systems.
  • Assist in maintaining OSHA recordkeeping documentation and supporting incident records.
  • Track safety and environmental KPIs and prepare routine reports for review by the HSEQ Manager.
  • Assist in maintaining employee training records and the facility training matrix.
  • Track expiration dates, recurring reporting requirements, and other scheduled EHS administrative obligations.
  • Assist in maintaining current electronic and physical EHS files.
  • Ensure records are accurate, complete, current, and easily retrievable.
Incident & Investigation Documentation
  • Provide administrative and documentation support for incident investigations led by the HSEQ Manager.
  • Organize photographs, statements, records, training documentation, and other investigation materials provided during the investigation process.
  • Assist in maintaining completed investigation files and supporting documentation.
  • Assist in maintaining incident metrics and records for internal and regulatory reporting.
Training Administration
  • Assist in maintaining the facility training matrix and employee training records.
  • Track upcoming and overdue training requirements.
  • Coordinate training schedules and employee attendance.
  • Prepare rosters, materials, records, and documentation for HSEQ Manager -led training.
  • Enter completed training and maintain supporting records.

Required Skills:
  • Minimum of 2-5 years of experience in health, safety, and environmental role, preferably in the chemical or warehousing industry.
  • Strong knowledge of OSHA, EPA, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and analytical skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and HSE management software.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams and enforce safety standards.

job.title: Field Service Engineer
job.description:
As a Field Service Engineer focused you’ll provide expert technical support for our full lineup of lithium-ion aircraft battery, power conversion and other electrical power system products. To be successful in this role, you’ll need to be able to accurately troubleshoot technical issues, while providing a top-notch customer experience.
THIS POSITION MAY BE FOR YOU IF…
•
You have a minimum of 5 years of direct aviation experience and technical support activities in a customer support environment.
•
You have extensive knowledge and understanding of aircraft electrical systems and are skilled at troubleshooting and problem-solving system installation and operation.
•
You are experienced in conducting tests and inspections of aircraft avionics and electrical systems to evaluate field function and operation.
•
You have knowledge of aviation certification requirements and disciplines such as DO-160, DO-254, DO-178, DO-311a as they relate to TSO, Type Certification or Supplemental Type Certification activities.
•
You have experience with FAR Part repair station requirements, FAR Parts 91, 23, 25 operations and current FAA and EASA requirements.
•
You are proficient with Microsoft Office and CRM systems.
•
You have strong attention to detail.
•
You are organized, focused, and results oriented.
•
You are a problem-solver with critical thinking and prioritizing skills.
•
You have excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
•
You are comfortable spending most of the day on the phone at your desk in an open office environment.
WE WOULD REALLY LIKE IT IF… (but it’s not a deal breaker)
•
You have a working familiarity with aircraft instruments and avionics and would be able to provide technical support for those types of products in a backup capacity.
•
You have knowledge of FAA Special Conditions.
•
You have a bachelor’s degree in a related field.
•
You hold a FAA A&P and/or pilot certification.
WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM ONE DAY TO THE NEXT…
Job Description

•
Diagnose customer issues and identify the action required (using company databases, customer information, and collaboration with other departments) to reach resolution
•
Serve as a primary technical interface for support of installation, configuration, operation, and management of products
•
Assist in the development of technical sales presentations to support customer meetings, trade shows, and conferences
•
Monitor field data for reliability trends and proactively coordinate with Quality and Engineering technical teams for root cause analysis and resolution
•
Track and monitor support cases to ensure timely resolution and effective follow through
•
Maintain accurate records of all service and support communications
•
Participate in industry trade shows as required
•
Travel up to 15% to meet business needs

job.title: Senior Revenue Cycle Specialist
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Senior Revenue Cycle Specialist for our healthcare client. In this role, you will be responsible for resolving complex billing and reimbursement issues while maximizing revenue recovery through expert claims analysis, denial management, and payment resolution. The Senior Revenue Cycle Specialist will collaborate with insurance carriers, patients, leadership, and cross-functional teams to ensure timely reimbursement, identify process improvements, and support overall revenue cycle performanc. Experience in Anatomic Pathology or Diagnostic Laboratory billing is required.

Industry:Diagnostics
Location: Onsite / Hybrid (Based on Client Need)

Job Functions
  • Investigate, resolve, and collect payment on complex healthcare billing and reimbursement transactions.
  • Research and resolve unpaid claims, billing discrepancies, denials, and customer complaints to ensure timely and accurate reimbursement.
  • Contact insurance carriers, patients, and other stakeholders to resolve account issues and maximize payment.
  • Review insurance and patient account correspondence to identify outstanding issues and determine appropriate corrective actions.
  • Analyze billing trends and identify recurring reimbursement issues, recommending process improvements to reduce denials and improve collections.
  • Collaborate with leadership and cross-functional teams to develop solutions that improve revenue cycle performance and operational efficiency.
  • Review billing documentation to ensure compliance with payer requirements and regulatory guidelines.
  • Communicate effectively with insurance companies, patients, and internal leadership regarding account status, payment issues, and resolution strategies.
  • Develop and maintain expertise in payer fee schedules, reimbursement methodologies, and denial management.
  • Apply advanced knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payer policies to maximize reimbursement opportunities.
  • Monitor and work aging reports to resolve outstanding accounts receivable and reduce claim aging.
  • Support complex revenue cycle projects and initiatives requiring advanced reimbursement knowledge.

job.title: Director Salesforce CRM Product Strategy
job.description:
Director, Salesforce CRM Product Strategy

Work Arrangement: 4 days per week onsite, occasional travel less than 25%.
Location: McKinney, TX (Hybrid – 4 Days Onsite)
Compensation: $180,000 Base Salary + 20% Annual Target Bonus
Employment Type: Full-Time, Direct Hire

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This position offers the opportunity to influence enterprise-wide Salesforce strategy while remaining actively involved in product decisions and delivery. You will work closely with senior leaders, shape technology investments, and introduce CRM improvements that produce measurable results.

The role is especially well suited for an accomplished Salesforce Product Owner or Product Manager seeking broader strategic responsibility, executive visibility, and ownership of business-critical technology products.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce product leader to guide the evolution of an enterprise CRM environment supporting sales operations, customer engagement, and business growth. This opportunity is ideal for a strategic, hands-on Product Owner who understands how to connect business objectives with technology investments and deliver solutions that improve operational efficiency and customer relationships.

The successful candidate will have extensive experience overseeing Salesforce products, establishing product direction, managing enhancement priorities, and working with technology teams to deliver impactful capabilities. This role combines product strategy, business process optimization, customer analytics, and emerging AI technologies.

This is a senior-level individual contributor position offering significant influence over enterprise technology decisions without direct people-management responsibilities.

What You'll Be Responsible For
  • Direct the strategy, ongoing development, and optimization of Salesforce CRM products supporting sales, customer service, and business operations.
  • Develop and maintain a long-term product roadmap, balancing business priorities, technical considerations, and opportunities for innovation.
  • Own product backlog management, including evaluating enhancement requests, establishing priorities, and coordinating release deliverables.
  • Translate business objectives into detailed functional requirements, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria for technical teams.
  • Partner with software engineers, solution architects, and Agile delivery teams to ensure successful development and deployment of CRM capabilities.
  • Collaborate with business leadership to identify opportunities for process improvements, workflow automation, and improved customer experiences.
  • Use CRM reporting, customer analytics, and data insights to influence product decisions and identify opportunities to increase revenue and sales productivity.
  • Evaluate AI-powered capabilities and customer intelligence solutions that improve sales effectiveness, customer segmentation, and business decision-making.
  • Establish processes for product intake, change management, platform standards, and enhancement prioritization.
  • Monitor system adoption, product performance, business value, and return on technology investments.
  • Coordinate with external technology partners and vendors regarding platform capabilities, licensing, and service delivery.
  • Present product initiatives, delivery progress, investment priorities, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in product management or product ownership, including significant Salesforce CRM experience.
  • Demonstrated ownership of Salesforce product strategy, roadmaps, backlog prioritization, and feature delivery.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud within enterprise business environments.
  • Proven ability to develop detailed user stories, define acceptance criteria, and work directly with software development teams.
  • Experience managing competing business requirements and aligning stakeholders around product priorities.
  • Working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, or similar software development methodologies.
  • Experience using CRM analytics, reporting, dashboards, and customer data to evaluate business performance.
  • Understanding of customer intelligence, AI-enabled CRM capabilities, and data-driven product improvements.
  • Experience implementing product governance, managing platform enhancements, and evaluating business outcomes.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence executive stakeholders and collaborate across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently while managing complex enterprise product initiatives.
Additional Technical Experience Candidates need familiarity with several of the following:

  • Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud
  • Salesforce CRM reporting, dashboards, and analytics
  • Customer Data Platforms (CDP) and customer intelligence solutions
  • Snowflake, SQL, and enterprise data integrations
  • AI-powered customer insights and predictive analytics
  • React-based web applications and integrated CRM experiences
  • Product backlog management, Agile delivery, and requirements documentation
Preferred or Nice to have Skills in Background:

  • Salesforce certifications or product management credentials such as CSPO, CSM, or PSM.
  • Experience supporting B2B sales, distribution, manufacturing, industrial, or other complex commercial organizations.
  • Advanced degree in Business, Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Experience supporting enterprise CRM transformations, product modernization, or customer intelligence initiatives.
  • Demonstrated success improving Salesforce adoption, business processes, revenue performance, or customer engagement through product enhancements.

job.title: Intermediate Semiconductor Manufacturing Techncian-Billerica,MA
job.description:
Intermediate Semiconductor Manufacturing Technician needed for an 6-month contract to hire opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Billerica, Massachusetts.


Pay Rate: $27 to $32 per hour



The Big Picture – Top Skills You Should Possess:
 

  • Solid interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Ability to quickly adapt to change


What You Will Be Doing:
  • As a Manufacturing Technician, you'll work hands-on in a cleanroom environment to build and test our multimillion-dollar display and wafer fabrication equipment 
  • You'll be responsible for building, repairing, and testing various types of equipment--including electrical, electro-mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic assemblies, subassemblies, and components.
  • You will perform electro-mechanical assembly operations, troubleshooting, and repairs-- and perform audits to ensure necessary parts are available and inspected for defects.
  • Using test fixtures, electronic measurement equipment, leak detectors, and vacuum pumps you'll test assemblies, complete documentation, perform repairs, or install software to continuously improve our processes
  • Has developed proficiency in a range of processes or procedures through job-related training and considerable on-the-job experience.
  • Completes a variety of atypical assignments, as needed. Works within defined processes and procedures or methodologies and may help determine the appropriate approach for new assignments.
  • Completes work with a limited degree of supervision. Likely to act as an informal resource for colleagues with less experience.
  • Use work orders (including schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and instructions) to build, repair and/or test equipment of various kinds (electrical, electro-mechanical, vacuum, pneumatic assemblies, subassemblies and components)
  • Perform a wide variety of electro-mechanical assembly operations, troubleshooting and repairs
  • Receive parts and perform audits to ensure all necessary parts are available; inspect parts for defects; troubleshoot and improve processes
  • Use test fixtures, electronic measurement equipment, leak detectors and/or vacuum pumps to test assemblies, subassemblies and components
  • Complete required job documentation (data entry) about progress, work expense and labor details; perform computer programming, repair or software installs, as needed
  • Work independently with minimal supervision, and serve as an informal resource for junior colleagues

What You Need to Bring to the Table: 
  • An Associate’s degree
  • 2–4 years of semiconductor or display experience, or comparable industry or military experience
  • Related technical trainings and certifications
  • Solid analytical skills, and an ability to problem-solve using established operating procedures or scientific methods
  • Demonstrated capability to operate as a peer leader and trainer
  • Demonstrated proficiency for required semiconductor manufacturing concepts and processes
  • ASSEET
  • BSEET (DeVry, TSTC)


Bonus Points! Otherwise Known As Preferred Qualifications:
  • This is a physically demanding position that often requires standing for extended periods of time, walking, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, lifting, the ability to distinguish between colors, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, the use of hand and power tools, and driving or operating heavy machinery including forklifts.
  • Additionally, because this position may involve working in a clean room, the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields may be required.

job.title: Material Coordinator
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Materials Coordinator in Carlsbad, CA.  You will support our biopharmaceutical customer with receiving, storing, staging, and distributing raw materials, components, and finished goods in accordance with cGMP (Current Good Manufacturing Practices), SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), and safety regulations. The role supports production schedules and ensures inventory accuracy while maintaining a safe, clean, and organized warehouse environment.

Location:  Carlsbad, CA 
Shift:   M-F 8-4:30pm 
Pay: $25-28/hr DOE 
Duration: Contract to perm 
Responsibilitie
  • Support and work within the Code of Federal Regulations Title 21, Quality Management System, Standard Operation Procedures (SOP’s), Work Instructions, comply with all documentation needs, and practices.  
  • Perform timely and accurate data entry in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) for material transactions.
  • Perform receipt of incoming materials. Check materials received against specifications, vendor shipping documents and purchase orders for accuracy.
  • Accurately maintain all receiving documentation to comply with internal procedures and or SOPs.
  • Follow best practices related to the systems and process that support material inventory, purchasing, and material control. 
  • Provide recommendations and assist with implementation of improvements.
  • Work with Purchasing and  Accounts Payable to  resolve any supplier invoice issues or discrepancies.
  • Coordinate with Quality Assurance and Quality Control personnel, ensuring timely testing and release of materials.
  • Conduct cycle counts and wall-to-wall counts as needed.
  • Pick and stage materials for manufacturing and laboratory support.
  • Support accurate client billing and raw material traceability through timely processing of return to stock items.
  • Inspect stock for damage/product integrity. Maintain organization of work areas through 6S (sort, set, standardize, shine, sustain, safety).
  • Interact with Manufacturing and laboratory departments to reconcile inventory variances.
  • Perform packaging and shipping of materials and samples to customers and/or testing facilities. Monitor shipments and update of any potential delays.
  • Manage effective relationships with suppliers as well as internal and external clients.
  • Successfully adapt to changing priorities in a high operating tempo.
Qualification
  • Minimum high school diploma, or equivalent
  • Preferred minimum two (2) years’ experience in materials management. Preferred minimum one (1) year experience working in Pharmaceutical environment.
  • Ability to read, understand, and carry out Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s), Work Instructions and other Quality Process Documentation in English.
  • Knowledge of standard concepts, practices and procedures within the manufacturing and biologic environment preferred.
  • Microsoft Office experience

#IND-SPG

job.title: SLA III
job.description:
Yoh presents an excellent long-term Senior Laboratory Analyst III opportunity with a trusted client located in Waltham, MA.  This highly motivated individual will be part of the Analytical Development group within the Genomic Medicine Unit BioAnalytics, which develops, validates, and transfers analytical methods used for characterization and release of viral and non-viral therapeutics to support clinical development of new medicines. The successful candidate will participate in the development, qualification and validation of PCR based assays and other analytical techniques routinely used to support gene therapy development.  A strong background in qPCR and ddPCR is desired, with a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in an industry setting performing and developing molecular biology assays.  This role operates within a GDP environment and requires excellent verbal and written communication skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross functional departments.  Experience with an electronic notebook and document writing is preferred.

Main Responsibilities:
Responsible for performing qPCR and ddPCR methods for viral and non-viral therapeutics.
Development and/or qualification of analytical methods.
Take an active role in lab maintenance, organization, and safety compliance.
Ensure documentation in a Good Documentation Practices (GDP) environment.
Ensure compliant use of written records and electronic notebooks.
Work in a matrixed environment and interact productively with associates, scientists, and management at various levels.

About You:
Education:
BS or MS in Biological Sciences or related fields.
3-5 years of relevant industry experience, including gene therapy (preferred).

Experience & Technical Skills:
Molecular biology development experience.
Experience in performing qPCR and ddPCR experiments, including tracking and trending of data.

Preferred Qualifications:
Experience automating assays with liquid handlers.
Experience with material management, inventory, and logistics.
Knowledge of method robustness and Design of Experiment.

Estimated Max Rate: $25.00

job.title: Software Engineer - ADAS Platform, Sensor Pipeline & AI Inference Optimization
job.description:
Software Engineer - ADAS Platform, Sensor Pipeline & AI
Inference Optimization

Lead the development and optimization of next-generation ADAS platform software across CPUs, GPUs, DSPs, AI accelerators, and safety-critical automotive hardware. Drive sensor processing pipelines, AI inference frameworks, and real-time embedded software that enable perception and autonomous driving capabilities.

Responsibilities
  • Design and optimize platform software supporting camera, radar, lidar, ultrasonic, and vehicle sensor pipelines.
  • Build scalable middleware, frameworks, and infrastructure for ADAS and autonomous driving systems.
  • Optimize AI inference workloads using TensorRT, CUDA, ONNX Runtime, NVIDIA DriveWorks, and OpenCL.
  • Improve latency, throughput, memory utilization, and power efficiency through profiling and performance tuning.
  • Optimize perception, tracking, image processing, and sensor fusion pipelines across CPU, GPU, and hardware accelerators.
  • Develop deterministic real-time software for Embedded Linux and QNX platforms.
  • Design low-latency IPC, shared-memory, DMA, and zero-copy data movement frameworks.
  • Support ISO 26262 compliance, safety reviews, and automotive reliability requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with Perception, ML, Systems, Hardware, and Functional Safety teams.
Experience
  • 10+ years of software development experience.
  • 5+ years in ADAS, autonomous driving, robotics, embedded AI, or high-performance embedded systems.
  • Proven track record delivering production automotive software.
Technical Skills
  • Expert C++14/17+, modern C++ design patterns, multithreading, and memory management.
  • Strong experience with QNX Neutrino RTOS, Embedded Linux, IPC, and real-time systems.
  • Deep expertise in CUDA, TensorRT, GPU memory management, profiling, and performance optimization.
  • Experience deploying AI/ML models on embedded automotive platforms.
Domain Knowledge
  • ADAS software architecture
  • Perception pipelines
  • Sensor fusion
  • Functional safety concepts (ISO 26262)
Preferred
Experience with NVIDIA DRIVE platforms, DriveWorks, perception systems, sensor fusion, and autonomous driving software architectures.

job.title: Polymer Characterization Engineer
job.description:
Polymer Characterization Engineer  

The Product Design Polymers Team is looking for an experienced polymer characterization engineer/scientist to join the Polymer Engineering group within Product Design department.
 
Responsibilities:
 
  • Perform polymer characterization techniques, such as rheology, DMA, FTIR, TGA, DSC, GPC, TMA, tensile testing, creep, fatigue, falling dart impact, chemical resistance testing, optical microscopy, laser interferometry and surface energy measurements.  Ability to execute testing beyond standardized protocols (e.g. ASTM, ISO)
  • Drive hands-on scientific studies of material performance, from DOE plan, to operating characterization instrumentation and analyzing final data
  • Collaborate with material engineers, finite element analysis specialists and product designers in order develop new characterization methods in order to better predict material performance in final products.
  • Work with material engineers to develop test plans for new material investigations, as well as failure analysis.
  • Analyze test results and create presentations to communicate results to an engineering audience with a range of polymer knowledge from novice to expert.
  • Manage, prioritize, and execute multiple test requests per week.
  • Develop collaborative relationships with instrument suppliers, material suppliers, external laboratories and universities to learn about new characterization methods and instrument capabilities.

Job Qualifications:
  • MS required, preferably in polymer chemistry or material science.
  • Advanced knowledge of the structure-property relationships in polymers that govern mechanical performance, material aesthetics, and overall function
  • Experience using analytical test equipment mentioned above.
  • Excellent housekeeping and lab management practices.
  • Experience handling chemicals such as adhesives, solvents, liquid nitrogen and mild acids.
  • Experience in organizing, performing statistical analysis and presentation of material characterization data.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills are necessary. 


Estimated Min Rate: $60.00
Estimated Max Rate: $75.00
