job.title: Visual Marketing Designer - Print & Digital
job.description:
Visual Marketing Designer - Print & Digital 
  • 6 month contract (potential to extend and/or convert)
  • 100% remote (United States)
  • $55-65/hr on W2 (contingent on experience)

*Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorship. Client cannot accept OPT visa, No C2C!!


***Required Documents*** --A cover letter, resume, and digital portfolio showcasing high-quality cross-platform examples.

Summary 

Working under the supervision of the Associate Director, Design, the Visual Designer will be part of the team that includes other visual designers, senior visual designers, production designer, and a creative director, as well as small group of student design interns (CO-OPs). The visual designer partners with multiple teams within Enrollment Management (EM) and joins the multimedia team to round out the creative team within the EM marketing group  at Northeastern University.

In this role, the Visual Designer will ideate and create on behalf of the University, working with the Creative Director, Associate Director, Design, and act as a support to senior visual designer(s). Projects will range from highly art directed to ones with more creative leeway while keeping within the brand identity of the University.

The Creative Team is responsible for conceiving, producing, and presenting content across the enrollment lifecycle for both digital and offline marketing vehicles. The Visual Designer must bring demonstrable experience in design across print and offline collateral; employ professional, proactive, and collegial communication; and be responsive, collaborative, empathetic, and flexible while working within an often fast-paced environment.  

Qualifications 

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required
  • At least two to five years of prior visual design experience
  • Must have a strong design acumen and creative concepting
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to manage and prioritize multiple concurrent projects at varying stages of production
  • Keen time management and communications skills
  • Robust willingness to collaborate and strong interpersonal skills
  • Ability to develop and effectively pitch creative concepts that appeal to a broad range of prospective student groups: undergraduate, graduate, bachelor’s completion, doctoral, certificates, etc.
  • Editorial design, art direction, and social media design experience a plus
  • Additional creative software expertise (video, animation, audio, etc.) a plus
  • An understanding of usability and user-centric design a plus
  • Illustration, animation, and photography skills a plus

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities 

  • Produce top-tiered marketing materials for both print and digital formats that support student recruitment communication efforts, including admission recruitment materials for both graduate and undergraduate audiences, general awareness and program-/ audience-specific advertising, mixed media design
  • Create concepts and designs for print and digital projects, and other special projects, producing them to be print- or publish-ready, as coordinated by production manager and aligned to media specifications
  • Provide layouts and printed comps to marketing managers and partners for approval with clear and well-informed design rationale
  • Partner closely with the multimedia, marketing management, social, and content teams on a multitude of projects.
  • Utilize conventional design software Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, AfterEffects, etc.) to create concepts and designs for publications (print and digital) as assigned
  • Successfully handle up to 15+ projects simultaneously under deadline pressure and with an exceptional attention to detail and ability to communicate effectively with colleagues
  • Provide detailed printing and mailing specs to production manager to secure price estimates
  • Act as liaison to the College of Art, Media, and Design (CAMD) and other schools and programs as needed.
  • Mentor the student designers (CO-OPs), and make recommendations to Senior Designer for potential student intern candidates
  • Part of team that advocates and upholds the Northeastern University brand identity and is responsible for creating collateral that supports enrollment goals across a wide range of prospective students.
  • Other duties as assigned

job.title: Learning Coordinator - Hybrid, Cambridge, MA
job.description:
Learning Coordinator
Cambridge, MA | Hybrid | Contract Overview We are seeking a Learning Coordinator to support Learning & Development programs and deliver a positive experience for employees, facilitators, vendors, and internal stakeholders. This role will coordinate program logistics, maintain accurate records, manage communications, and help ensure learning events run smoothly from planning through follow-up.

Key Responsibilities
  • Plan and coordinate Learning & Development programs, including manager development initiatives.
  • Maintain event records, attendance rosters, registration lists, feedback surveys, and program documentation within a Learning Management System.
  • Manage schedules and calendars across multiple time zones while coordinating facilitators, venues, and participant availability.
  • Support onsite and virtual event logistics, including room setup, materials, technology, catering, participant check-in, and vendor coordination.
  • Provide timely communications before, during, and after each event.
  • Monitor registration and capacity, identifying sessions that require additional communication, resources, or scheduling adjustments.
  • Gather and share post-event feedback to evaluate program effectiveness and support continuous improvement.
  • Assist with HR projects, events, and employee experience initiatives as needed.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 1–3 years of experience in learning coordination, HR, event coordination, or administrative support.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize competing demands.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a customer-focused approach.
  • Comfort using scheduling tools and virtual meeting platforms such as Zoom or Microsoft Teams.

job.title: Bioconjugation Lab Assistant
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Lab Assistant contractor to help support the bioconjugation team in Bristol, PA.   The Lab Assistant provides support to analysts to ensure testing needs can be completed in a timely manner by maintaining lab supplies, equipment, and materials.

Position:  Lab Assistant 
Location: Bristol, PA 
Duration: 3 months 
Schedule:  M-F 7:30 - 4:30pm 
Pay:  $21-24/hr DOE 

Responsibilities
  • Performs daily checks and calibrations of equipment (e.g. balances, storage chambers).
  • Prepare cleaning solutions for laboratory use. Clean and maintain areas of the laboratory and equipment as needed.
  • Perform routine cleaning following proper procedures for equipment such as biosafety cabinets, incubators, water baths, etc.
  • Daily monitoring and restocking of laboratory supplies and chemicals; ensure proper cycling of supplies (first in first out) and monitor supply expiration dates.
  • Orders and receives samples, lab chemicals, and consumable materials/supplies; maintains inventory of received materials and ensures accuracy of information entered.
  • Prepares buffers and solutions used in the lab; cleans lab glassware and instruments used in reagent preparation.
  • Prepares and labels aliquots of samples and reagents.
  • Records laboratory activities in logbooks and lab notebook by following current good documentation practices (cGDP).
  • Assists with maintenance of laboratory equipment list and perform periodic equipment inventory.
  • Assists with periodic lab-wide cleaning schedule for refrigerators and freezer defrosts; assist with disposal of materials and organization of refrigerator/freezer shelves.
  • Setup and transfer materials for shipping to external clients and across internal sites.
  • Maintains laboratory 5S organization, perform additional duties as needed.

Qualifications:
  • High School Diploma or equivalent, AA/AS or BA/BS in chemistry, biology, or related field preferred.
  • Familiarity with analytical, chemical, or biological laboratory environment.
  • Ability to utilize email, word processing, and spreadsheet software.
  • Good oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively.

job.title: Quality Assurance Manager
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Quality Assurance Manager for our medical device manufacturing client in the Los Angeles Metropolitan Area. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the daily operations, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the company's Quality Management System (QMS).

The Quality Assurance Manager will ensure compliance with ISO 13485, FDA Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR), EU MDR, MDSAP, and applicable regulatory requirements while leading quality initiatives, supplier quality programs, audits, CAPA investigations, and continuous improvement efforts. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on medical device quality experience, excellent leadership skills, and the ability to collaborate across Regulatory Affairs, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and executive leadership.

Industry: Medical Device / Healthcare Products
Location: Los Angeles Metropolitan Area – Onsite
Compensation: $129,000–$145,000 annually (based upon experience)
Type: Direct Hire / Full-Time
Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Vacation

Job Functions:
  • Manage, maintain, and continuously improve the company's Quality Management System (QMS) in accordance with ISO 13485, FDA QMSR, EU MDR, MDSAP, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee document control, change control, training records, nonconformances, deviations, and other core Quality System processes.
  • Develop, review, and maintain SOPs, work instructions, quality procedures, and controlled documentation to ensure regulatory compliance.
  • Lead internal, supplier, customer, Notified Body, MDSAP, and regulatory audits while maintaining continuous inspection readiness.
  • Develop and execute risk-based internal audit schedules and coordinate audit preparation, execution, responses, and corrective actions.
  • Serve as a key Quality representative during external audits and regulatory inspections, including FDA and Notified Body inspections.
  • Lead the Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) program, including investigations, root cause analysis, corrective action implementation, and effectiveness verification.
  • Monitor CAPA, nonconformance, and audit trends to identify systemic quality issues and implement sustainable improvements.
  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs to support EU MDR compliance, technical documentation, post-market surveillance, risk management, and regulatory change assessments.
  • Manage supplier quality activities, including supplier qualification, audits, monitoring, quality agreements, corrective actions, and performance evaluations.
  • Evaluate supplier changes and quality events to determine potential impacts on product quality and regulatory compliance.
  • Collaborate with Operations and Supply Chain to ensure appropriate controls are maintained for incoming products, materials, and components.
  • Oversee or support receiving inspections, product testing, sampling, and material disposition activities.
  • Support manufacturing, packaging, sterilization, and inspection process validation and qualification activities.
  • Oversee product complaint handling and quality investigations, ensuring appropriate documentation, escalation, and resolution.
  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs to support regulatory reporting and post-market surveillance requirements.
  • Develop, monitor, and report Quality KPIs, including CAPA performance, complaints, supplier quality, audit findings, nonconformances, and training compliance.
  • Analyze Quality System performance data and identify opportunities for corrective action and continuous improvement.
  • Prepare Quality Management Review reports and presentations for executive leadership.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop Quality team members while establishing performance expectations and departmental priorities.
  • Provide training and guidance on QMS requirements, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), documentation practices, and quality procedures.
  • Support the implementation and optimization of electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS).
  • Promote a culture of quality, regulatory compliance, accountability, and continuous improvement across the organization.

Education and/or Experience:
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Quality, Biomedical Sciences, or a related technical discipline required.
  • Minimum of five (5) to seven (7) years of progressive Quality Assurance experience within the medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Previous experience working within a medical device Quality Management System required.
  • Strong working knowledge of ISO 13485 and FDA medical device quality system requirements, including FDA QMSR.
  • Demonstrated experience with CAPA, nonconformance management, root cause investigations, document control, change control, complaint handling, and internal auditing.
  • Experience participating in and/or leading FDA, Notified Body, MDSAP, customer, supplier, and certification audits.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage audit findings, regulatory observations, and corrective actions through successful closure.
  • Strong understanding of risk-based decision-making and quality risk management principles.
  • Experience developing and analyzing quality metrics and presenting Quality System performance to management.
  • Strong technical writing skills with experience developing SOPs, work instructions, investigation reports, CAPAs, audit responses, and controlled documentation.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience with the ability to train, mentor, and develop Quality team members.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and project management skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across multiple departments and organizational levels.
  • Ability to independently identify Quality System gaps, develop corrective solutions, and drive improvements through implementation.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with EU MDR 2017/745, including Quality System requirements and Notified Body audits.
  • Experience supporting MDSAP audits and regulatory inspections.
  • Experience with disposable or sterile medical devices, including syringes, needles, drug-delivery devices, blood collection products, or similar single-use medical products.
  • Experience managing supplier quality programs, global suppliers, and contract manufacturers.
  • Knowledge of ISO 14971 risk management, post-market surveillance, validation, sterilization, packaging, and medical device manufacturing controls.
  • Experience implementing or managing electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS).
  • Familiarity with international regulatory requirements and global supply chain quality management.
  • Professional certifications such as ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), or Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC) are highly desirable.

Physical Job Requirements
  • Full-time, onsite work environment within a medical device manufacturing and distribution organization.
  • Position involves both office-based Quality Management activities and hands-on support of manufacturing, warehouse, and quality operations.
  • Regular use of computers and standard office equipment for documentation, data analysis, reporting, and communication.
  • May require standing, walking, or moving throughout manufacturing and warehouse areas during audits, inspections, and Quality System assessments.
  • Must be able to review detailed technical documentation, quality records, inspection reports, and regulatory information.
  • Must follow applicable safety procedures and facility requirements when working in manufacturing or controlled environments.

job.description:
Yoh Healthcare is looking for a polished, professional, and corporate savvy Occupational Health Registered Nurse to join our client in Summit, NJ

This is a 1 year+ contract position working in a Pharmaceutical Company, 40 hours per week.

HOURS: 7:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., with one Wednesday a month requiring an extended shift until 6:00 p.m.

Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Registered Nurse
  • Occupational Health

Th Occupational Health Nurse will provide clinical, case management, and administrative services. Working alongside the Provider
  • Provide clinical services, which include phlebotomy, surveillance testing, and management of injuries and illnesses.

  • Submit monthly data for tracking and performance metrics analysis.

  • Proficiently utilize OH electronic medical system and Microsoft platform.

Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for Manufacturing Technician to help a leading diagnostics company in Longmont, CO. The Manufacturing Technician will be responsible for performing mechanical assembly as part of pilot-scale manufacturing of disposable medical devices. JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Title: Senior Accounting Specialist
Location: Englewood Cliffs, New Jersey

POSITION INFORMATION
Job Summary: Assist in the company’s financial closing process related to the general ledger accounts including balance sheet and profit & loss accounts in a timely manner. Maintain accuracy of company financial information while ensuring internal controls and procedures are followed.

• Conduct general ledger activity related to client's business
o Journal entries
o Account reconciliations
o Account analysis

• Finance company experience is a plus

Licenses/Certifications: CPA is highly desirable
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
• Knowledge of Flexi financial software is a plus
• Thorough knowledge cost center and balance sheet analysis

• Ability to multi-task in a dynamic, ever-changing environment
• Highly proficient in Microsoft Office

job.title: Marketing Ops and Automation Specialist
job.description:
Marketing Operations & Automation Specialist
6+ month contract (W2 ONLY, NO C-C)
South San Francisco, CA  (Hybrid)
 
Position Summary
Our client (confidential) is seeking a Marketing Operations & Automation Specialist to support both marketing operations and digital campaign execution. This is a hands-on, tactical role focused on building, maintaining, and improving scalable marketing workflows—while ensuring campaigns are executed on time, accurately, and with high quality.
You’ll serve as the operational backbone of the marketing team by helping improve process efficiency, data flow across systems, reporting visibility, and adoption of automation and emerging technologies (including AI).
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Own day-to-day marketing operations execution and optimization, including building and improving automated workflows across platforms such as Eloqua, HubSpot, ZoomInfo, and CRM integrations.
  • Manage marketing data operations: upload/process lists, routing, segmentation support, and data quality using tools such as RingLead (or similar).
  • Apply and experiment with AI-driven tools to improve efficiency and scalability, including:
    • Workflow automation
    • Content generation support
    • AI-assisted video/content creation
  • Build and maintain dashboards and performance reporting by integrating data across marketing and analytics platforms.
  • Ensure reporting is actionable and aligned to campaign goals and business objectives.
  • Partner with marketing leadership to evaluate, implement, and optimize marketing technology tools and operational processes.
  • Build and update landing pages using no-code/low-code tools (e.g., Ion or similar).
  • Support email marketing campaigns end-to-end (build, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, QA).
  • Assist with digital advertising campaign support, including asset coordination, tracking setup, monitoring, and performance measurement.
  • Maintain documentation, best practices, and process guidelines to enable repeatable, scalable execution.
 
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 3–5 years of experience in marketing operations, digital marketing, or campaign execution.
  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms such as:
    • Eloqua, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, or similar
  • Working knowledge of:
    • Marketing analytics & measurement
    • Data integration and multi-platform reporting
  • Experience using AI tools in marketing or demonstrated ability to quickly learn/apply new AI and automation tools.
  • Understanding of integrations between marketing automation + CRM + web + analytics tools.
  • Experience configuring and optimizing automation workflows, segmentation, and campaign setup.
  • Experience with email campaigns, landing pages, and paid digital campaigns (support/execution).
  • Comfort working with marketing data operations tools (e.g., RingLead or similar).
  • Basic HTML/CSS knowledge and ability to troubleshoot digital assets.
  • Ability to design, document, and improve repeatable operational processes and QA/testing practices.

job.title: Senior Refrigeration Engineer
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Refrigeration Engineer for our Research and Development Client in Marietta, Ohio. This is a great opportunity to join a growing team!

Job Functions:
  • Design and develop cascade vapor-compression systems used in ULT freezers and cold storage platforms.
  • Develop specifications for system-level, subsystem and component performance.
  • Execute test plans to validate the performance of newly developed refrigeration systems by utilizing design for reliability tools and performance sensitivity analysis.
  • Design refrigeration systems that meet customer requirements, time to market commitments and that are within the target cost of the projects.
  • Analyze the thermal behavior of the refrigeration system with thermo-physical tools for component selection and overall refrigeration system design.

Education and Experience Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, systems engineering, chemical engineering, physics, or related discipline
  • Coursework in thermodynamics, heat transfer, and fluid mechanics strongly preferred
  • Master’s degree preferred
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience developing vapor-compression systems for cold storage or HVAC/R products, cascade systems preferred.
  • Experience using natural refrigerants and other low GWP refrigerants in system designs.
  •  Thermal system modeling, simulation, and performance testing
  •  Analyzing empirical test data to guide design decisions
  • Familiarity with data acquisition systems, automated testing, and technical documentation
  • Familiarity with Lean / PPI methodologies and continuous improvement systems.
  • Knowledge of refrigeration system testing methods and equipment

job.title: Sr. Associate Engineer - Process Development
job.description:
Yoh presents an excellent long-term Sr. Associate Engineer – Process Development opportunity with a trusted, long-term client located in Waltham, MA.
 
This position is part of a major pharmaceutical company, and requires a Bachelors and/or Masters of Science and 1-2+ years of relevant experience. Schedule is full-time M-F (7am-8am start time, 8 hour shift) and may require flexibility to work some evenings and overtime due to projects.
 
Key Responsibilities:
  • Provide technical support for scale-up and manufacturing issues and develop solutions to improve process efficiency and product quality.
    • Scale-up
      • Perform process scale-up and Pilot batches
      • Generate and execute scale down models for GMP manufacturing
      • Generate scale-down models to assist with process scale-up
    • Solution Development
      • Generate process changes to address process issues
    • Lead and assist implementation of Digital Tools
      • Assist with the implementation and use of digital tools for inventory management, genealogy, and sample submission
      • Assist with the implementation and use of digital tools for process data acquisition (Electronic lab notebooks and Electronic Batch Records.)
    • Assist with project activities for the design and technology transfer of mRNA manufacturing processes by contributing and reviewing of Batch Records/Master Production Records (MBR) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
      • Tech Transfer
        • Assist with Tech Transfer batches
        • Support knowledge packages for Tech Transfer
      • Document Generation
        • Assist with the review MBRs
        • Assist with the review SOPs
      • Troubleshoot process/analytical issues that occur during scale-ups and/or in production of drug substance and drug product.
        • Contact vendors for equipment support
        • Conduct investigations using techniques such as 5 why’s, Fishbone diagrams, etc.
        • Determine the root cause of process/analytical issues
        • Develop solutions to process/analytical issues
      • Effectively communicate with cross functional teams like Analytical Development, R&D, Process Development, Quality Assurance (QA), Project Management, Regulatory Affairs and Legal teams.
        • Provide Samples to AD
        • Obtain data from AD and compile into reports
        • Obtain processes from R&D and PD and implement at-scale
        • Generate procedures (SOPs, MBRs, Protocols) and work with QA on review and approval
        • Review and follow QA procedures
      • Assist in the preparation of technical reports and presentations that support scale-up activities and process improvements.
        • Technical reports
          • Generate/review Technical reports such as batch summaries, process descriptions, Tech transfer, etc.
        • Presentations
          • Present on batch performance, technical issues, etc.
 
Qualifications:
  • 1+ (Masters) or 2+ (Bachelors) years of relevant experience is required
  • A Bachelor’s degree and/or Master’s degree in Chemical engineering, Biomedical engineering or related field.
  • Demonstrated experience in process development, manufacturing, tech transfer, and/or scale-up to support the manufacturing of biopharmaceuticals (1+ year) is required
  • Experience with mRNA Drug Substance is strongly preferred

Consultant Reporting and Analytics, Global Safety Systems - Hybrid, Cambridge, MA
  Overview
In this hybrid role based in Cambridge, MA, you will partner with Safety and Risk Management teams to develop, test, and validate cutting-edge reporting solutions. Your work will support critical safety activities, including medical monitoring, signal detection, and regulatory reporting, ensuring compliance and enhancing safety processes across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with safety stakeholders to create and refine safety data reports, visualizations, and listings using pharmacovigilance tools like PV Reports, Oracle Analytics Server, OBIEE, BI Publisher, or Cognos. Experience with PV Reports is preferred.
  • Generate and deliver formal safety reports, summaries, and listings to support regulatory and monitoring needs, including PBRERs and DSURs.

  • Contribute to ongoing departmental responsibilities related to regulatory adherence and ICH guidelines for adverse event and product complaint reporting.
Must-Have Requirements

  • Experience with pharmacovigilance reporting tools such as PV Reports, Oracle Analytics Server, OBIEE, BI Publisher, or Cognos (PV Reports experience preferred).
  • Strong ability to generate reports, analyze safety data, and support safety monitoring activities.
  • Ability to document requirements, complete data requests, and coordinate with external partners.
  • Knowledge of validation, quality checks, and system monitoring activities related to safety reporting.
Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with PV Reports.
  • Knowledge of regulatory standards related to safety reporting and compliance.

job.title: Endpoint Support Engineer - Onsite in NYC
job.description:
ENDPOINT SUPPORT ENGINEER OPPORTUNITY - ONSITE IN NYC
  • 6 month contract
  • onsite 5 days/week
  • $60-70/hr on W2 
*Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorship. No C2C!!

Job Summary

The Endpoint Support Engineer provides dedicated, on-site technical support and endpoint engineering for faculty/staff endpoints as well as specialty arts, media, and performance spaces on the Northeastern University New York City campus. The role combines hands-on lab and studio support with endpoint administration in Jamf Pro and Microsoft Intune.

A primary focus of this engagement is migrating lab, studio, and teaching devices onto Northeastern standard management, security, and software delivery, then stabilizing those environments so they run reliably for instruction, production, and performance. The engineer serves as the on-the-ground technical lead for these spaces, working closely with faculty, lab managers, the central Endpoint Engineering team, network and security teams, college technology teams, and on-site ITS staff.

The ideal candidate is a self-directed technologist who is equally comfortable building a Jamf or Intune policy, activating a license on a studio workstation, and explaining a fix to a faculty member minutes before class. The role requires sound judgment about what to fix immediately on site and what to route through standard ITS processes.

Schedule and business continuity

Standard hours are Monday through Friday 8am-5pm, on site in New York City. The role requires occasional early morning, evening, or weekend availability to support term start, scheduled productions and performances, maintenance windows, and urgent issues that block instruction.

2. Minimum Qualifications

•    3+ years of experience in endpoint administration, desktop engineering, or advanced technical support in a mixed macOS and Windows environment.

•    Hands-on experience administering Jamf Pro, including configuration profiles, policies, smart groups, PreStage enrollment, Self Service, and package deployment.

•    Working experience with Microsoft Intune, including Windows Autopilot, compliance and configuration policies, and Win32 app deployment.

•    Strong macOS troubleshooting skills, including permissions, privacy and security settings (TCC/PPPC), screen sharing and remote management, and OS upgrades.

•    Experience supporting creative, media, or engineering software in a lab or studio environment, including network or per-device license activation.

•    Experience with Apple School/Business Manager and Automated Device Enrollment.

•    Scripting ability in zsh/bash and PowerShell to automate common endpoint tasks.

•    Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VLANs, firewall ports) sufficient to diagnose license server and remote management connectivity.

•    Experience documenting work in an ITSM platform such as ServiceNow.

•    Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to work directly with faculty, students, and non-technical stakeholders.

•    Ability to work on site in New York City 5 days per week and travel between campus buildings.

•    Ability to lift up to 40 lbs, work under desks and in tight spaces, and stand for extended periods.

Preferred Qualifications

•    Jamf Certified Admin (JCA) or Jamf Certified Expert (JCE); Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102); Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP).

•    Experience administering Avid Pro Tools, Adobe Admin Console and Creative Cloud packaging, Vectorworks, or Sassafras KeyServer licensing.

•    Familiarity with audio interfaces, MIDI devices, NDI, video capture, and theater or live production technology.

•    Experience with device management migrations, tenant consolidations, or mergers.

•    Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Microsoft Entra ID groups and Conditional Access.

•    Experience in a higher education IT environment.


3. Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

Faculty, Staff, Specialty Lab, and Studio Endpoint Support

•    Provide on-site support for faculty/staff, arts, media, audio, design, and performance labs, studios, and teaching spaces, including computer labs, cart rooms, theater and production spaces, and student loaner devices.

•    Install, configure, license, and troubleshoot specialty creative and production software, including Adobe Creative Cloud, Avid Pro Tools, Vectorworks, Final Draft, Isadora, NDI Tools, and subscription audio plugins that require per-device activation.

•    Verify lab and teaching space readiness before each term and before scheduled productions, performances, and events.

•    Respond to in-class and production-critical blockers on site, and coordinate with classroom AV support when issues cross into room technology.

•    Gather software, version, and seat requirements from faculty and lab managers and route new requests through standard ITS intake channels.

Endpoint Management and Migration

•    Administer macOS and Windows devices in Jamf Pro and Microsoft Intune, including configuration profiles, policies, smart and dynamic groups, compliance policies, and Self Service catalogs.

•    Migrate devices from legacy management platforms into Northeastern Jamf and Intune tenants, including Apple School/Business Manager reassignment, Automated Device Enrollment, device wipe and re-enrollment, and Windows Autopilot hash collection and group tagging.

•    Package, deploy, and patch applications (macOS PKG/DMG, App Store/VPP, Win32, Microsoft 365) and keep operating systems at consistent, supported versions across lab fleets.

•    Apply Northeastern security baselines, including Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, FileVault, BitLocker, recovery locks, and local admin controls.

•    Diagnose and resolve enrollment, profile, policy, and app delivery failures, and escalate platform-level issues to the central Endpoint Engineering team.

Lab Infrastructure and Licensing

•    Support network license and distribution servers for specialty software (for example Avid, Vectorworks, and Sassafras KeyServer), and validate client connectivity to centrally hosted license services.

•    Partner with network, firewall, and identity teams to submit and test port, VLAN, wireless, and access requests that lab software and remote management depend on.

•    Identify, document, and help retire unsupported or insecure legacy servers and equipment in lab spaces and network closets.

•    Maintain accurate hardware and software inventory by room, including seat counts, license terms, and renewal dates.

General On-Site Client Support

•    Provide in-person technical support to faculty, staff, and students on the New York City campus, and serve as backup to the on-site Tech Bar during peak periods.

•    Troubleshoot hardware, account access, Microsoft 365, printing, and connectivity issues, and perform device setup, imaging, and hardware swaps.

•    Document all work in ServiceNow, meet incident and request response targets, and escalate to the appropriate ITS teams.

Documentation and Knowledge Transfer

•    Create and maintain runbooks, lab build standards, software inventories, and knowledge base articles for each supported space.

•    Transition ongoing lab operations and documentation to permanent ITS staff and the Endpoint Engineering team before the contract ends.

Contract Details

•    Term: Full-time 6-month engagement. Northeastern may extend the engagement based on project needs, funding, and performance.

•    Location: On site at the Northeastern University New York City campus. Remote work is limited to approved exceptions.

•    Equipment and access: Northeastern provides required systems access, administrative tooling, and a university-issued device.

•    Management: The contractor takes day-to-day direction from Northeastern leadership and follows ITS change, security, and service management processes.

job.title: Head of Portfolio Architecture, Corporate Functions
job.description:
Head of Portfolio Architecture, Corporate Functions
Direct Hire (Base + Bonus)
Work Location (Hybrid): 3 days/week onsite — New York, NY, Holmdel, NJ, or Bethlehem, PA
 
We’re prioritizing candidates with:
  • Insurance industry architecture leadership experience
  • Architecture & technology alignment at portfolio scale (not just solution design)
  • Strong governance mindset that enables speed, not blocks it
  • Executive presence and proven ability to influence investment/roadmaps
 
Key Responsibilities
Portfolio Architecture Leadership
  • Drive cohesive architecture across multiple value streams, ensuring end-to-end design consistency across platforms, products, and capabilities.
  • Own the Corporate Functions target-state architecture, portfolio roadmap, architecture priorities, and investment influence.
  • Advance modern platform architecture across cloud, data, integration, and AI capabilities.
  • Improve engineering productivity and delivery speed by defining architecture patterns, guardrails, and operating models that scale.
  • Partner with Solution Architects to establish scalable patterns and with enterprise architecture leadership for cross-portfolio alignment and trade-offs.
  • Serve as the primary architecture advisor to the Corporate Functions digital/technology leadership team, shaping strategy, priorities, and transformation sequencing.
  • Manage and develop a team of Solution Architects; raise architecture maturity across the portfolio.
  • Be available for high-impact production incidents affecting business operations.
 
Investment & Roadmap Influence
  • Shape and influence strategic investments across Corporate Functions (HR, Legal, Finance, Risk, Investments).
  • Guide architecture across core enterprise platforms such as Workday, Oracle, and ServiceNow, plus integration/API ecosystem enablement.
  • Balance near-term delivery commitments with long-term sustainability.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt, increase reuse, and accelerate time-to-market—driving simplification across business units, not just within the portfolio.
 
End-to-End Enterprise / Insurance Architecture Ownership
  • Drive holistic architecture across:
    • Business processes and operating value streams
    • Core and surrounding application ecosystems
    • Integration and event-driven architectures
    • AI/ML use cases (e.g., underwriting/claims automation, fraud, personalization)
    • Digital experiences for customers, distribution partners (agents/brokers), and internal users
  • Ensure solutions meet regulatory, risk, security, privacy, and resiliency requirements (e.g., SOX/SOC expectations, data privacy).
  • Promote cloud-native, API-first, data-centric, and AI-enabled patterns where appropriate.
 
Governance, Risk & Compliance
  • Define/enforce architecture principles and guardrails aligned to enterprise standards and insurance regulatory expectations.
  • Lead or participate in architecture review and governance forums; ensure decisions are auditable and practical.
  • Partner with security, risk, compliance, and legal stakeholders to support operational resilience and auditability.
 
Stakeholder & Leadership Engagement
  • Act as a trusted advisor to Corporate Functions leaders and senior technology leadership.
  • Represent architecture trade-offs in enterprise forums and influence outcomes across business units.
  • Communicate architectural direction, risks, and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Mentor and develop architects across the portfolio.
 
Required Qualifications
  • 7+ years in technology/architecture roles, with significant experience in the insurance industry (or similarly regulated financial services with deep insurance exposure).
  • Proven experience as a Portfolio / Domain / Product / Enterprise Architect in a large, regulated environment.
  • Deep understanding of insurance operations and systems (policy, underwriting, claims, billing, distribution) and how they connect to enterprise platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of Corporate Functions ecosystems: HR, Legal, Finance, Risk, Investments.
  • Expertise across enterprise architecture domains: business, application, data, integration, AI, and digital.
  • Demonstrated success influencing senior leaders on technology strategy and investment decisions.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud platforms, modern integration patterns, data platforms, and applied AI capabilities.
  • Solid grasp of regulatory, risk, compliance, and resiliency expectations in regulated environments.

job.title: Senior Vehicle Software Integration Engineer
job.description:
Senior Vehicle Software Integration Engineer

We are building the next generation of electric vehicles from first principles. As a Senior Vehicle Software Integration Engineer, you will play a critical role in bringing together in-house developed software, supplier ECUs, and multi-domain systems into a cohesive vehicle-level experience. You will lead the technical execution of software integration activities across domains (chassis, powertrain, body, ADAS, thermal, infotainment) and ensure that each software drop is tested, validated, and debugged in both virtual environments and prototype vehicles.

This is a hands-on, senior technical role where you will define integration strategies, drive vehicle bring-up, and mentor engineers on best practices for software/hardware integration.

Responsibilities
 
  • Lead vehicle-level software integration across all domains, ensuring compatibility of in-house and supplier ECUs.
  • Define and manage integration strategies, test plans, and regression loops for pre-merge and post-merge software releases.
  • Own and operate prototype vehicle bring-up, including flashing, network validation (CAN/LIN/FlexRay/Ethernet), and feature smoke testing.
  • Drive root-cause analysis of cross-domain software/hardware issues, coordinating with domain software teams and suppliers.
  • Establish and maintain vehicle-level SIL/HIL “virtual car” environments for automated regression testing.
  • Collaborate with Release Engineering to develop efficient software flashing, build, and logging pipelines.
  • Define and maintain interface specifications (signals, diagnostics, timing budgets, communication protocols) across domains.
  • Partner with calibration and attribute teams to ensure vehicle-level attributes (driveability, responsiveness, safety, NVH) are met.
  • Provide technical mentorship to junior integration engineers and operators.
  • Support vehicle testing at proving grounds, winter test sites, and internal fleet usage.


Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in automotive software or systems integration, with at least 3 years at vehicle-level scope.
  • Strong knowledge of embedded automotive ECUs (chassis, powertrain, body, ADAS, thermal).
  • Proficient in vehicle communication protocols (CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Automotive Ethernet).
  • Experience with diagnostics (UDS, OBD-II, DoIP) and flashing tools.
  • Hands-on experience with HIL/SIL environments and prototype vehicle bring-up.
  • Familiarity with tools: CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape, Vector tools, dSPACE, ETAS, Python/C++ scripting.
  • Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills across hardware/software boundaries.
  • Understanding of functional safety (ISO 26262) and ASPICE processes is a plus.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, prototype-heavy environment with limited documentation.
  • Willingness to travel to proving grounds and remote test sites.

job.title: Family Nurse Practitioner
job.description:
Nurse Practitioner needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh’s Primary Care located in Windsor, WI. This clinic provides care to patients ages 2+. Clinical knowledge and experience in primary care, acute care, and occupational health are expected with an ability to provide comprehensive, patient-centered care across a variety of healthcare needs. Strong communication, teamwork, and clinical decision-making skills as well as exceptional customer service is a top priority, with an emphasis on creating a welcoming, respectful, and positive patient experience.
 
Schedule: Mon, Tues 6:30a-4:30p, Wed, Thurs 11a-7p, Fri 8a-12p
Duration: 1/4/27-5/5/27 with training in mid December (PTO coverage)
Pay: $55-70/hr DOE
 
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Performs physical examinations and preventive health measures within prescribed guidelines and instructions of Physician.
  • Orders, interprets, and evaluates diagnostic tests to identify and assess patients’ clinical problems and health care needs.
  • Records physical findings, and formulates plan and prognosis, based on patient’s condition. Provides written home-going instructions.
  • Collaborates with Physician and other health professionals to prepare comprehensive patient care plan as necessary.
  • Prescribes or recommends medications or other forms of treatment such as physical therapy, inhalation therapy, or related therapeutic procedures.
  • Refers patients to Physician for consultation or to specialized health resources for treatment.
  • Maintains medical records using (In some health centers it may be using Electronic Medical Record software).
